name: Flexon MR Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About FLEXON MR TABLET

FLEXON MR TABLET is a combination of Chlorzoxazone, Ibuprofen, and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants, Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs, and Analgesics, respectively. It is used to manage spondylitis (inflammatory arthritis affecting spine and large joints), lower back pain, frozen shoulder, and myalgia (muscle aches and pain) in affected individuals.

FLEXON MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to paracetamol, ibuprofen, and/or chlorzoxazone. It is also not recommended for use in patients with a history of allergic reactions associated with other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs/ acetylsalicylic acid. The medicine is not recommended for use in patients suffering from severe hepatocellular insufficiency/renal failure/heart failure, active/history of ulceration/ perforation/bleeding in the digestive tract, and/or defects in blood clotting.

Before taking FLEXON MR TABLET, inform your doctor if you had asthma, and/or have uncontrolled high blood pressure, kidney problems (such as severe renal insufficiency, renal impairment), heart problems (such as congestive heart failure, ischaemic heart disease), and liver problems (such as mild to moderate hepatocellular insufficiency, hepatic dysfunction), and

FLEXON MR TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women during third trimester stage. It should be used with caution in first and second trimester of pregnancy stage only if is clearly necessary. The medicine is advised to be used with caution in breastfeeding women only if necessary, since the medicine may pass through breast milk.

FLEXON MR TABLET is not recommended for use in children (aged below 12 years) and in adolescents weighing less than 40kg. The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of taking FLEXON MR TABLET are heart burn, abdominal pain, nausea, indigestion, vomiting, flatulence, diarrhoea, and/or constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How FLEXON MR TABLET Works

FLEXON MR TABLET helps in reducing pain, where chlorzoxazone relaxes muscles by acting on the certain areas of the brain which inhibits reflexes involved in producing and maintaining muscle spasms, ibuprofen reduces inflammation and provides relief from pain by blocking the production of certain chemical messengers in the body that cause inflammation and paracetamol provides relief from pain by working on receptors involved in production of chemical messengers that are responsible to cause pain in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use FLEXON MR TABLET

Take FLEXON MR TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the tablet with the glass of water. Take the medicine with food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: FLEXON MR TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women during third trimester stage. It should be used with caution in first and second trimester of pregnancy stage only if is clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
FLEXON MR TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding mothers as this medicine may pass into milk in low concentrations. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or operate machines if you feel dizzy, and/or tired after taking FLEXON MR TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking FLEXON MR TABLET since it may aggravate dizziness, tiredness, addiction and may increase risk of toxification (including fatal outcome).

FLEXON MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe renal failure. It should be used with caution in patients with severe renal insufficiency or mild to moderate renal impairment. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

FLEXON MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hepatocellular insufficiency. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate hepatocellular insufficiency/hepatic dysfunction. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

FLEXON MR TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to paracetamol, ibuprofen, chlorzoxazone, and/or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is also not recommended for use in patients with a history of allergic reactions (angioedema, asthma, bronchospasm, rhinitis or urticaria) associated with other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs/ acetylsalicylic acid. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
FLEXON MR TABLET should be used with caution in patients with a history of asthma attacks. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

FLEXON MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease such as severe heart failure. It should be used with caution in patients with a history of heart failure (such as fluid retention/swelling upon taking NSAID therapy). It is also advised to be used with caution in patients with congestive heart failure (inability of heart to pump sufficient blood), ischaemic heart disease (impaired blood flow to heart tissues), and/or carotid stenosis (condition that occurs due to blockade of carotid artery). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

Others

FLEXON MR TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have a history of ulcer/ perforation/bleeding in the digestive tract.
Have defects in blood clotting/coagulation.
Suffer/have a history of recurrent/existing stomach ulcerations/haemorrhages.
Suffer from stroke/other bleeding disorders.  
Suffer from severe dehydration due to vomiting, diarrhoea, and/or insufficient fluid intake.

Before taking FLEXON MR TABLET, inform your doctor if you:    

Have signs of glucose-6-phosphate-dehydrogenase deficiency (genetic disorder that affects red blood cells) such as fever, dark urine, abdominal pain, back pain, weakness, and pale skin.
Signs of Gilbert´s syndrome (genetic disorder that affects liver's ability to break down red blood cells) such as dark-colored urine, difficulty concentrating, and dizziness.
Signs of low glutathione reserves such as anaemia, acid build-up in the body, frequent infections, and seizures
Have mixed connective tissue disease such as systemic lupus erythematosus (autoimmune disease that attacks body's own tissues).
Have congenital disorder of porphyrin metabolism (rare metabolic disorder causing partial deficiency of the enzyme porphobilinogen deaminase)
Have disorders of digestive tract such as peptic ulcer, hiatus hernia or gastrointestinal bleeding
Have chronic inflammatory intestinal disease such as ulcerative colitis, Crohn’s disease.
Have recently undergone major surgery.
Have hay fever (allergy to pollen grains)
Have nasal polyps (abnormal growth in nose)
Have Quincke’s oedema (a feeling of rapidly progressing blockage or presence of a foreign body in the throat)
Have a history of high blood pressure.
Are suffering from uncontrolled high blood pressure.

Use in Paediatrics

FLEXON MR TABLET is not recommended for use in children (aged below 12 years) and adolescents (weighing less than 40kg).  Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

Use in Geriatrics

FLEXON MR TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions

Before taking FLEXON MR TABLET, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used to manage epilepsy such as antiepileptics Ex. phenobarbital, phenytoin, carbamazepine, or topiramate
Medicine used to manage tuberculosis Ex. rifampicin
Medicines that are used to delay blood clotting such as antivitamin K (Ex. warfarin)
Flucloxacillin (medicine used to manage infections)
Medicines used to manage infections such as quinolone antibiotics (Ex. ciprofloxacin)
Medicine used to manage pain and inflammation such as NSAIDs (Ex. dexamethasone) or salicylates (Ex. aspirin)
Medicines used to reduce nausea and vomiting Ex. metoclopramide, domperidone
Medicines used to remove harmful metals from the body such as chelating agents Ex. dimercaprol
Medicines used to manage pain and inflammation such as corticosteroids Ex. dexamethasone, prednisolone
Medicines used to manage depression such as lithium or selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs) Ex. fluoxetine, citalopram, or sertraline
Medicines used to manage gout Ex. probenecid, sulfinpyrazone
Medicines used to lower the blood pressure such as diuretics (Ex. spironolactone), ACE inhibitors (Ex. enalapril), beta-receptor-blockers (Ex. atenolol), and angiotensin-II antagonists (Ex. telmisartan)
Medicines used to manage psoriasis Ex. methotrexate
Medicines used to manage organ reject after transplant Ex. ciclosporin, tacrolimus
Medicines used to manage AIDS or HIV Ex. zidovudine
Medicines used to lower blood sugar levels such as sulphonylureas (Ex. gliclazide)
Medicines used to manage digestive tract problems such as CYP2C9 inhibitors Ex. fluconazole
Medicines used for abortions Ex. mifepristone
Medicine used to manage heart failure and abnormal heart rhythms Ex. digoxin

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of FLEXON MR TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are nausea, vomiting, anorexia (an eating disorder), pallor, abdominal pain, hepatic cytolysis (liver disorder caused by drug overdose), digestive tract bleeding, acid build-up in the body, encephalopathy (disease that alters brain functions), disseminated intravascular coagulation (formation of blood clots in blood vessels), increased bleeding time, pancreatitis (inflammation of pancreas), acute renal failure, pancytopenia (shortness of breath, pale skin, or fatigue). Other symptoms include headache, dizziness, drowsiness, light-headedness, unconsciousness, low blood pressure, breathing problems, cyanosis (bluish discoloration of fingernails due to lack of oxygen), diarrhoea, weakness/sluggishness, loss of muscle tone making voluntary movements impossible, impaired tendon reflexes, and/or coma.

name: Bizlo Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About BIZLO TABLET

BIZLO TABLET contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking BIZLO TABLET inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

BIZLO TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with BIZLO TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

BIZLO TABLET may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking BIZLO TABLET are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking BIZLO TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BIZLO TABLET
Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How BIZLO TABLET Works

BIZLO TABLET is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use BIZLO TABLET

Take BIZLO TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking BIZLO TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

introduction:
Introduction About MYOTOP 150MG TABLET

MYOTOP 150MG TABLET contains Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle Relaxants. It is used to relieve painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of the muscles. Symptoms include muscular weakness, tingling or prickling sensation, pain or discomfort.

MYOTOP 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver or kidney impairment, galactose intolerance, the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption and myasthenia gravis. MYOTOP 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney impairment.

MYOTOP 150MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. MYOTOP 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age) and in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking MYOTOP 150MG TABLET are muscle weakness, headache, nausea, indigestion and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
usesDetails:
Uses Of MYOTOP 150MG TABLET
Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
mechanismOfAction:
How MYOTOP 150MG TABLET Works

MYOTOP 150MG TABLET works by blocking the voltage-gated sodium channel in the brain stem thereby causing muscle relaxation and stopping the pain signals between nerve and brain. It also relieves pain by increasing the blood supply to skeletal muscles.
usageDetails:
How to use MYOTOP 150MG TABLET

Take MYOTOP 150MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with plenty of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking MYOTOP 150MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

MYOTOP 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment. MYOTOP 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Tolperisone or any other ingredients of this medicine. It should be used with caution in patients who are allergic to lidocaine (due to cross-reactions).

name: Nucoxia MR Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About NUCOXIA MR TABLET

NUCOXIA MR TABLET is a combination of Etoricoxib and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) and Muscle relaxants. It is used to reduce pain and swelling in the joints and muscles in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, gout and muscle spasm. This medicine is also used for the short-term management after dental surgery for moderate pain. Muscle spasm is the rapid spontaneous contractions of the muscle, which can be painful and uncomfortable. When the nerve impulses are damaged or interrupted that control muscle movement, it could lead to muscle spasms. Symptoms include muscle tightness, joint stiffness, unusual posture, difficulty in moving and pain in affected muscles and joints.

NUCOXIA MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having inflammatory bowel disease, severe congestive heart failure, peptic ulcer or cerebrovascular disease. Consult your doctor for advice. Before taking NUCOXIA MR TABLET, inform your doctor if you have blood disorders, kidney problems, liver problems or heart problems.

NUCOXIA MR TABLET is not recommended to use among pregnant and breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of this medicine are stomach pain, dry socket, edema, dizziness, headache, palpitations, arrhythmia, constipation, diarrhea, indigestion, gastritis, nausea and vomiting. Consult your doctor if the above side effects worsens or persist for a longer duration.

Have stomach ulcer or bleeding in the stomach or intestines
Have Crohn’s disease, Ulcerative colitis, or Colitis (inflammatory bowel disease)
Have any kind of stroke, and muscles problems
Have peripheral arterial disease

Tell your physician before taking this medicine if you:

Had dehydration (a prolonged bout of vomiting or diarrhea)
Had swelling due to fluid retention
Have being managed for an infection
Have high cholesterol, diabetes
Are a smoker
Have epilepsy

Introduction About ACENAC MR 8MG TABLET

ACENAC MR 8MG TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs and Muscle relaxants. ACENAC MR 8MG TABLET is used in adults for the management of acute inflammatory and painful conditions associated with muscle spasms, such as lower back pain, muscle spasm due to any injury, neck and shoulder pain, sciatica (type of nerve pain), degenerative vertebral disorders, ankylosing spondylitis (chronic back pain due to fusion of some bones of the spine), osteoarthritis, and rheumatoid arthritis.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking ACENAC MR 8MG TABLET. ACENAC MR 8MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from stomach ulcers, intestinal bleeding or have a history of stomach ulcers, severe kidney problems, liver failure, bleeding disorders, peripheral arterial disease (problem with blood circulation), heart problems such as heart attack, stroke, blockages in blood vessels of brain or heart or had a history of heart surgery for clearing blockages, rare hereditary problems of galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption, therefore consult your doctor before taking.

ACENAC MR 8MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver and kidney problems, seizures, stomach and bowel disorders, asthma or breathing problems, blood disorders (porphyria), recovering from major surgery, and alcohol dependence. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

ACENAC MR 8MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women; therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. ACENAC MR 8MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 16 years of age. ACENAC MR 8MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (>65 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects after taking ACENAC MR 8MG TABLET are dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea, drowsiness, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any side effects or an allergic reaction after taking this medicine.

mechanismOfAction:
How ACENAC MR 8MG TABLET Works

ACENAC MR 8MG TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside, which work together to reduce pain and inflammation. Paracetamol and aceclofenac stop the formation of pain and inflammation-causing chemicals called prostaglandins, and thiocolchicoside acts in the brain and spinal cord on GABA receptors and helps to relieve muscle stiffness and muscle spasms.

Take ACENAC MR 8MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Take ACENAC MR 8MG TABLET with meals or after meals. Swallow ACENAC MR 8MG TABLET as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration of management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About EPRISAN SR CAPSULE

EPRISAN SR CAPSULE contains Eperisone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle Relaxants. It is used to manage and improve the myotonic condition of the muscles caused by neck-shoulder arm syndrome (a condition causing muscle pain and stiffness in the neck, arm, and shoulder region), scapulohumeral periarthritis (a condition causing muscle pain and stiffness in the shoulder joint), and low back pain (a painful condition affecting the lower region of the spine due to a muscle or ligament injury).

The myotonic condition causes wasting and weakness of the muscle when its functional ability to relax is impaired. It is also used to manage spastic paralysis (loss of muscle function along with pain and muscle stiffness) caused by a spinal or neurological disorder, trauma, cerebral palsy, tumour in the spine, etc.

EPRISAN SR CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with liver function disorders. EPRISAN SR CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy unless recommended by your doctor. EPRISAN SR CAPSULE is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. Its safety and efficiency for use in children have not been established. Consult your doctor for advice before taking EPRISAN SR CAPSULE.

The most common side effects of taking EPRISAN SR CAPSULE may include weakness, light-headedness, fatigue, sleepiness, insomnia, headache, nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, abdominal pain, diarrhea, constipation, and thirst. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persist.

introduction:
Introduction About ETOWIN MR 4MG TABLET

ETOWIN MR 4MG TABLET is a combination of Etoricoxib and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) and Muscle relaxants. It is used to reduce pain and swelling in the joints and muscles in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, gout and muscle spasm. This medicine is also used for the short-term management after dental surgery for moderate pain. Muscle spasm is the rapid spontaneous contractions of the muscle, which can be painful and uncomfortable. When the nerve impulses are damaged or interrupted that control muscle movement, it could lead to muscle spasms. Symptoms include muscle tightness, joint stiffness, unusual posture, difficulty in moving and pain in affected muscles and joints.

ETOWIN MR 4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having inflammatory bowel disease, severe congestive heart failure, peptic ulcer or cerebrovascular disease. Consult your doctor for advice. Before taking ETOWIN MR 4MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have blood disorders, kidney problems, liver problems or heart problems.

ETOWIN MR 4MG TABLET is not recommended to use among pregnant and breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of this medicine are stomach pain, dry socket, edema, dizziness, headache, palpitations, arrhythmia, constipation, diarrhea, indigestion, gastritis, nausea and vomiting. Consult your doctor if the above side effects worsens or persist for a longer duration.

introduction:
Introduction About MOVEXX MR TABLET

MOVEXX MR TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac, Chlorzoxazone and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Muscle relaxants respectively. It is used to manage muscular pains and spasms. It can also be used to provide relief from joint pain (Ex. osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis) and back pain (Ex. ankylosing spondylitis).

Take MOVEXX MR TABLET preferably with meals to avoid gut irritation. Avoid consumption of alcohol as it could aggravate the risk of stomach problems. Do not take MOVEXX MR TABLET if you have any ulcers, bleeding or perforations in the gut.

Before taking MOVEXX MR TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, high blood cholesterol, any inflammation in the bowel or intestines, blood clots, bleeding problems or a previous history of stomach ulcers as a precaution.

MOVEXX MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver failure or stroke. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of taking MOVEXX MR TABLET are nausea, vomiting, indigestion, heartburn and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MOVEXX MR TABLET

It is used to manage:

Muscle pain and spasms
Joint pain and back pain
mechanismOfAction:
How MOVEXX MR TABLET Works

MOVEXX MR TABLET contains three medicines namely Chlorzoxazone, Aceclofenac and paracetamol. Chlorzoxazone is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the brain and in spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.

Aceclofenac and paracetamol are analgesic agents. They provide pain relief by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, inflammation and swelling. Collectively, these action helps in reducing muscle spasms, joint pain and inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use MOVEXX MR TABLET

Take MOVEXX MR TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with meals to avoid gastric irritation.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: TIZAVIN 2mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TIZAVIN 2MG TABLET

TIZAVIN 2MG TABLET contains Tizanidine which belongs to a group of medicines called Skeletal muscle relaxants. It is used to relieve the stiffness and restriction of muscles resulting from multiple sclerosis, injury or diseases of the spinal cord.

Multiple sclerosis is a disease in which the immune system destroys the protective layer of nerves resulting in cramping, difficulty in walking, muscle paralysis, etc. Your doctor may want you to take several blood tests and liver function tests to understand your existing condition. Do not consume alcohol while taking this medicine.

TIZAVIN 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems, or rare hereditary problems of galactose intolerance, lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose galactose malabsorption. Before using TIZAVIN 2MG TABLET consult your doctor if you have any kidney, liver, heart disease (like coronary artery disease), or intolerance to any sugars.

TIZAVIN 2MG TABLET is not recommended in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. TIZAVIN 2MG TABLET should be used with caution in geriatric patients. The most common side effects of using this medicine are drowsiness, tiredness, dizziness, dry mouth. Consult your doctor if these side effects get more severe.

name: Zerodol TH 4mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ZERODOL TH 4MG TABLET

ZERODOL TH 4MG TABLET is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

ZERODOL TH 4MG TABLET is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, ZERODOL TH 4MG TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking ZERODOL TH 4MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take ZERODOL TH 4MG TABLET if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking ZERODOL TH 4MG TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take ZERODOL TH 4MG TABLET only as advised by your doctor. Do not take ZERODOL TH 4MG TABLET longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with ZERODOL TH 4MG TABLET to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking ZERODOL TH 4MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Collectively, ZERODOL TH 4MG TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

introduction:
Introduction About CIP ZOX TABLET

CIP ZOX TABLET is a combination of Chlorzoxazone, Diclofenac sodium and Paracetamol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants, Analgesics and Anti-pyrectics and Analgesics. It is used to manage painful muscle spasms associated with musculoskeletal conditions and provides effective relief from headaches, toothache, period pains, rheumatic pain, tendon pain, gout, soft tissue injuries, backache, arthritic pain, sprains, strains, frozen shoulder, muscle pain.

Avoid consuming alcohol while taking CIP ZOX TABLET as it may worsen your condition. CIP ZOX TABLET is not recommended for use by patients with nasal polyps, rhinitis, asthma precipitated by aspirin (aspirin-sensitive asthma) or other NSAIDs, severe liver, kidney or heart disease, history of active gastric or intestinal ulcer, bleeding (blood in stools, vomiting blood) or perforation. CIP ZOX TABLET should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing asthma, COPD, mild to moderate liver or kidney disease and high blood pressure.

CIP ZOX TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy. CIP ZOX TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding mothers. CIP ZOX TABLET is not recommended for use by children. CIP ZOX TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhoea, indigestion, ulcers in the stomach or intestines, bleeding/perforation, heartburn etc. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms get worse.

Together, relieves pain effectively.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you have visual disturbances, dizziness, vertigo, somnolence, drowsiness or fatigue after taking CIP ZOX TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking CIP ZOX TABLET as it may lead to unwanted effects.
CIP ZOX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease and should be used with caution in mild to moderate kidney disease. Contact your doctor before taking it.
CIP ZOX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease and should be used with caution in mild to moderate liver disease. Contact your doctor before taking it.

Do not take CIP ZOX TABLET if you are allergic to chlorzoxazone, diclofenac sodium or to acetylsalicylic acid, other NSAIDs, misoprostol, other prostaglandins, paracetamol, or to lactose, or to other ingredients of this medicine.

CIP ZOX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with nasal polyps, rhinitis, asthma precipitated by aspirin (aspirin-sensitive asthma) or other NSAIDs and should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing asthma and COPD. Contact your doctor before taking it.

CIP ZOX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe congestive heart failure, ischemic heart disease (heart attack), blockages of blood vessels to the heart and should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure and mild to moderate heart failure. Contact your doctor before taking it.

Others

CIP ZOX TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have a history or active gastric or intestinal ulcer, bleeding (blood in stools, vomiting blood) or perforation or cerebrovascular bleeding
Have angioedema, urticaria
Have peripheral arterial disease
Have cerebrovascular disease (stroke), mini-stroke (TIA) or blockages of blood vessels to the brain
Have rare hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, severe lactase deficiency and glucose-galactose malabsorption
Have or undergoing coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery
Have ethanol intoxication
Have dehydration

Before taking CIP ZOX TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease
Have hyperlipidaemia
Have diabetes mellitus
Smoke
Have blood clotting disorders or haematological abnormalities
Have systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE)
Have mixed connective tissue disorders
Have aseptic meningitis
Have angina

Use in paediatrics:

CIP ZOX TABLET is not recommended for use in children. Contact your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

CIP ZOX TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking it.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took too much of this medicine, consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdose are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, anorexia, epigastric pain or abdominal pain, drowsiness, dizziness, light-headedness, malaise or sluggishness, followed by marked loss of muscle tone making voluntary movement impossible and decrease in deep tendon reflexes, pallor, gastrointestinal bleeding, confusion, disorientation, excitation, tinnitus, fainting or convulsions, hypertension, acute renal failure (with acute tubular necrosis, characterised by loin pain, haematuria and proteinuria) and liver damage. Abnormalities of glucose metabolism, metabolic acidosis, cardiac arrhythmias, pancreatitis and anaphylactic reactions may occur. In severe cases, hepatic failure may progress to encephalopathy, haemorrhage, hypoglycaemia, cerebral oedema, respiratory depression, low blood pressure, coma, and death.

introduction:
Introduction About FLEXURA 400MG TABLET

FLEXURA 400MG TABLET contains Metaxalone which belongs to the group of medicines called Skeletal Muscle Relaxants. It is used with rest, physical therapy and other measures to relax muscles and relieve pain and discomfort caused by strains, sprains and other muscle injuries.

FLEXURA 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with anaemia (decreased red blood cells), severe liver, kidney dysfunction. FLEXURA 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with fits. Consult your doctor before taking it.

FLEXURA 400MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless it is considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

FLEXURA 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children younger than 12 years old. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

The most common side effects of taking FLEXURA 400MG TABLET are drowsiness, dizziness, headache, nervousness or irritability, nausea, vomiting, stomach upset. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

FLEXURA 400MG TABLET works by blocking nerve impulses (or pain sensations) in the brain. This improves helps to relax muscles.

Take FLEXURA 400MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MYOSPAZ FORTE TABLET

MYOSPAZ FORTE TABLET is a combination of Chlorzoxazone, Diclofenac sodium and Paracetamol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants, Analgesics and Anti-pyrectics and Analgesics. It is used to manage painful muscle spasms associated with musculoskeletal conditions and provides effective relief from headaches, toothache, period pains, rheumatic pain, tendon pain, gout, soft tissue injuries, backache, arthritic pain, sprains, strains, frozen shoulder, muscle pain.

Avoid consuming alcohol while taking MYOSPAZ FORTE TABLET as it may worsen your condition. MYOSPAZ FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use by patients with nasal polyps, rhinitis, asthma precipitated by aspirin (aspirin-sensitive asthma) or other NSAIDs, severe liver, kidney or heart disease, history of active gastric or intestinal ulcer, bleeding (blood in stools, vomiting blood) or perforation. MYOSPAZ FORTE TABLET should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing asthma, COPD, mild to moderate liver or kidney disease and high blood pressure.

MYOSPAZ FORTE TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy. MYOSPAZ FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding mothers. MYOSPAZ FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use by children. MYOSPAZ FORTE TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhoea, indigestion, ulcers in the stomach or intestines, bleeding/perforation, heartburn etc. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms get worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How MYOSPAZ FORTE TABLET Works

MYOSPAZ FORTE TABLET helps to manage pain, where Chlorzoxazone is a muscle relaxant, acts on the brain and spinal cord causing relaxation of muscles and relief of pain, while Diclofenac is an NSAID inhibits COX-1 and COX-2 and blocks the production of prostaglandins (which are responsible for pain) and Paracetamol is an Analgesic, increases the pain threshold by inhibiting COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes. Together, relieves pain effectively.

Symptoms of overdose are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, anorexia, epigastric pain or abdominal pain, drowsiness, dizziness, light-headedness, malaise or sluggishness, followed by marked loss of muscle tone making voluntary movement impossible and decrease in deep tendon reflexes, pallor, gastrointestinal bleeding, confusion, disorientation, excitation, tinnitus, fainting or convulsions, hypertension, acute renal failure (with acute tubular necrosis, characterised by loin pain, haematuria and proteinuria) and liver damage. Abnormalities of glucose metabolism, metabolic acidosis, cardiac arrhythmias, pancreatitis and anaphylactic reactions may occur. introduction:
Introduction About ETORICA MR 60/4MG TABLET

ETORICA MR 60/4MG TABLET is a combination of Etoricoxib and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) and Muscle relaxants. It is used to reduce pain and swelling in the joints and muscles in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, gout and muscle spasm. This medicine is also used for the short-term management after dental surgery for moderate pain. Muscle spasm is the rapid spontaneous contractions of the muscle, which can be painful and uncomfortable. When the nerve impulses are damaged or interrupted that control muscle movement, it could lead to muscle spasms. Symptoms include muscle tightness, joint stiffness, unusual posture, difficulty in moving and pain in affected muscles and joints.

ETORICA MR 60/4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having inflammatory bowel disease, severe congestive heart failure, peptic ulcer or cerebrovascular disease. Consult your doctor for advice. Before taking ETORICA MR 60/4MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have blood disorders, kidney problems, liver problems or heart problems.

ETORICA MR 60/4MG TABLET is not recommended to use among pregnant and breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of this medicine are stomach pain, dry socket, edema, dizziness, headache, palpitations, arrhythmia, constipation, diarrhea, indigestion, gastritis, nausea and vomiting. Consult your doctor if the above side effects worsens or persist for a longer duration.

introduction:
Introduction About LIOFEN 5MG TABLET

LIOFEN 5MG TABLET contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking LIOFEN 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

LIOFEN 5MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with LIOFEN 5MG TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

LIOFEN 5MG TABLET may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking LIOFEN 5MG TABLET are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking LIOFEN 5MG TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LIOFEN 5MG TABLET
Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How LIOFEN 5MG TABLET Works

LIOFEN 5MG TABLET is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use LIOFEN 5MG TABLET

Take LIOFEN 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking LIOFEN 5MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

introduction:
Introduction About DOLOKIND MR TABLET

DOLOKIND MR TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac, Chlorzoxazone and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Muscle relaxants respectively. It is used to manage muscular pains and spasms. It can also be used to provide relief from joint pain (Ex. osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis) and back pain (Ex. ankylosing spondylitis).

Take DOLOKIND MR TABLET preferably with meals to avoid gut irritation. Avoid consumption of alcohol as it could aggravate the risk of stomach problems. Do not take DOLOKIND MR TABLET if you have any ulcers, bleeding or perforations in the gut.

Before taking DOLOKIND MR TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, high blood cholesterol, any inflammation in the bowel or intestines, blood clots, bleeding problems or a previous history of stomach ulcers as a precaution.

DOLOKIND MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver failure or stroke. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of taking DOLOKIND MR TABLET are nausea, vomiting, indigestion, heartburn and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOLOKIND MR TABLET

It is used to manage:

Muscle pain and spasms
Joint pain and back pain
mechanismOfAction:
How DOLOKIND MR TABLET Works

DOLOKIND MR TABLET contains three medicines namely Chlorzoxazone, Aceclofenac and paracetamol. Chlorzoxazone is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the brain and in spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.

Aceclofenac and paracetamol are analgesic agents. They provide pain relief by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, inflammation and swelling. Collectively, these action helps in reducing muscle spasms, joint pain and inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use DOLOKIND MR TABLET

Take DOLOKIND MR TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with meals to avoid gastric irritation.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About NEORELAX MR 8MG TABLET

NEORELAX MR 8MG TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs and Muscle relaxants. NEORELAX MR 8MG TABLET is used in adults for the management of acute inflammatory and painful conditions associated with muscle spasms, such as lower back pain, muscle spasm due to any injury, neck and shoulder pain, sciatica (type of nerve pain), degenerative vertebral disorders, ankylosing spondylitis (chronic back pain due to fusion of some bones of the spine), osteoarthritis, and rheumatoid arthritis.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking NEORELAX MR 8MG TABLET. NEORELAX MR 8MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from stomach ulcers, intestinal bleeding or have a history of stomach ulcers, severe kidney problems, liver failure, bleeding disorders, peripheral arterial disease (problem with blood circulation), heart problems such as heart attack, stroke, blockages in blood vessels of brain or heart or had a history of heart surgery for clearing blockages, rare hereditary problems of galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption, therefore consult your doctor before taking.

NEORELAX MR 8MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver and kidney problems, seizures, stomach and bowel disorders, asthma or breathing problems, blood disorders (porphyria), recovering from major surgery, and alcohol dependence. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

NEORELAX MR 8MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women; therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. NEORELAX MR 8MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 16 years of age. NEORELAX MR 8MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (>65 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects after taking NEORELAX MR 8MG TABLET are dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea, drowsiness, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any side effects or an allergic reaction after taking this medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About BACLOF 10MG TABLET

BACLOF 10MG TABLET contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking BACLOF 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

BACLOF 10MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with BACLOF 10MG TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

BACLOF 10MG TABLET may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking BACLOF 10MG TABLET are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking BACLOF 10MG TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BACLOF 10MG TABLET
Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How BACLOF 10MG TABLET Works

BACLOF 10MG TABLET is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use BACLOF 10MG TABLET

Take BACLOF 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking BACLOF 10MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

introduction:
Introduction About ZERODOL TH 8MG TABLET

ZERODOL TH 8MG TABLET is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

ZERODOL TH 8MG TABLET is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, ZERODOL TH 8MG TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking ZERODOL TH 8MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take ZERODOL TH 8MG TABLET if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking ZERODOL TH 8MG TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take ZERODOL TH 8MG TABLET only as advised by your doctor. Do not take ZERODOL TH 8MG TABLET longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with ZERODOL TH 8MG TABLET to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking ZERODOL TH 8MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ROBINAXOL TABLET

ROBINAXOL TABLET is a combination of Methocarbamol and Paracetamol, which belong to the groups of medicines called Muscle relaxants, Analgesics and antipyretics, respectively. ROBINAXOL TABLET is used to manage painful muscle spasms associated with short-term muscle disorders like spasms in the lower back. Muscle spasm is a condition in which there are sudden, painful, and involuntary muscle contractions that occur when the nerve impulses that control the muscle movements are damaged or interrupted.

ROBINAXOL TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or have had brain damage or a coma, epilepsy or convulsions, or myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness). Before taking ROBINAXOL TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems related to the kidney or liver.

Before taking ROBINAXOL TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. ROBINAXOL TABLET is not recommended for use by children (16 and under). Elderly patients above 65 years of age should always consult their doctor before taking ROBINAXOL TABLET. The most common side effects of ROBINAXOL TABLET are nausea, vomiting, blurred vision, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, itching, etc. Consult your doctor for advice if your symptoms get worse over time.
uses: Manage painful muscle spasms associated with short-term muscle disorders like spasms in the lower back
usesDetails:

Manage painful muscle spasms associated with short-term muscle disorders like spasms in the lower back
mechanismOfAction:
How ROBINAXOL TABLET Works

ROBINAXOL TABLET is a combination of Methocarbamol and Paracetamol. Methocarbamol is a muscle relaxant that works on the brain and spinal cord to relieve muscle stiffness or spasm and to improve pain and movement of muscles. Paracetamol is an Analgesic and Antipyretic that works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers in the brain that cause pain and fever. Thus, together they relieve pain and relax the muscles.
usageDetails:
How to use ROBINAXOL TABLET

Always take ROBINAXOL TABLET as directed by your physician. Take it with or without food, swallow the medicine as full and do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not stop taking ROBINAXOL TABLET without informing your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About CAMIROFEN 10 TABLET

CAMIROFEN 10 TABLET contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking CAMIROFEN 10 TABLET inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

CAMIROFEN 10 TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with CAMIROFEN 10 TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

CAMIROFEN 10 TABLET may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking CAMIROFEN 10 TABLET are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking CAMIROFEN 10 TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CAMIROFEN 10 TABLET
Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How CAMIROFEN 10 TABLET Works

CAMIROFEN 10 TABLET is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use CAMIROFEN 10 TABLET

Take CAMIROFEN 10 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking CAMIROFEN 10 TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

TIZAN 2MG TABLET contains Tizanidine which belongs to a group of medicines called Skeletal muscle relaxants. It is used to relieve the stiffness and restriction of muscles resulting from multiple sclerosis, injury or diseases of the spinal cord.

Multiple sclerosis is a disease in which the immune system destroys the protective layer of nerves resulting in cramping, difficulty in walking, muscle paralysis, etc. Your doctor may want you to take several blood tests and liver function tests to understand your existing condition. Do not consume alcohol while taking this medicine.

TIZAN 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems, or rare hereditary problems of galactose intolerance, lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose galactose malabsorption. TIZAN 2MG TABLET should be used with caution in geriatric patients. The most common side effects of using this medicine are drowsiness, tiredness, dizziness, dry mouth. Consult your doctor if these side effects get more severe.

introduction:
Introduction About INFLAM MR TABLET

INFLAM MR TABLET is a combination of Chlorzoxazone, Diclofenac sodium and Paracetamol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants, Analgesics and Anti-pyrectics and Analgesics. It is used to manage painful muscle spasms associated with musculoskeletal conditions and provides effective relief from headaches, toothache, period pains, rheumatic pain, tendon pain, gout, soft tissue injuries, backache, arthritic pain, sprains, strains, frozen shoulder, muscle pain.

Avoid consuming alcohol while taking INFLAM MR TABLET as it may worsen your condition. INFLAM MR TABLET is not recommended for use by patients with nasal polyps, rhinitis, asthma precipitated by aspirin (aspirin-sensitive asthma) or other NSAIDs, severe liver, kidney or heart disease, a history of active gastric or intestinal ulcer, bleeding (blood in the stools, vomiting blood) or perforation. INFLAM MR TABLET should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing asthma, COPD, mild to the moderate liver or kidney disease or high blood pressure.

INFLAM MR TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy. INFLAM MR TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding mothers. INFLAM MR TABLET is not recommended for use by children. INFLAM MR TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhoea, indigestion, ulcers in the stomach or intestines, bleeding or perforation, heartburn, etc. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms get worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How INFLAM MR TABLET Works

INFLAM MR TABLET helps to manage pain, where Chlorzoxazone is a muscle relaxant, acts on the brain and spinal cord causing relaxation of muscles and relief of pain, while Diclofenac is an NSAID inhibits COX-1 and COX-2 and blocks the production of prostaglandins (which are responsible for pain) and Paracetamol is an Analgesic, increases the pain threshold by inhibiting COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes. Together, relieves pain effectively.

Have a history of active gastric or intestinal ulcer, bleeding (blood in stools, vomiting blood) or perforation or cerebrovascular bleeding
Have angioedema, urticaria
Have peripheral arterial disease
Have cerebrovascular disease (stroke), mini-stroke (TIA) or blockages of blood vessels in the brain
Have rare hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, severe lactase deficiency and glucose-galactose malabsorption
Have or undergoing coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery
Have ethanol intoxication
Have dehydration

Have hyperlipidaemia
Have diabetes mellitus

Have mixed connective tissue disorders
Have aseptic meningitis
Have angina

INFLAM MR TABLET is not recommended for use in children. Contact your doctor before taking it.

INFLAM MR TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking it.

Inform your physician, if you are using,

Barbiturates Ex. butobarbital (medicines used to manage insomnia)

Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs) Ex.  fluoxetine and sertraline (medicines used to manage depression)
Antidiabetics ex. metformin (medicines used to manage diabetes mellitus)
Mifepristone (medicines used for abortion)
Ciprofloxacin, chloramphenicol (medicines used for bacterial infections)
Colestipol and cholestyramine (medicines used to decrease high cholesterol levels)
Sulfinpyrazone (medicines used to manage gout)

Cardiac glycosides ex. digoxin (medicines used for heart failure)

Imatinib (medicines used to manage cancer)
Magnesium-containing antacids (medicines used to manage heartburn)
Ibuprofen (medicines used to manage pain)
Amiodarone (medicines used to manage heart rhythm disorders)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took too much of this medicine, consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdose are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, anorexia, epigastric pain or abdominal pain, drowsiness, dizziness, light-headedness, malaise or sluggishness, followed by marked loss of muscle tone making voluntary movement impossible and decrease in deep tendon reflexes, pallor, gastrointestinal bleeding, confusion, disorientation, excitation, tinnitus, fainting or convulsions, hypertension, acute renal failure (with acute tubular necrosis, characterised by loin pain, haematuria and proteinuria) and liver damage. Abnormalities of glucose metabolism, metabolic acidosis, cardiac arrhythmias, pancreatitis and anaphylactic reactions may occur. In severe cases, hepatic failure may progress to encephalopathy, haemorrhage, hypoglycaemia, cerebral oedema, respiratory depression, low blood pressure, coma and death.

MOBIZOX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe congestive heart failure, ischemic heart disease (heart attack), blockages of blood vessels to the heart and should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure and mild to moderate heart failure. Contact your doctor before taking it.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took too much of this medicine, consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdose are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, anorexia, epigastric pain or abdominal pain, drowsiness, dizziness, light-headedness, malaise or sluggishness, followed by marked loss of muscle tone making voluntary movement impossible and decrease in deep tendon reflexes, pallor, gastrointestinal bleeding, confusion, disorientation, excitation, tinnitus, fainting or convulsions, hypertension, acute renal failure (with acute tubular necrosis, characterised by loin pain, haematuria and proteinuria) and liver damage. Abnormalities of glucose metabolism, metabolic acidosis, cardiac arrhythmias, pancreatitis and anaphylactic reactions may occur. In severe cases, hepatic failure may progress to encephalopathy, haemorrhage, hypoglycaemia, cerebral oedema, respiratory depression, low blood pressure, coma, and death.

name: Dolostat MR Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About DOLOSTAT MR TABLET

DOLOSTAT MR TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac, Chlorzoxazone and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Muscle relaxants respectively. It is used to manage muscular pains and spasms. It can also be used to provide relief from joint pain (Ex. osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis) and back pain (Ex. ankylosing spondylitis).

Take DOLOSTAT MR TABLET preferably with meals to avoid gut irritation. Avoid consumption of alcohol as it could aggravate the risk of stomach problems. Do not take DOLOSTAT MR TABLET if you have any ulcers, bleeding or perforations in the gut.

Before taking DOLOSTAT MR TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, high blood cholesterol, any inflammation in the bowel or intestines, blood clots, bleeding problems or a previous history of stomach ulcers as a precaution.

DOLOSTAT MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver failure or stroke. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of taking DOLOSTAT MR TABLET are nausea, vomiting, indigestion, heartburn and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOLOSTAT MR TABLET

It is used to manage:

Muscle pain and spasms
Joint pain and back pain
mechanismOfAction:
How DOLOSTAT MR TABLET Works

DOLOSTAT MR TABLET contains three medicines namely Chlorzoxazone, Aceclofenac and paracetamol. Chlorzoxazone is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the brain and in spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.

Aceclofenac and paracetamol are analgesic agents. They provide pain relief by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, inflammation and swelling. Collectively, these action helps in reducing muscle spasms, joint pain and inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use DOLOSTAT MR TABLET

Take DOLOSTAT MR TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with meals to avoid gastric irritation.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MYORIL 8MG CAPSULE

MYORIL 8MG CAPSULEcontains Thiocolchicoside, which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used in adults and adolescents over 16 years of age to manage painful muscle contractions and for acute painful conditions related to the spine. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of your muscles. They’re common, involuntary, and unpredictable. The symptoms may include swelling, pain, stiffness, tenderness, and fatigue.

Your doctor may advise you to take relevant tests to understand your condition. Before taking MYORIL 8MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have flaccid paralysis (sagging of the face), muscular hypotonia (weak muscles), diarrhoea, lactose intolerance, seizure, or epilepsy.

MYORIL 8MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. MYORIL 8MG CAPSULE should not be used by children or adolescents under the age of 16. The most common side effects of taking MYORIL 8MG CAPSULE are skin allergic reactions, drowsiness, diarrhea, and gastric symptoms. Consult your doctor if your symptoms get worse or persist.

How MYORIL 8MG CAPSULE Works

MYORIL 8MG CAPSULE works through selective binding to the GABA-A receptor (neurotransmitter). It manages muscle contractions by activating the GABA-inhibitory motor pathway and inhibiting the glycine receptors (neurotransmitters). Thus, relaxing the muscle pain and spasms.

Introduction About ZORIFEN CAPSULE

ZORIFEN CAPSULE contains Cyclobenzaprine which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to relax muscles, relieve pain and discomfort caused by strains, sprains, and other muscle injuries.

Before taking ZORIFEN CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have diseases such as fits, an overactive thyroid gland, glaucoma (increased pressure inside the eyes), and urinary retention (difficulty passing urine) to avoid getting unwanted side effects.

ZORIFEN CAPSULE should be taken with caution in patients with liver and kidney diseases. ZORIFEN CAPSULE is not recommended for patients with heart diseases. ZORIFEN CAPSULE is not recommended to be taken during pregnancy unless necessary due to the lack of safety data. ZORIFEN CAPSULE should be used with caution by breastfeeding mothers.

The most common side effects of taking ZORIFEN CAPSULE may include dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, stomach pain, nausea, diarrhoea, vomiting, headache, dry mouth, confusion, mood changes, and an irregular heartbeat. Consult a doctor if any of these symptoms get worse for you while taking this medicine.
uses: Relieve pain and discomfort caused by sprains, strains, and other muscle injuries

mechanismOfAction:
How ZORIFEN CAPSULE Works

ZORIFEN CAPSULE contains Cyclobenzaprine which is a muscle relaxant that works by relieving skeletal muscle spasms without interfering with muscle function. It helps to reduce the hyperactivity of skeletal muscles. ZORIFEN CAPSULE works on the central nervous system (centres in the brain and spinal cord) to relieve muscle spasms, reduce local pain and tenderness and increase the range of motion in acute, painful musculoskeletal conditions.

introduction:
Introduction About TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET

TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET contains Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle Relaxants. It is used to relieve painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of the muscles. Symptoms include muscular weakness, tingling or prickling sensation, pain or discomfort.

TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver or kidney impairment, galactose intolerance, the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption and myasthenia gravis. TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney impairment.

TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age) and in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET are muscle weakness, headache, nausea, indigestion and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
usesDetails:
Uses Of TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET
Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
mechanismOfAction:
How TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET Works

TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET works by blocking the voltage-gated sodium channel in the brain stem thereby causing muscle relaxation and stopping the pain signals between nerve and brain. It also relieves pain by increasing the blood supply to skeletal muscles.
usageDetails:
How to use TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET

Take TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with plenty of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.
sideEffects: Hypersensitivity reactions (signs include rash, redness of the skin, itching, shortness of breath, swelling underneath the skin, increased heart rate or low blood pressure)

warnings.details: TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET.
TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET.

TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET may cause dizziness, sleepiness, attention disturbance, muscle weakness, fits or blurred vision after taking TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET. If you experience any such side effects consult your doctor for advice.

TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and kidney function in patients with moderate kidney impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET.

TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with liver impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and the dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and liver function in patients with moderate liver impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET.

TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Tolperisone or any other ingredients of this medicine. It should be used with caution in patients who are allergic to lidocaine (due to cross-reactions).

Others

TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Galactose intolerance
The Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption
Myasthenia gravis

Use in pediatrics:

TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age). Your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon age and body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

The dose of the TOLPERITAS SR 450MG TABLET should be adjusted in the elderly. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Introduction About MEFKIND DS SUSPENSION

MEFKIND DS SUSPENSION is a combination of Mefenamic acid and Paracetamol, which belongs to a group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) and Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is indicated for the management of fever in children. It is also used for the management of mild to moderate pain such as headache, toothache, joint or muscle pain, and period pain.

MEFKIND DS SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in patients with asthma or aspirin-sensitive asthma, severe liver, kidney, or heart disease. Contact your doctor before taking.

MEFKIND DS SUSPENSION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. Contact your doctor before taking.

MEFKIND DS SUSPENSION is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

MEFKIND DS SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in children under 6 months of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

MEFKIND DS SUSPENSION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are skin rash, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, constipation, indigestion, flatulence, anorexia, dry mouth, heartburn, peptic ulcers, perforation or GI bleeding, and ulcerative stomatitis. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Introduction About LIOFEN 10MG TABLET

Liofen 10mg Tablet is an effective muscle relaxant that supports improved muscle flexibility and helps relieve muscle spasticity symptoms such as stiffness, spasms, and discomfort. It is commonly recommended for individuals experiencing neurological conditions such as spinal cord injury, multiple sclerosis, and other nerve-related disorders to enhance mobility and comfort.

Liofen 10mg Tablet can be taken with or without food. It is recommended to use the lowest effective dose for the shortest duration necessary to manage your symptoms. For optimal results, take this medicine consistently as prescribed and avoid missing doses, as irregular use may reduce its effectiveness.

Common side effects of Liofen 10mg Tablet may include fatigue, weakness, drowsiness, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, tiredness, sleepiness, weak limbs, muscle pain, constipation, diarrhoea, dry mouth, nightmares, confusion, hallucination, breathing difficulties, vision problems, urge to pass urine (urinary frequency or retention), feeling unsteady or shaky, feeling faint due to low blood pressure (hypotension), skin rash, sweating and increased liver enzymes (requires monitoring). If these symptoms persist or worsen, it is important to consult your doctor. Your healthcare provider can recommend strategies to helps to reduce or minimize these side effects for your comfort and safety.

Before taking Liofen 10mg Tablet, inform your doctor about any existing medical conditions or health concerns. Additionally, disclose all other medications or supplements you are currently taking. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should seek medical advice before using this medicine to ensure safety for both mother and baby.
