mechanismOfAction:
How LIOFEN 10MG TABLET Works

Liofen 10mg Tablet is a muscle relaxant that works by acting on the brain and spinal cord to relieve muscle stiffness and spasms. It helps relax tight muscles, reduce pain, and improve muscle movement for better daily functioning.

Mechanism of Action: Liofen 10mg Tablet

Liofen contains Baclofen, which targets the GABA-B receptors in the central nervous system. By activating these receptors, it reduces excessive nerve signaling that causes muscle spasms, leading to improved muscle relaxation.

Baclofen and GABA-B Receptor Activation

Baclofen acts as an agonist at GABA-B receptors in the spinal cord and brain. This activation inhibits the release of excitatory neurotransmitters while stimulating inhibitory signals, resulting in the reduction of muscle spasticity and increased comfort.

Role of Liofen 10mg Tablet in Muscle Relaxation

Liofen helps ease muscle rigidity and spasticity by blocking overactive nerve impulses that cause muscle tightness. This results in smoother muscle function and enhanced coordination.

Neurotransmitter Modulation by Liofen 10mg Tablet

The medicine modulates neurotransmitters by decreasing excitatory signals and enhancing inhibitory nerve activity. This balance restores muscle control and reduces spasm frequency and severity.

Understanding Nerve Signal Inhibition

Liofen inhibits nerve activity involved in muscle contraction reflexes at the spinal level, calming hyperactive muscles and supporting better mobility and pain relief.
usageDetails:
How to use LIOFEN 10MG TABLET

Take Liofen 10mg Tablet exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water. It can be taken with or without food. Do not crush, chew, or break the tablet. Maintain a consistent dosing schedule for best results.

Dosage Guidance for Liofen 10mg Tablet

The usual starting dose for adults is 5mg three times a day, which your doctor may gradually increase based on your response and tolerance. The maximum recommended dose is typically 80mg per day. Dosage for children should be determined by a healthcare professional.

How to Administer Liofen 10mg Tablet

Take the tablet at the same time every day to maintain an even level in your system. Follow your doctor’s instructions closely. If you are using the medicine for long-term therapy, regular follow-ups are important to monitor its effectiveness and adjust dosage if needed.

Tips for Safe Administration and Storage

Store Liofen 10mg Tablet at room temperature, away from moisture and heat. Keep it out of reach of children and pets. Avoid alcohol while taking this medicine as it may increase drowsiness and dizziness. Consult your doctor before making any changes to your medication routine.

Dosage Titration and Adjustment

Your doctor may start you on a low dose and gradually increase it to find the smallest effective dose that controls your symptoms with minimal side effects. Dose adjustments may be necessary for people with kidney or liver problems.

Advice for Missed Dose and Overdose

If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember unless it is almost time for the next dose. Do not double the dose to catch up. In case of overdose, seek immediate medical attention, as symptoms may include severe drowsiness, weakness, or difficulty breathing.

What should be expected when using Liofen, and how can it be effectively integrated with other therapies or lifestyle changes?

Aspect

	

What to Expect

	

Integration with Other Therapies/Lifestyle Changes




Effectiveness

	

Relieves muscle stiffness, spasms, and discomfort; improves flexibility and mobility.

	

Use alongside physiotherapy and regular exercise for best results.




Onset of Action

	

Starts working within a few hours; full effect may take several days.

	

Maintain a consistent dosing schedule for steady symptom control.




Common Side Effects

	

Drowsiness, dizziness, weakness, nausea, dry mouth.

	

Avoid driving or operating machinery if drowsy; stay hydrated.




Serious Side Effects

	

Confusion, breathing difficulties, severe muscle weakness (rare).

	

Report any severe symptoms to your doctor immediately.




Dosage

	

Typically started at a low dose, gradually increased as needed.

	

Follow doctor's prescription strictly; do not self-adjust dosage.




Alcohol Interaction

	

Alcohol may increase drowsiness and dizziness.

	

Avoid alcohol while on Liofen to minimize side effects.




Kidney/Liver Precautions

	

Use with caution if you have kidney or liver issues.

	

Regular medical checkups and lab tests recommended.




Lifestyle Tips

	

May cause fatigue or dizziness initially.

	

Incorporate rest periods; avoid sudden posture changes to reduce falls.




Medication Adherence

	

Skipping doses reduces effectiveness.

	

Set reminders to take medicine consistently; don’t stop abruptly.




Combination Therapy

	

Safe to use with other prescribed medications with medical supervision.

	

Inform doctors of all medications to avoid interactions.

introduction:
Introduction About THIOQUEST ET 4MG TABLET

THIOQUEST ET 4MG TABLET is a combination of Etoricoxib and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) and Muscle relaxants. It is used to reduce pain and swelling in the joints and muscles in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, gout and muscle spasm. This medicine is also used for the short-term management after dental surgery for moderate pain. Muscle spasm is the rapid spontaneous contractions of the muscle, which can be painful and uncomfortable. When the nerve impulses are damaged or interrupted that control muscle movement, it could lead to muscle spasms. Symptoms include muscle tightness, joint stiffness, unusual posture, difficulty in moving and pain in affected muscles and joints.

THIOQUEST ET 4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having inflammatory bowel disease, severe congestive heart failure, peptic ulcer or cerebrovascular disease. Consult your doctor for advice. Before taking THIOQUEST ET 4MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have blood disorders, kidney problems, liver problems or heart problems.

THIOQUEST ET 4MG TABLET is not recommended to use among pregnant and breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of this medicine are stomach pain, dry socket, edema, dizziness, headache, palpitations, arrhythmia, constipation, diarrhea, indigestion, gastritis, nausea and vomiting. Consult your doctor if the above side effects worsens or persist for a longer duration.

introduction:
Introduction About TOLKEM 150MG TABLET

TOLKEM 150MG TABLET contains Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle Relaxants. It is used to relieve painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of the muscles. Symptoms include muscular weakness, tingling or prickling sensation, pain or discomfort.

TOLKEM 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver or kidney impairment, galactose intolerance, the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption and myasthenia gravis. TOLKEM 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney impairment.

TOLKEM 150MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. TOLKEM 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age) and in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking TOLKEM 150MG TABLET are muscle weakness, headache, nausea, indigestion and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
usesDetails:
Uses Of TOLKEM 150MG TABLET
Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
mechanismOfAction:
How TOLKEM 150MG TABLET Works

TOLKEM 150MG TABLET works by blocking the voltage-gated sodium channel in the brain stem thereby causing muscle relaxation and stopping the pain signals between nerve and brain. It also relieves pain by increasing the blood supply to skeletal muscles.
usageDetails:
How to use TOLKEM 150MG TABLET

Take TOLKEM 150MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with plenty of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking TOLKEM 150MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

TOLKEM 150MG TABLET may cause dizziness, sleepiness, attention disturbance, muscle weakness, fits or blurred vision after taking TOLKEM 150MG TABLET. If you experience any such side effects consult your doctor for advice.

TOLKEM 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TOLKEM 150MG TABLET.

TOLKEM 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Tolperisone or any other ingredients of this medicine. It should be used with caution in patients who are allergic to lidocaine (due to cross-reactions).

TOLKEM 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age). Your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon age and body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The dose of the TOLKEM 150MG TABLET should be adjusted in the elderly. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About NUFLAM TH CAPSULE

NUFLAM TH CAPSULE is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

NUFLAM TH CAPSULE is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, NUFLAM TH CAPSULE relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking NUFLAM TH CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take NUFLAM TH CAPSULE if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking NUFLAM TH CAPSULE if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take NUFLAM TH CAPSULE only as advised by your doctor. Do not take NUFLAM TH CAPSULE longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with NUFLAM TH CAPSULE to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking NUFLAM TH CAPSULE are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About CIP ZOX TABLET

CIP ZOX TABLET is a combination of Chlorzoxazone, Diclofenac sodium and Paracetamol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants, Analgesics and Anti-pyrectics and Analgesics. It is used to manage painful muscle spasms associated with musculoskeletal conditions and provides effective relief from headaches, toothache, period pains, rheumatic pain, tendon pain, gout, soft tissue injuries, backache, arthritic pain, sprains, strains, frozen shoulder, muscle pain.

Avoid consuming alcohol while taking CIP ZOX TABLET as it may worsen your condition. CIP ZOX TABLET is not recommended for use by patients with nasal polyps, rhinitis, asthma precipitated by aspirin (aspirin-sensitive asthma) or other NSAIDs, severe liver, kidney or heart disease, history of active gastric or intestinal ulcer, bleeding (blood in stools, vomiting blood) or perforation. CIP ZOX TABLET should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing asthma, COPD, mild to moderate liver or kidney disease and high blood pressure.

CIP ZOX TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy. CIP ZOX TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding mothers. CIP ZOX TABLET is not recommended for use by children. CIP ZOX TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhoea, indigestion, ulcers in the stomach or intestines, bleeding/perforation, heartburn etc. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms get worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How CIP ZOX TABLET Works

CIP ZOX TABLET helps to manage pain, where Chlorzoxazone is a muscle relaxant, acts on the brain and spinal cord causing relaxation of muscles and relief of pain, while Diclofenac is an NSAID inhibits COX-1 and COX-2 and blocks the production of prostaglandins (which are responsible for pain) and Paracetamol is an Analgesic, increases the pain threshold by inhibiting COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes. Together, relieves pain effectively.

Take this medicine as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine.

Have rare hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, severe lactase deficiency and glucose-galactose malabsorption
Have or undergoing coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery
Have ethanol intoxication
Have dehydration

Have hyperlipidaemia
Have diabetes mellitus

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took too much of this medicine, consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdose are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, anorexia, epigastric pain or abdominal pain, drowsiness, dizziness, light-headedness, malaise or sluggishness, followed by marked loss of muscle tone making voluntary movement impossible and decrease in deep tendon reflexes, pallor, gastrointestinal bleeding, confusion, disorientation, excitation, tinnitus, fainting or convulsions, hypertension, acute renal failure (with acute tubular necrosis, characterised by loin pain, haematuria and proteinuria) and liver damage. Abnormalities of glucose metabolism, metabolic acidosis, cardiac arrhythmias, pancreatitis and anaphylactic reactions may occur. In severe cases, hepatic failure may progress to encephalopathy, haemorrhage, hypoglycaemia, cerebral oedema, respiratory depression, low blood pressure, coma, and death.

introduction:
Introduction About TIZAVIN 4MG TABLET

TIZAVIN 4MG TABLET contains Tizanidine which belongs to a group of medicines called Skeletal muscle relaxants. It is used to relieve the stiffness and restriction of muscles resulting from multiple sclerosis, injury or diseases of the spinal cord.

Multiple sclerosis is a disease in which the immune system destroys the protective layer of nerves resulting in cramping, difficulty in walking, muscle paralysis, etc. Your doctor may want you to take several blood tests and liver function tests to understand your existing condition. Do not consume alcohol while taking this medicine.

TIZAVIN 4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems, or rare hereditary problems of galactose intolerance, lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose galactose malabsorption. Before using TIZAVIN 4MG TABLET consult your doctor if you have any kidney, liver, heart disease (like coronary artery disease), or intolerance to any sugars.

TIZAVIN 4MG TABLET is not recommended in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. TIZAVIN 4MG TABLET should be used with caution in geriatric patients. The most common side effects of using this medicine are drowsiness, tiredness, dizziness, dry mouth. Consult your doctor if these side effects get more severe.

introduction:
Introduction About ACECLO MR TABLET

ACECLO MR TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac, Chlorzoxazone and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Muscle relaxants respectively. It is used to manage muscular pains and spasms. It can also be used to provide relief from joint pain (Ex. osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis) and back pain (Ex. ankylosing spondylitis).

Take ACECLO MR TABLET preferably with meals to avoid gut irritation. Avoid consumption of alcohol as it could aggravate the risk of stomach problems. Do not take ACECLO MR TABLET if you have any ulcers, bleeding or perforations in the gut.

Before taking ACECLO MR TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, high blood cholesterol, any inflammation in the bowel or intestines, blood clots, bleeding problems or a previous history of stomach ulcers as a precaution.

ACECLO MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver failure or stroke. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of taking ACECLO MR TABLET are nausea, vomiting, indigestion, heartburn and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ACECLO MR TABLET

It is used to manage:

Muscle pain and spasms
Joint pain and back pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ACECLO MR TABLET Works

ACECLO MR TABLET contains three medicines namely Chlorzoxazone, Aceclofenac and paracetamol. Chlorzoxazone is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the brain and in spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.

Aceclofenac and paracetamol are analgesic agents. They provide pain relief by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, inflammation and swelling. Collectively, these action helps in reducing muscle spasms, joint pain and inflammation.
usageDetails:

Take ACECLO MR TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with meals to avoid gastric irritation.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About FLEXABENZ PLUS TABLET

FLEXABENZ PLUS TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac and Cyclobenzaprine which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) and Skeletal muscle relaxants respectively. It is used to relieve muscle spasm associated with acute, painful musculoskeletal conditions such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis and ankylosing spondylitis (inflammation of the spine).

Osteoarthritis is defined as a progressive disorder affecting primarily weight-bearing joints, characterized by progressive worsening and loss of cartilage that join bones, pain, motion restriction, deformity and disability.

Rheumatoid arthritis is a long-term, progressive inflammatory disorder of unknown cause characterized by polyarticular (five or more joints) joint involvement and systemic symptoms like tiredness, weakness, fever, loss of appetite and joint pain.

Before taking FLEXABENZ PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any severe kidney, heart, liver or thyroid problems or if you have stomach ulcers or bleeding problems.

FLEXABENZ PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy. FLEXABENZ PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women unless specifically directed by your doctor.

FLEXABENZ PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children. The most common side effects of taking FLEXABENZ PLUS TABLET are nausea and dizziness. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About LIOFEN LIQUID

LIOFEN LIQUID contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking LIOFEN LIQUID inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

LIOFEN LIQUID should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with LIOFEN LIQUID, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

LIOFEN LIQUID may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, restrict yourself from engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel more drowsy.

The most common side effects of taking LIOFEN LIQUID are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking LIOFEN LIQUID.

mechanismOfAction:
How LIOFEN LIQUID Works

LIOFEN LIQUID is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use LIOFEN LIQUID

Take LIOFEN LIQUID as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking LIOFEN LIQUID without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

Introduction About ROBINAX 500MG TABLET

ROBINAX 500MG TABLET contains Methocarbamol which belongs to a group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used for the short-term management of pain and muscle spasm caused by injuries such as sprains and strains.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine. ROBINAX 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have ever suffered any brain damage or coma, epilepsy/convulsions or muscle weakness (a disease called myasthenia gravis).

Before taking ROBINAX 500MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney problems or taking any medical tests. ROBINAX 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children below 16 years of age.

ROBINAX 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of ROBINAX 500MG TABLET are drowsiness, dizziness, headache, fever, nausea, vomiting, blurred or double vision. Consult your doctor if symptoms do not improve.

name: Tolmex 150mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TOLMEX 150MG TABLET

TOLMEX 150MG TABLET contains Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle Relaxants. It is used to relieve painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of the muscles. Symptoms include muscular weakness, tingling or prickling sensation, pain or discomfort.

TOLMEX 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver or kidney impairment, galactose intolerance, the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption and myasthenia gravis. TOLMEX 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney impairment.

TOLMEX 150MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. TOLMEX 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age) and in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking TOLMEX 150MG TABLET are muscle weakness, headache, nausea, indigestion and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
usesDetails:
Uses Of TOLMEX 150MG TABLET
Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
mechanismOfAction:
How TOLMEX 150MG TABLET Works

TOLMEX 150MG TABLET works by blocking the voltage-gated sodium channel in the brain stem thereby causing muscle relaxation and stopping the pain signals between nerve and brain. It also relieves pain by increasing the blood supply to skeletal muscles.
usageDetails:
How to use TOLMEX 150MG TABLET

Take TOLMEX 150MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with plenty of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking TOLMEX 150MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.
sideEffects: Hypersensitivity reactions (signs include rash, redness of the skin, itching, shortness of breath, swelling underneath the skin, increased heart rate or low blood pressure)

Hypersensitivity reactions (signs include rash, redness of the skin, itching, shortness of breath, swelling underneath the skin, increased heart rate or low blood pressure)

warnings.details: TOLMEX 150MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking TOLMEX 150MG TABLET.
TOLMEX 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking TOLMEX 150MG TABLET.

TOLMEX 150MG TABLET may cause dizziness, sleepiness, attention disturbance, muscle weakness, fits or blurred vision after taking TOLMEX 150MG TABLET. If you experience any such side effects consult your doctor for advice.

TOLMEX 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and kidney function in patients with moderate kidney impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TOLMEX 150MG TABLET.

TOLMEX 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with liver impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and the dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and liver function in patients with moderate liver impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TOLMEX 150MG TABLET.

TOLMEX 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Tolperisone or any other ingredients of this medicine. It should be used with caution in patients who are allergic to lidocaine (due to cross-reactions).

Others

TOLMEX 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Galactose intolerance
The Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption
Myasthenia gravis

Use in pediatrics:

TOLMEX 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age). Your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon age and body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

The dose of the TOLMEX 150MG TABLET should be adjusted in the elderly. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About NUCOXIA MR 8MG TABLET

NUCOXIA MR 8MG TABLET is a combination of Etoricoxib and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) and Muscle relaxants. It is used to reduce pain and swelling in the joints and muscles in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, gout and muscle spasm. This medicine is also used for the short-term management after dental surgery for moderate pain. Muscle spasm is the rapid spontaneous contractions of the muscle, which can be painful and uncomfortable. When the nerve impulses are damaged or interrupted that control muscle movement, it could lead to muscle spasms. Symptoms include muscle tightness, joint stiffness, unusual posture, difficulty in moving and pain in affected muscles and joints.

NUCOXIA MR 8MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having inflammatory bowel disease, severe congestive heart failure, peptic ulcer or cerebrovascular disease. Consult your doctor for advice. Before taking NUCOXIA MR 8MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have blood disorders, kidney problems, liver problems or heart problems.

NUCOXIA MR 8MG TABLET is not recommended to use among pregnant and breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of this medicine are stomach pain, dry socket, edema, dizziness, headache, palpitations, arrhythmia, constipation, diarrhea, indigestion, gastritis, nausea and vomiting. Consult your doctor if the above side effects worsens or persist for a longer duration.

name: Tolax 150mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TOLAX 150MG TABLET

TOLAX 150MG TABLET contains Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle Relaxants. It is used to relieve painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of the muscles. Symptoms include muscular weakness, tingling or prickling sensation, pain or discomfort.

TOLAX 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver or kidney impairment, galactose intolerance, the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption and myasthenia gravis. TOLAX 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney impairment.

TOLAX 150MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. TOLAX 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age) and in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking TOLAX 150MG TABLET are muscle weakness, headache, nausea, indigestion and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
usesDetails:
Uses Of TOLAX 150MG TABLET
Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
mechanismOfAction:
How TOLAX 150MG TABLET Works

TOLAX 150MG TABLET works by blocking the voltage-gated sodium channel in the brain stem thereby causing muscle relaxation and stopping the pain signals between nerve and brain. It also relieves pain by increasing the blood supply to skeletal muscles.
usageDetails:
How to use TOLAX 150MG TABLET

Take TOLAX 150MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with plenty of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking TOLAX 150MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

warnings.details: TOLAX 150MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking TOLAX 150MG TABLET.
TOLAX 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking TOLAX 150MG TABLET.

TOLAX 150MG TABLET may cause dizziness, sleepiness, attention disturbance, muscle weakness, fits or blurred vision after taking TOLAX 150MG TABLET. If you experience any such side effects consult your doctor for advice.

TOLAX 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and kidney function in patients with moderate kidney impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TOLAX 150MG TABLET.

TOLAX 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with liver impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and the dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and liver function in patients with moderate liver impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TOLAX 150MG TABLET.

TOLAX 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Tolperisone or any other ingredients of this medicine. It should be used with caution in patients who are allergic to lidocaine (due to cross-reactions).

Others

TOLAX 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Galactose intolerance
The Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption
Myasthenia gravis

Use in pediatrics:

TOLAX 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age). Your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon age and body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

The dose of the TOLAX 150MG TABLET should be adjusted in the elderly. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About THIOFORD AP TABLET

THIOFORD AP TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs and Muscle relaxants. THIOFORD AP TABLET is used in adults for the management of acute inflammatory and painful conditions associated with muscle spasms, such as lower back pain, muscle spasm due to any injury, neck and shoulder pain, sciatica (type of nerve pain), degenerative vertebral disorders, ankylosing spondylitis (chronic back pain due to fusion of some bones of the spine), osteoarthritis, and rheumatoid arthritis.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking THIOFORD AP TABLET. THIOFORD AP TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from stomach ulcers, intestinal bleeding or have a history of stomach ulcers, severe kidney problems, liver failure, bleeding disorders, peripheral arterial disease (problem with blood circulation), heart problems such as heart attack, stroke, blockages in blood vessels of brain or heart or had a history of heart surgery for clearing blockages, rare hereditary problems of galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption, therefore consult your doctor before taking.

THIOFORD AP TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver and kidney problems, seizures, stomach and bowel disorders, asthma or breathing problems, blood disorders (porphyria), recovering from major surgery, and alcohol dependence. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

THIOFORD AP TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women; therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. THIOFORD AP TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 16 years of age. THIOFORD AP TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (>65 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects after taking THIOFORD AP TABLET are dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea, drowsiness, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any side effects or an allergic reaction after taking this medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About ALONAC TC TABLET

ALONAC TC TABLET is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

ALONAC TC TABLET is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, ALONAC TC TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking ALONAC TC TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take ALONAC TC TABLET if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking ALONAC TC TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take ALONAC TC TABLET only as advised by your doctor. Do not take ALONAC TC TABLET longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with ALONAC TC TABLET to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking ALONAC TC TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Introduction About TOLEXANT D TABLET

TOLEXANT D TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac and Tolperisone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Skeletal Muscle relaxants respectively. It is used in adults to manage painful muscle spasms.

It can also be used to manage back pain (Ex. ankylosing spondylitis), joint pain and swelling (Ex. osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis), neck pain, sports injuries and sprains.

Take TOLEXANT D TABLET with or just after meals. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with TOLEXANT D TABLET to achieve better results. Before taking TOLEXANT D TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your lung, liver, kidney, heart or stomach.

You much also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, asthma or COPD, bleeding disorders or any allergic conditions (such as skin rash, itching or watery eyes, repeated sneezing, nasal congestion and nasal itching) as a precaution.

TOLEXANT D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe bleeding, perforation or ulcers in the stomach or intestines. Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of taking TOLEXANT D TABLET dizziness, headache, spinning sensation, nausea, vomiting, indigestion, stomach pain, heartburn, flatulence, loss of appetite, increased liver enzymes and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About ETOS MR TABLET

ETOS MR TABLET is a combination of Etoricoxib and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) and Muscle relaxants. It is used to reduce pain and swelling in the joints and muscles in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, gout and muscle spasm. This medicine is also used for the short-term management after dental surgery for moderate pain. Muscle spasm is the rapid spontaneous contractions of the muscle, which can be painful and uncomfortable. When the nerve impulses are damaged or interrupted that control muscle movement, it could lead to muscle spasms. Symptoms include muscle tightness, joint stiffness, unusual posture, difficulty in moving and pain in affected muscles and joints.

ETOS MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having inflammatory bowel disease, severe congestive heart failure, peptic ulcer or cerebrovascular disease. Consult your doctor for advice. Before taking ETOS MR TABLET, inform your doctor if you have blood disorders, kidney problems, liver problems or heart problems.

ETOS MR TABLET is not recommended to use among pregnant and breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of this medicine are stomach pain, dry socket, edema, dizziness, headache, palpitations, arrhythmia, constipation, diarrhea, indigestion, gastritis, nausea and vomiting. Consult your doctor if the above side effects worsens or persist for a longer duration.

name: MYOSPAS Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About MYOSPAS TABLET

MYOSPAS TABLET is a combination of Chlorzoxazone and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants and Analgesics respectively. It is used to manage muscular pains and spasms. It can also be used to provide relief from joint pain (Ex. osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis), back pain (Ex. ankylosing spondylitis) and neck pain.

Take MYOSPAS TABLET preferably with meals to avoid gut irritation. Avoid consumption of alcohol as it could aggravate the risk of stomach problems. Do not take MYOSPAS TABLET if you have any ulcers, bleeding or perforations in the gut.

Before taking MYOSPAS TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, alcoholism, any eating disorder or any disease that causes loss of skeletal muscles and fats (such as cachexia) as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before taking MYOSPAS TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The common side effects of taking MYOSPAS TABLET are stomach upset and orangish urine. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Joint pain, back pain, neck pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of MYOSPAS TABLET

It is used to manage:

Muscle pain and spasms
Joint pain, back pain, neck pain
mechanismOfAction:
How MYOSPAS TABLET Works

MYOSPAS TABLET contains two medicines namely Chlorzoxazone and paracetamol. Chlorzoxazone is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the brain and in spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.

Paracetamol is a pain-relieving agent. It provides pain relief by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, inflammation and swelling. Collectively, these action helps in reducing muscle spasms, joint pain and inflammation.

introduction:
Introduction About MIOFREE ET 4 TABLET

MIOFREE ET 4 TABLET is a combination of Etoricoxib and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) and Muscle relaxants. It is used to reduce pain and swelling in the joints and muscles in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, gout and muscle spasm. This medicine is also used for the short-term management after dental surgery for moderate pain. Muscle spasm is the rapid spontaneous contractions of the muscle, which can be painful and uncomfortable. When the nerve impulses are damaged or interrupted that control muscle movement, it could lead to muscle spasms. Symptoms include muscle tightness, joint stiffness, unusual posture, difficulty in moving and pain in affected muscles and joints.

MIOFREE ET 4 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having inflammatory bowel disease, severe congestive heart failure, peptic ulcer or cerebrovascular disease. Consult your doctor for advice. Before taking MIOFREE ET 4 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have blood disorders, kidney problems, liver problems or heart problems.

MIOFREE ET 4 TABLET is not recommended to use among pregnant and breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of this medicine are stomach pain, dry socket, edema, dizziness, headache, palpitations, arrhythmia, constipation, diarrhea, indigestion, gastritis, nausea and vomiting. Consult your doctor if the above side effects worsens or persist for a longer duration.

Introduction About MYOTOP P TABLET

MYOTOP P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Muscle relaxants respectively. It is used for the management of patients with acute painful musculoskeletal conditions.

MYOTOP P TABLET is not recommended for use if you have myasthenia gravis. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

Before taking MYOTOP P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have peptic ulcer disease, gastrointestinal perforation, bleeding and anemia. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

MYOTOP P TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women (especially during first three months) and breastfeeding women, unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of taking MYOTOP P TABLET are muscle weakness, headache, low blood pressure, nausea, vomiting, dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage patients with acute painful musculoskeletal conditions

mechanismOfAction:
How MYOTOP P TABLET Works

MYOTOP P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tolperisone that works by blocking chemical messengers in the brain, which are responsible for inflammatory signs such as pain, increased temperature. Tolperisone works on the spinal cord and brain to relieve contraction or muscle stiffness without a decrease in strength and increases the blood supply to the muscles. These actions together provide relief from painful muscle spasm and spastic conditions.

THIOACT D 4MG CAPSULE is a combination of Diclofenac and Thiocolchicoside, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants respectively. It is used in adults to manage painful muscle spasms.

THIOACT D 4MG CAPSULE can also be used to manage back pain (Ex. ankylosing spondylitis), joint pain and swelling (Ex. osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis), neck pain, sports injuries and sprains.

Take THIOACT D 4MG CAPSULE with or just after meals. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with THIOACT D 4MG CAPSULE to achieve better results. Before taking THIOACT D 4MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart or stomach.

You much also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, bleeding or blood related problems, fits or allergic conditions (such as skin rash, itching or watery eyes, repeated sneezing, nasal congestion and nasal itching) as a precaution.

Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you have severe bleeding, perforation or ulcers in the stomach or intestines. THIOACT D 4MG CAPSULE is also not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of taking THIOACT D 4MG CAPSULE dizziness, headache, spinning sensation, nausea, vomiting, indigestion, stomach pain, flatulence, loss of appetite, increased liver enzymes and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How THIOACT D 4MG CAPSULE Works

THIOACT D 4MG CAPSULE contains two medicines namely diclofenac and thiocolchicoside. Diclofenac is a pain-relieving medication. It acts by blocking the production of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain and inflammation.

Thiocolchicoside is a muscle relaxant. It relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that causes muscle spasm. As a result, THIOACT D 4MG CAPSULE relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET

TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET contains Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle Relaxants. It is used to relieve painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of the muscles. Symptoms include muscular weakness, tingling or prickling sensation, pain or discomfort.

TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver or kidney impairment, galactose intolerance, the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption and myasthenia gravis. TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney impairment.

TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age) and in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET are muscle weakness, headache, nausea, indigestion and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
usesDetails:
Uses Of TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET
Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
mechanismOfAction:
How TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET Works

TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET works by blocking the voltage-gated sodium channel in the brain stem thereby causing muscle relaxation and stopping the pain signals between nerve and brain. It also relieves pain by increasing the blood supply to skeletal muscles.
usageDetails:
How to use TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET

Take TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with plenty of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

warnings.details: TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET.
TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET.

TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET may cause dizziness, sleepiness, attention disturbance, muscle weakness, fits or blurred vision after taking TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET. If you experience any such side effects consult your doctor for advice.

TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and kidney function in patients with moderate kidney impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET.

TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with liver impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and the dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and liver function in patients with moderate liver impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET.

TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Tolperisone or any other ingredients of this medicine. It should be used with caution in patients who are allergic to lidocaine (due to cross-reactions).

Others

TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Galactose intolerance
The Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption
Myasthenia gravis

Use in pediatrics:

TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age). Your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon age and body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

The dose of the TOLPERITAS 150MG TABLET should be adjusted in the elderly. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Introduction About FLEXURA D TABLET

FLEXURA D TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac and Metaxalone which belongs to the group of medicines called Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) and Muscle relaxants respectively. FLEXURA D TABLET is used to relieve pain, inflammation and swelling in conditions that affect the muscles. Also, it effectively relieves muscle stiffness or spasm, thereby improving muscle movement.

Before taking FLEXURA D TABLET inform your doctor if you have heart, liver or kidney disease and including other conditions such as diabetes, high blood pressure and high cholesterol levels.

Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctors before taking FLEXURA D TABLET. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age and not recommended for use in children.

The most common side effects of taking FLEXURA D TABLET are nausea, vomiting, upset stomach, drowsiness, headache and nervousness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Stop taking FLEXURA D TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Severe allergic reactions symptoms (such as swelling of the lips, tongue, throat, face or neck leading to severe difficulty in breathing, skin rash or spots, eczema, redness of the skin, scaly skin, bruise like rash, itching, very low blood pressure or shock and hives, peeling or blistering)
Passing blood in faeces (stools/motions)
Yellowing of the skin or whites of the eyes, blood problems, inflammation of liver, liver disorders
Myocardial infarction or heart attack symptoms such as sudden and crushing chest pain
Heart failure symptoms such as breathlessness, difficulty breathing when lying down, swelling of the feet or legs
Stroke symptoms such as sudden weakness or numbness in the face, arm or leg especially on one side of the body, sudden loss or disturbance of vision, sudden difficulty in speaking or ability to understand speech, sudden migraine like headache, with or without disturbed vision
Persistent sore throat or high temperature, infections
Unexpected change in the amount of urine produced or its appearance
Mild cramping and tenderness of the abdomen followed by rectal bleeding or bloody diarrhoea
Stevens- johnson syndrome (serious illnesses with blistering of the skin, mouth, eyes and genitals)
Kounis syndrome symptoms such as chest pain
Weak or shallow breathing
Confusion or weakness

Consumption of alcohol is not recommended during management with FLEXURA D TABLET because it may enhance the effects of alcohol and cause dangerous side effects.

FLEXURA D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease and should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking FLEXURA D TABLET.
FLEXURA D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease and should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking FLEXURA D TABLET.
Do not take FLEXURA D TABLET if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to Diclofenac or Metaxalone or aspirin or ibuprofen or any other NSAID such as naproxen and indomethacin.

It should be used with caution in patients with asthma, long-term lung disease or lung infection. Consult your doctor before taking FLEXURA D TABLET.

FLEXURA D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart attack, blockages to blood vessels of the heart and should be used with caution in patients with heart problems, angina and high blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking FLEXURA D TABLET.

Others

FLEXURA D TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

An itchy or runny nose
Peptic ulceration (ulcer in your stomach or duodenum)
Stomach or intestinal bleeding (black tarry stools or vomiting blood)
Cerebrovascular disease such as stroke, mini stroke (TIA)
Blockages to blood vessels to the brain or an operation to clear or bypass blockages
Peripheral arterial disease (problems with your blood circulation)

Before taking FLEXURA D TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Suffer from any stomach or bowel disorders such as ulcerative colitis, crohn's disease
Have condition called porphyria (symptoms such as discolouration of the urine, serious skin disorders, anaemia, abdominal pain and severe mental disorders)
Suffer from serious illness with blistering of the skin, mouth, eyes and genitals or connective tissue disorders such as lupus
Have skin rash, appearance of lesions
Suffer from nasal polyps
Are recovering from major surgery
Are a smoker
Suffer from diabetes
Blood clots, raised cholesterol or raised triglycerides
Are going to have surgery of the stomach or intestinal tract
Seasonal allergic rhinitis

Use in pediatrics:

FLEXURA D TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.  

 Use in geriatrics:

FLEXURA D TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above), usually initiating the management with the lowest effective dose. In elderly patients with stomach problems, doctor may prescribe another medicine to protect the stomach during management with this medicine. Consult your doctor before taking FLEXURA D TABLET.

Any other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) such as ibuprofen, aspirin, cyclooxygenase-2 selective inhibitors such as celecoxib (used for pain relief)

Immunosuppressive agents such as ciclosporin, tacrolimus (used to manage organ rejection after transplant)

introduction:
Introduction About TOLZEST P TABLET

TOLZEST P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Muscle relaxants respectively. It is used for the management of patients with acute painful musculoskeletal conditions.

TOLZEST P TABLET is not recommended for use if you have myasthenia gravis. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

Before taking TOLZEST P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have peptic ulcer disease, gastrointestinal perforation, bleeding and anemia. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

TOLZEST P TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women (especially during first three months) and breastfeeding women, unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of taking TOLZEST P TABLET are muscle weakness, headache, low blood pressure, nausea, vomiting, dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage patients with acute painful musculoskeletal conditions
usesDetails:
Uses Of TOLZEST P TABLET
Used to manage patients with acute painful musculoskeletal conditions
mechanismOfAction:
How TOLZEST P TABLET Works

TOLZEST P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tolperisone that works by blocking chemical messengers in the brain, which are responsible for inflammatory signs such as pain, increased temperature. Tolperisone works on the spinal cord and brain to relieve contraction or muscle stiffness without a decrease in strength and increases the blood supply to the muscles. These actions together provide relief from painful muscle spasm and spastic conditions.
usageDetails:
How to use TOLZEST P TABLET

Take TOLZEST P TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET

BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET
Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET Works

BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET

Take BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

introduction:
Introduction About GUDGESIC TH 8MG TABLET

GUDGESIC TH 8MG TABLET is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

GUDGESIC TH 8MG TABLET is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, GUDGESIC TH 8MG TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking GUDGESIC TH 8MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take GUDGESIC TH 8MG TABLET if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking GUDGESIC TH 8MG TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take GUDGESIC TH 8MG TABLET only as advised by your doctor. Do not take GUDGESIC TH 8MG TABLET longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with GUDGESIC TH 8MG TABLET to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking GUDGESIC TH 8MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About TRIACTIN 8MG TABLET

TRIACTIN 8MG TABLETcontains Thiocolchicoside, which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used in adults and adolescents over 16 years of age to manage painful muscle contractions and for acute painful conditions related to the spine. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of your muscles. They’re common, involuntary, and unpredictable. The symptoms may include swelling, pain, stiffness, tenderness, and fatigue.

Your doctor may advise you to take relevant tests to understand your condition. Before taking TRIACTIN 8MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have flaccid paralysis (sagging of the face), muscular hypotonia (weak muscles), diarrhoea, lactose intolerance, seizure, or epilepsy.

TRIACTIN 8MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. TRIACTIN 8MG TABLET should not be used by children or adolescents under the age of 16. The most common side effects of taking TRIACTIN 8MG TABLET are skin allergic reactions, drowsiness, diarrhea, and gastric symptoms. Consult your doctor if your symptoms get worse or persist.
uses: Acute painful conditions related to the spine
usesDetails:

Painful muscle contractions
Acute painful conditions related to the spine
mechanismOfAction:
How TRIACTIN 8MG TABLET Works

TRIACTIN 8MG TABLET works through selective binding to the GABA-A receptor (neurotransmitter). It manages muscle contractions by activating the GABA-inhibitory motor pathway and inhibiting the glycine receptors (neurotransmitters). Thus, relaxing the muscle pain and spasms.

Take TRIACTIN 8MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

SPASTONE RM NEW TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac and Drotaverine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics. It is used to manage dysmenorrhea (menstrual pain), abdominal pain and cramps.

Do not use SPASTONE RM NEW TABLET if you are allergic to other NSAIDs like ibuprofen or aspirin. Before taking SPASTONE RM NEW TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of stomach ulcer, have vomited blood, passed blood in faeces, have any kidney, heart, liver, bowel or blood clotting problems, porphyria, diabetes, chicken pox or if you have undergone any bypass surgery.

SPASTONE RM NEW TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by your doctor. SPASTONE RM NEW TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Avoid smoking while taking SPASTONE RM NEW TABLET. The most common side effects of taking SPASTONE RM NEW TABLET are dizziness, dry mouth, nausea, sleepiness, blurred vision and weakness. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen over time.

introduction:
Introduction About MYOSPAS TH 4MG CAPSULE

MYOSPAS TH 4MG CAPSULE is a combination of Diclofenac and Thiocolchicoside, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants respectively. It is used in adults to manage painful muscle spasms.

MYOSPAS TH 4MG CAPSULE can also be used to manage back pain (Ex. ankylosing spondylitis), joint pain and swelling (Ex. osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis), neck pain, sports injuries and sprains.

Take MYOSPAS TH 4MG CAPSULE with or just after meals. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with MYOSPAS TH 4MG CAPSULE to achieve better results. Before taking MYOSPAS TH 4MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart or stomach.

You much also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, bleeding or blood related problems, fits or allergic conditions (such as skin rash, itching or watery eyes, repeated sneezing, nasal congestion and nasal itching) as a precaution.

Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you have severe bleeding, perforation or ulcers in the stomach or intestines. MYOSPAS TH 4MG CAPSULE is also not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of taking MYOSPAS TH 4MG CAPSULE dizziness, headache, spinning sensation, nausea, vomiting, indigestion, stomach pain, flatulence, loss of appetite, increased liver enzymes and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Joint pain, back pain, neck pain
usesDetails:

Painful muscle spasms

mechanismOfAction:
How MYOSPAS TH 4MG CAPSULE Works

MYOSPAS TH 4MG CAPSULE contains two medicines namely diclofenac and thiocolchicoside. Diclofenac is a pain-relieving medication. It acts by blocking the production of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain and inflammation.

Thiocolchicoside is a muscle relaxant. It relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that causes muscle spasm. As a result, MYOSPAS TH 4MG CAPSULE relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.
usageDetails:
How to use MYOSPAS TH 4MG CAPSULE

Always take MYOSPAS TH 4MG CAPSULE as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. MYOSPAS TH 4MG CAPSULE should be taken with or after food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About THIOACT 4MG CAPSULE

THIOACT 4MG CAPSULEcontains Thiocolchicoside, which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used in adults and adolescents over 16 years of age to manage painful muscle contractions and for acute painful conditions related to the spine. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of your muscles. They’re common, involuntary, and unpredictable. The symptoms may include swelling, pain, stiffness, tenderness, and fatigue.

Your doctor may advise you to take relevant tests to understand your condition. Before taking THIOACT 4MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have flaccid paralysis (sagging of the face), muscular hypotonia (weak muscles), diarrhoea, lactose intolerance, seizure, or epilepsy.

THIOACT 4MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. THIOACT 4MG CAPSULE should not be used by children or adolescents under the age of 16. The most common side effects of taking THIOACT 4MG CAPSULE are skin allergic reactions, drowsiness, diarrhea, and gastric symptoms. Consult your doctor if your symptoms get worse or persist.
uses: Acute painful conditions related to the spine

mechanismOfAction:
How THIOACT 4MG CAPSULE Works

THIOACT 4MG CAPSULE works through selective binding to the GABA-A receptor (neurotransmitter). It manages muscle contractions by activating the GABA-inhibitory motor pathway and inhibiting the glycine receptors (neurotransmitters). Thus, relaxing the muscle pain and spasms.

introduction:
Introduction About THIOBLIS A 4MG TABLET

THIOBLIS A 4MG TABLET is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

THIOBLIS A 4MG TABLET is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, THIOBLIS A 4MG TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking THIOBLIS A 4MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take THIOBLIS A 4MG TABLET if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking THIOBLIS A 4MG TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take THIOBLIS A 4MG TABLET only as advised by your doctor. Do not take THIOBLIS A 4MG TABLET longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with THIOBLIS A 4MG TABLET to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking THIOBLIS A 4MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Collectively, THIOBLIS A 4MG TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

introduction:
Introduction About TOLEXANT 150 TABLET

TOLEXANT 150 TABLET contains Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle Relaxants. It is used to relieve painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of the muscles. Symptoms include muscular weakness, tingling or prickling sensation, pain or discomfort.

TOLEXANT 150 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver or kidney impairment, galactose intolerance, the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption and myasthenia gravis. TOLEXANT 150 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney impairment.

TOLEXANT 150 TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. TOLEXANT 150 TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age) and in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking TOLEXANT 150 TABLET are muscle weakness, headache, nausea, indigestion and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

How TOLEXANT 150 TABLET Works

TOLEXANT 150 TABLET works by blocking the voltage-gated sodium channel in the brain stem thereby causing muscle relaxation and stopping the pain signals between nerve and brain. It also relieves pain by increasing the blood supply to skeletal muscles.

name: Nedolide MR Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About NEDOLIDE MR TABLET

NEDOLIDE MR TABLET is a combination of Chlorzoxazone, Nimesulide and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants, Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) and Analgesic and Antipyretics respectively. NEDOLIDE MR TABLET is used to manage low back pain, muscle spasm or cramps and fibromyalgia.

Fibromyalgia is a condition that is characterized by widespread musculoskeletal pain associated by fatigue, sleep, memory and mood issues.

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with NEDOLIDE MR TABLET as it may increase the risk of liver damage. NEDOLIDE MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having active peptic ulcers, severe kidney problems and liver impairment.

Inform your doctor if you have any problems related to stomach, high blood pressure, active bleeding or bleeding disorders, heart disease or fluid retention. Before taking NEDOLIDE MR TABLET inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

NEDOLIDE MR TABLET is not recommended for use in children (aged 12 years and below). It should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking NEDOLIDE MR TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach upset and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen over the time.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NEDOLIDE MR TABLET

Manage:

Low back pain
Muscle spasm and cramping
Fibromyalgia
mechanismOfAction:
How NEDOLIDE MR TABLET Works

NEDOLIDE MR TABLET is a combination of chlorzoxazone, nimesulide and paracetamol. Chlorzoxazone is a muscle relaxant that works on the brain and spinal cord to relieve muscle stiffness or spasm and to improve pain and movement of muscles. Nimesulide is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) and paracetamol is an analgesic and antipyretic, which works together by inhibiting the production of a chemical called prostaglandins in the body which are responsible for causing pain and swelling at the site of injury.
usageDetails:
How to use NEDOLIDE MR TABLET

Take NEDOLIDE MR TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow NEDOLIDE MR TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking NEDOLIDE MR TABLET without informing your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About BACK 25MG TABLET

BACK 25MG TABLET contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking BACK 25MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

BACK 25MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with BACK 25MG TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

BACK 25MG TABLET may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking BACK 25MG TABLET are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking BACK 25MG TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BACK 25MG TABLET
Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How BACK 25MG TABLET Works

BACK 25MG TABLET is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use BACK 25MG TABLET

Take BACK 25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking BACK 25MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).
