Introduction About TOPERIZONE 150MG TABLET

TOPERIZONE 150MG TABLET contains Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle Relaxants. It is used to relieve painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of the muscles. Symptoms include muscular weakness, tingling or prickling sensation, pain or discomfort.

TOPERIZONE 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver or kidney impairment, galactose intolerance, the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption and myasthenia gravis. TOPERIZONE 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney impairment.

TOPERIZONE 150MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. TOPERIZONE 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age) and in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking TOPERIZONE 150MG TABLET are muscle weakness, headache, nausea, indigestion and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About TOLKEM 50MG TABLET

TOLKEM 50MG TABLET contains Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle Relaxants. It is used to relieve painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of the muscles. Symptoms include muscular weakness, tingling or prickling sensation, pain or discomfort.

TOLKEM 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver or kidney impairment, galactose intolerance, the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption and myasthenia gravis. TOLKEM 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney impairment.

TOLKEM 50MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. TOLKEM 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age) and in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking TOLKEM 50MG TABLET are muscle weakness, headache, nausea, indigestion and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
usesDetails:
Uses Of TOLKEM 50MG TABLET
Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
mechanismOfAction:
How TOLKEM 50MG TABLET Works

TOLKEM 50MG TABLET works by blocking the voltage-gated sodium channel in the brain stem thereby causing muscle relaxation and stopping the pain signals between nerve and brain. It also relieves pain by increasing the blood supply to skeletal muscles.
usageDetails:
How to use TOLKEM 50MG TABLET

Take TOLKEM 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with plenty of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking TOLKEM 50MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

Introduction About MYOSPAS D TABLET

MYOSPAS D TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac and Metaxalone which belongs to the group of medicines called Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) and Muscle relaxants respectively. MYOSPAS D TABLET is used to relieve pain, inflammation and swelling in conditions that affect the muscles. Also, it effectively relieves muscle stiffness or spasm, thereby improving muscle movement.

Before taking MYOSPAS D TABLET inform your doctor if you have heart, liver or kidney disease and including other conditions such as diabetes, high blood pressure and high cholesterol levels.

Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctors before taking MYOSPAS D TABLET. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age and not recommended for use in children.

The most common side effects of taking MYOSPAS D TABLET are nausea, vomiting, upset stomach, drowsiness, headache and nervousness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Consult your doctor before taking MYOSPAS D TABLET if you are planning to become pregnant or if you have problems getting pregnant because this medicine makes it more difficult to become pregnant.
MYOSPAS D TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking MYOSPAS D TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizziness, drowsiness, sleepiness, tiredness and problems with your vision after taking MYOSPAS D TABLET.
Consumption of alcohol is not recommended during management with MYOSPAS D TABLET because it may enhance the effects of alcohol and cause dangerous side effects.

MYOSPAS D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease and should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking MYOSPAS D TABLET.
MYOSPAS D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease and should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking MYOSPAS D TABLET.
Do not take MYOSPAS D TABLET if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to Diclofenac or Metaxalone or aspirin or ibuprofen or any other NSAID such as naproxen and indomethacin.

MYOSPAS D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with lung disease such as asthma, breathing difficulties after taking nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) such as aspirin or ibuprofen. It should be used with caution in patients with asthma, long-term lung disease or lung infection. Consult your doctor before taking MYOSPAS D TABLET.

MYOSPAS D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart attack, blockages to blood vessels of the heart and should be used with caution in patients with heart problems, angina and high blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking MYOSPAS D TABLET.

Others

MYOSPAS D TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

An itchy or runny nose
Peptic ulceration (ulcer in your stomach or duodenum)
Stomach or intestinal bleeding (black tarry stools or vomiting blood)
Cerebrovascular disease such as stroke, mini stroke (TIA)
Blockages to blood vessels to the brain or an operation to clear or bypass blockages
Peripheral arterial disease (problems with your blood circulation)

Before taking MYOSPAS D TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Suffer from any stomach or bowel disorders such as ulcerative colitis, crohn's disease
Have condition called porphyria (symptoms such as discolouration of the urine, serious skin disorders, anaemia, abdominal pain and severe mental disorders)
Suffer from serious illness with blistering of the skin, mouth, eyes and genitals or connective tissue disorders such as lupus
Have skin rash, appearance of lesions
Suffer from nasal polyps
Are recovering from major surgery
Are a smoker
Suffer from diabetes
Blood clots, raised cholesterol or raised triglycerides
Are going to have surgery of the stomach or intestinal tract
Seasonal allergic rhinitis

Use in pediatrics:

MYOSPAS D TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.  

 Use in geriatrics:

MYOSPAS D TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above), usually initiating the management with the lowest effective dose. In elderly patients with stomach problems, doctor may prescribe another medicine to protect the stomach during management with this medicine. Consult your doctor before taking MYOSPAS D TABLET.

name: Thiox OD 8mg Capsule 5'S
introduction:
Introduction About THIOX OD 8MG CAPSULE

THIOX OD 8MG CAPSULE is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

THIOX OD 8MG CAPSULE is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, THIOX OD 8MG CAPSULE relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking THIOX OD 8MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take THIOX OD 8MG CAPSULE if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking THIOX OD 8MG CAPSULE if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take THIOX OD 8MG CAPSULE only as advised by your doctor. Do not take THIOX OD 8MG CAPSULE longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with THIOX OD 8MG CAPSULE to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking THIOX OD 8MG CAPSULE are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Collectively, THIOX OD 8MG CAPSULE relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

name: Synaptol 50mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET

SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET contains Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle Relaxants. It is used to relieve painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of the muscles. Symptoms include muscular weakness, tingling or prickling sensation, pain or discomfort.

SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver or kidney impairment, galactose intolerance, the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption and myasthenia gravis. SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney impairment.

SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age) and in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET are muscle weakness, headache, nausea, indigestion and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
usesDetails:
Uses Of SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET
Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
mechanismOfAction:
How SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET Works

SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET works by blocking the voltage-gated sodium channel in the brain stem thereby causing muscle relaxation and stopping the pain signals between nerve and brain. It also relieves pain by increasing the blood supply to skeletal muscles.
usageDetails:
How to use SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET

Take SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with plenty of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.
sideEffects: Hypersensitivity reactions (signs include rash, redness of the skin, itching, shortness of breath, swelling underneath the skin, increased heart rate or low blood pressure)

Stop taking SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience this side effect:  

Hypersensitivity reactions (signs include rash, redness of the skin, itching, shortness of breath, swelling underneath the skin, increased heart rate or low blood pressure)

warnings.details: SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET.
SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET.

SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET may cause dizziness, sleepiness, attention disturbance, muscle weakness, fits or blurred vision after taking SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET. If you experience any such side effects consult your doctor for advice.

SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and kidney function in patients with moderate kidney impairment. Consult your doctor before taking SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET.

SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with liver impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and the dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and liver function in patients with moderate liver impairment. Consult your doctor before taking SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET.

SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Tolperisone or any other ingredients of this medicine. It should be used with caution in patients who are allergic to lidocaine (due to cross-reactions).

Others

SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Galactose intolerance
The Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption
Myasthenia gravis

Use in pediatrics:

SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age). Your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon age and body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

The dose of the SYNAPTOL 50MG TABLET should be adjusted in the elderly. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About MYALSIDE 8MG CAPSULE

MYALSIDE 8MG CAPSULEcontains Thiocolchicoside, which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used in adults and adolescents over 16 years of age to manage painful muscle contractions and for acute painful conditions related to the spine. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of your muscles. They’re common, involuntary, and unpredictable. The symptoms may include swelling, pain, stiffness, tenderness, and fatigue.

Your doctor may advise you to take relevant tests to understand your condition. Before taking MYALSIDE 8MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have flaccid paralysis (sagging of the face), muscular hypotonia (weak muscles), diarrhoea, lactose intolerance, seizure, or epilepsy.

MYALSIDE 8MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. MYALSIDE 8MG CAPSULE should not be used by children or adolescents under the age of 16. The most common side effects of taking MYALSIDE 8MG CAPSULE are skin allergic reactions, drowsiness, diarrhea, and gastric symptoms. Consult your doctor if your symptoms get worse or persist.
uses: Acute painful conditions related to the spine
usesDetails:
Uses Of MYALSIDE 8MG CAPSULE
Painful muscle contractions
Acute painful conditions related to the spine
mechanismOfAction:
How MYALSIDE 8MG CAPSULE Works

MYALSIDE 8MG CAPSULE works through selective binding to the GABA-A receptor (neurotransmitter). It manages muscle contractions by activating the GABA-inhibitory motor pathway and inhibiting the glycine receptors (neurotransmitters). Thus, relaxing the muscle pain and spasms.

name: BOLOFEN 5 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About BOLOFEN 5 TABLET

BOLOFEN 5 TABLET contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking BOLOFEN 5 TABLET inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

BOLOFEN 5 TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with BOLOFEN 5 TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

BOLOFEN 5 TABLET may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking BOLOFEN 5 TABLET are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking BOLOFEN 5 TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BOLOFEN 5 TABLET
Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How BOLOFEN 5 TABLET Works

BOLOFEN 5 TABLET is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use BOLOFEN 5 TABLET

Take BOLOFEN 5 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking BOLOFEN 5 TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

introduction:
Introduction About HIFENAC MR TABLET

HIFENAC MR TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac, Chlorzoxazone and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Muscle relaxants respectively. It is used to manage muscular pains and spasms. It can also be used to provide relief from joint pain (Ex. osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis) and back pain (Ex. ankylosing spondylitis).

Take HIFENAC MR TABLET preferably with meals to avoid gut irritation. Avoid consumption of alcohol as it could aggravate the risk of stomach problems. Do not take HIFENAC MR TABLET if you have any ulcers, bleeding or perforations in the gut.

Before taking HIFENAC MR TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, high blood cholesterol, any inflammation in the bowel or intestines, blood clots, bleeding problems or a previous history of stomach ulcers as a precaution.

HIFENAC MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver failure or stroke. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of taking HIFENAC MR TABLET are nausea, vomiting, indigestion, heartburn and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of HIFENAC MR TABLET

It is used to manage:

Muscle pain and spasms
Joint pain and back pain
mechanismOfAction:
How HIFENAC MR TABLET Works

HIFENAC MR TABLET contains three medicines namely Chlorzoxazone, Aceclofenac and paracetamol. Chlorzoxazone is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the brain and in spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.

Aceclofenac and paracetamol are analgesic agents. They provide pain relief by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, inflammation and swelling. Collectively, these action helps in reducing muscle spasms, joint pain and inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use HIFENAC MR TABLET

Take HIFENAC MR TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with meals to avoid gastric irritation.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ROBINAXOL D TABLET

ROBINAXOL D TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac, Methocarbamol, and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Nonsteroidal Anti-inflammatory agents, Skeletal Muscle Relaxants and Analgesics & Antipyretics respectively. It is used to relieve pain, reduce swelling, and muscle spasm associated with conditions affecting the joints, muscles and tendons like sprains, strains and backache, rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, dental or minor surgery and other injuries.

Arthritis is the tenderness or swelling of one or more joints characterized by pain, stiffness, and reduced movements.

ROBINAXOL D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with asthma, liver, kidney, and heart. Consult your doctor for advice.

ROBINAXOL D TABLET is not recommended for use in woman who are pregnant, and it should be used with caution in breastfeeding woman. Consult your doctor for advice.

ROBINAXOL D TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 12 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of taking ROBINAXOL D TABLET are stomach pain, indigestion, heart burn and vomiting. Consult your doctor if the symptoms does not improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How ROBINAXOL D TABLET Works

[GBKEYWORD] act as a painkiller and muscle relaxant where Diclofenac and Paracetamol works by reducing the effects of prostaglandin (substance produced during injury and inflammation causing pain) thereby blocking the pain signals between the brain and nerve endings. Methocarbamol blocks the effects of acetylcholine (neurotransmitter responsible for muscle contraction.

Take ROBINAXOL D TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ETRIK MR TABLET

ETRIK MR TABLET is a combination of Etoricoxib and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) and Muscle relaxants. It is used to reduce pain and swelling in the joints and muscles in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, gout and muscle spasm. This medicine is also used for the short-term management after dental surgery for moderate pain. Muscle spasm is the rapid spontaneous contractions of the muscle, which can be painful and uncomfortable. When the nerve impulses are damaged or interrupted that control muscle movement, it could lead to muscle spasms. Symptoms include muscle tightness, joint stiffness, unusual posture, difficulty in moving and pain in affected muscles and joints.

ETRIK MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having inflammatory bowel disease, severe congestive heart failure, peptic ulcer or cerebrovascular disease. Consult your doctor for advice. Before taking ETRIK MR TABLET, inform your doctor if you have blood disorders, kidney problems, liver problems or heart problems.

ETRIK MR TABLET is not recommended to use among pregnant and breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of this medicine are stomach pain, dry socket, edema, dizziness, headache, palpitations, arrhythmia, constipation, diarrhea, indigestion, gastritis, nausea and vomiting. Consult your doctor if the above side effects worsens or persist for a longer duration.

name: MYOREST Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About MYOREST TABLET

MYOREST TABLET is a combination of Chlorzoxazone and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants and Analgesics respectively. It is used to manage muscular pains and spasms. It can also be used to provide relief from joint pain (Ex. osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis), back pain (Ex. ankylosing spondylitis) and neck pain.

Take MYOREST TABLET preferably with meals to avoid gut irritation. Avoid consumption of alcohol as it could aggravate the risk of stomach problems. Do not take MYOREST TABLET if you have any ulcers, bleeding or perforations in the gut.

Before taking MYOREST TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, alcoholism, any eating disorder or any disease that causes loss of skeletal muscles and fats (such as cachexia) as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before taking MYOREST TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The common side effects of taking MYOREST TABLET are stomach upset and orangish urine. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Joint pain, back pain, neck pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of MYOREST TABLET

It is used to manage:

Muscle pain and spasms
Joint pain, back pain, neck pain
mechanismOfAction:
How MYOREST TABLET Works

MYOREST TABLET contains two medicines namely Chlorzoxazone and paracetamol. Chlorzoxazone is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the brain and in spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.

Paracetamol is a pain-relieving agent. It provides pain relief by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, inflammation and swelling. Collectively, these action helps in reducing muscle spasms, joint pain and inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use MYOREST TABLET

Take MYOREST TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with meals to avoid gastric irritation.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

MYOREST TABLET should be used in breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness, drowsiness or vision problems after taking MYOREST TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking MYOREST TABLET as it may increase the risk of side effects.

MYOREST TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with moderate to severe kidney diseases. It should be used with caution in patients with mild kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

MYOREST TABLET is not recommended in patients with severe liver problems (such as liver failure). It should be used with caution in patients with mild liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take MYOREST TABLET if you are allergic to Chlorzoxazone or Paracetamol.
MYOREST TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who previous experienced asthma attack or breathing difficulties after taking any pain-relieving medicine.

Have GI bleeding (bloody stools or vomits)
Have ulcers in the stomach or intestines

Before taking MYOREST TABLET inform your doctor if you:

Are an alcoholic
Have porphyria (a rare inherited blood disorder)
Have any eating disorders
Have cystic fibrosis
Have HIV infection
Have starvation (starving without food)
Have cachexia (loss of skeletal muscles and fat)

MYOREST TABLET is not recommended for use in children aged below 12 years. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.

MYOREST TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.

Introduction About BACFEN 10MG TABLET

BACFEN 10MG TABLET contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking BACFEN 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

BACFEN 10MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with BACFEN 10MG TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

BACFEN 10MG TABLET may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking BACFEN 10MG TABLET are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking BACFEN 10MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About BACFEN 5MG TABLET

BACFEN 5MG TABLET contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking BACFEN 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

BACFEN 5MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with BACFEN 5MG TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

BACFEN 5MG TABLET may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking BACFEN 5MG TABLET are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking BACFEN 5MG TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BACFEN 5MG TABLET
Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How BACFEN 5MG TABLET Works

BACFEN 5MG TABLET is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use BACFEN 5MG TABLET

Take BACFEN 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking BACFEN 5MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

name: Tolmove 150mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET

TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET contains Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle Relaxants. It is used to relieve painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of the muscles. Symptoms include muscular weakness, tingling or prickling sensation, pain or discomfort.

TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver or kidney impairment, galactose intolerance, the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption and myasthenia gravis. TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney impairment.

TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age) and in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET are muscle weakness, headache, nausea, indigestion and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
usesDetails:
Uses Of TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET
Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
mechanismOfAction:
How TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET Works

TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET works by blocking the voltage-gated sodium channel in the brain stem thereby causing muscle relaxation and stopping the pain signals between nerve and brain. It also relieves pain by increasing the blood supply to skeletal muscles.
usageDetails:
How to use TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET

Take TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with plenty of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.
sideEffects: Hypersensitivity reactions (signs include rash, redness of the skin, itching, shortness of breath, swelling underneath the skin, increased heart rate or low blood pressure)
sideEffectsDetails:

Headache

Uncommon

Abdominal discomfort or pain

Lassitude (physical or mental tiredness)
Weakness
Rare
Constipation, gastrointestinal disturbance, diarrhea
Increased sweating
Sleep disturbance

Stop taking TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience this side effect:  

Hypersensitivity reactions (signs include rash, redness of the skin, itching, shortness of breath, swelling underneath the skin, increased heart rate or low blood pressure)

warnings.details: TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET.
TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET.

TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET may cause dizziness, sleepiness, attention disturbance, muscle weakness, fits or blurred vision after taking TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET. If you experience any such side effects consult your doctor for advice.

TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and kidney function in patients with moderate kidney impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET.

TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with liver impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and the dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and liver function in patients with moderate liver impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET.

TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Tolperisone or any other ingredients of this medicine. It should be used with caution in patients who are allergic to lidocaine (due to cross-reactions).

Others

TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Galactose intolerance
The Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption
Myasthenia gravis

Use in pediatrics:

TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age). Your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon age and body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

The dose of the TOLMOVE 150MG TABLET should be adjusted in the elderly. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About LIOFEN XL 40MG CAPSULE

LIOFEN XL 40MG CAPSULE contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking LIOFEN XL 40MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

LIOFEN XL 40MG CAPSULE should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with LIOFEN XL 40MG CAPSULE, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

LIOFEN XL 40MG CAPSULE may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking LIOFEN XL 40MG CAPSULE are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking LIOFEN XL 40MG CAPSULE.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LIOFEN XL 40MG CAPSULE
Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How LIOFEN XL 40MG CAPSULE Works

LIOFEN XL 40MG CAPSULE is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use LIOFEN XL 40MG CAPSULE

Take LIOFEN XL 40MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking LIOFEN XL 40MG CAPSULE without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

introduction:
Introduction About GUDGESIC TH 4MG TABLET

GUDGESIC TH 4MG TABLET is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

GUDGESIC TH 4MG TABLET is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, GUDGESIC TH 4MG TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking GUDGESIC TH 4MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take GUDGESIC TH 4MG TABLET if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking GUDGESIC TH 4MG TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take GUDGESIC TH 4MG TABLET only as advised by your doctor. Do not take GUDGESIC TH 4MG TABLET longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with GUDGESIC TH 4MG TABLET to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking GUDGESIC TH 4MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Other muscle relaxants (Ex. tizanidine)

name: Baclof 25mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About BACLOF 25MG TABLET

BACLOF 25MG TABLET contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking BACLOF 25MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

BACLOF 25MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with BACLOF 25MG TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

BACLOF 25MG TABLET may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking BACLOF 25MG TABLET are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking BACLOF 25MG TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BACLOF 25MG TABLET
Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How BACLOF 25MG TABLET Works

BACLOF 25MG TABLET is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use BACLOF 25MG TABLET

Take BACLOF 25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking BACLOF 25MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

name: Synaptol SR 150mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET

SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET contains Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle Relaxants. It is used to relieve painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of the muscles. Symptoms include muscular weakness, tingling or prickling sensation, pain or discomfort.

SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver or kidney impairment, galactose intolerance, the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption and myasthenia gravis. SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney impairment.

SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age) and in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET are muscle weakness, headache, nausea, indigestion and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
usesDetails:
Uses Of SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET
Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
mechanismOfAction:
How SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET Works

SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET works by blocking the voltage-gated sodium channel in the brain stem thereby causing muscle relaxation and stopping the pain signals between nerve and brain. It also relieves pain by increasing the blood supply to skeletal muscles.
usageDetails:
How to use SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET

Take SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with plenty of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.
sideEffects: Hypersensitivity reactions (signs include rash, redness of the skin, itching, shortness of breath, swelling underneath the skin, increased heart rate or low blood pressure)
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET
Common
Muscle weakness
Headache
Low blood pressure
Nausea, vomiting, indigestion, dry mouth
Uncommon
Sleepiness, dizziness
Abdominal discomfort or pain
Fatigue
Lassitude (physical or mental tiredness)
Weakness
Rare
Constipation, gastrointestinal disturbance, diarrhea
Increased sweating
Sleep disturbance

Stop taking SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience this side effect:  

Hypersensitivity reactions (signs include rash, redness of the skin, itching, shortness of breath, swelling underneath the skin, increased heart rate or low blood pressure)

warnings.details: SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET.
SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET.

SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET may cause dizziness, sleepiness, attention disturbance, muscle weakness, fits or blurred vision after taking SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET. If you experience any such side effects consult your doctor for advice.

SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and kidney function in patients with moderate kidney impairment. Consult your doctor before taking SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET.

SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with liver impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and the dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and liver function in patients with moderate liver impairment. Consult your doctor before taking SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET.

SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Tolperisone or any other ingredients of this medicine. It should be used with caution in patients who are allergic to lidocaine (due to cross-reactions).

Others

SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Galactose intolerance
The Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption
Myasthenia gravis

Use in pediatrics:

SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age). Your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon age and body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

The dose of the SYNAPTOL SR 150MG TABLET should be adjusted in the elderly. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Medicines used to manage schizophrenia (Ex. thioridazine, perphenazine)
Tolterodine (used to manage overactive bladder)
Atomoxetine (used in attention deficit hyperactivity disorder)

name: Synaptol SR 450mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About SYNAPTOL SR 450MG TABLET

SYNAPTOL SR 450MG TABLET contains Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle Relaxants. It is used to relieve painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of the muscles. Symptoms include muscular weakness, tingling or prickling sensation, pain or discomfort.

SYNAPTOL SR 450MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver or kidney impairment, galactose intolerance, the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption and myasthenia gravis. SYNAPTOL SR 450MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney impairment.

SYNAPTOL SR 450MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. SYNAPTOL SR 450MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age) and in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking SYNAPTOL SR 450MG TABLET are muscle weakness, headache, nausea, indigestion and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
usesDetails:
Uses Of SYNAPTOL SR 450MG TABLET
Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
mechanismOfAction:
How SYNAPTOL SR 450MG TABLET Works

SYNAPTOL SR 450MG TABLET works by blocking the voltage-gated sodium channel in the brain stem thereby causing muscle relaxation and stopping the pain signals between nerve and brain. It also relieves pain by increasing the blood supply to skeletal muscles.
usageDetails:
How to use SYNAPTOL SR 450MG TABLET

Take SYNAPTOL SR 450MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with plenty of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking SYNAPTOL SR 450MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

name: Retoz MR 4mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About RETOZ MR 4MG TABLET

RETOZ MR 4MG TABLET is a combination of Etoricoxib and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) and Muscle relaxants. It is used to reduce pain and swelling in the joints and muscles in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, gout and muscle spasm. This medicine is also used for the short-term management after dental surgery for moderate pain. Muscle spasm is the rapid spontaneous contractions of the muscle, which can be painful and uncomfortable. When the nerve impulses are damaged or interrupted that control muscle movement, it could lead to muscle spasms. Symptoms include muscle tightness, joint stiffness, unusual posture, difficulty in moving and pain in affected muscles and joints.

RETOZ MR 4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having inflammatory bowel disease, severe congestive heart failure, peptic ulcer or cerebrovascular disease. Consult your doctor for advice. Before taking RETOZ MR 4MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have blood disorders, kidney problems, liver problems or heart problems.

RETOZ MR 4MG TABLET is not recommended to use among pregnant and breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of this medicine are stomach pain, dry socket, edema, dizziness, headache, palpitations, arrhythmia, constipation, diarrhea, indigestion, gastritis, nausea and vomiting. Consult your doctor if the above side effects worsens or persist for a longer duration.

introduction:
Introduction About PROXYM MR TABLET

PROXYM MR TABLET is a combination of Etodolac and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and Skeletal muscle relaxants. It is used in the management of osteoarthritis (the most common form of arthritis that occurs when cartilage wears down over time resulting in joint pain and stiffness), painful syndromes of the vertebral column(lower back and neck pain along with muscle stiffness that restricts range of motion and normal posture), rheumatism not related to joint (pain and discomfort are seen but it does damage the joints for long term), painful and muscle spasms due to injury and surgical interventions in adults.

PROXYM MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having heart failure, peptic ulcer, relaxed paralysis, muscle hypotonia, undergone by-pass and cardiac surgery, allergic to aspirin or other NSAIDs drugs, pregnant women, breastfeeding women, children and adolescents (below 16 years of age).

Before using PROXYM MR TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any history of asthma, epilepsy, fluid retention, high blood pressure or impaired heart, kidney or liver function. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of PROXYM MR TABLET are dizziness, stomach pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting and diarrhoea. If any of these symptoms worsen, consult your doctor.
uses: Manage osteoarthritis, painful syndromes of the vertebral column, rheumatism not related to joint, painful muscle spasms in acute spinal pathologies and pain following trauma and surgical interventions
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How PROXYM MR TABLET Works

PROXYM MR TABLET is a combination of Etodolac, which works by blocking the release of some chemical substances in the body that are responsible for the pain and inflammation at the site of injury and thiocolchicoside, a skeletal muscle relaxant that modifies the action of a chemical substance produced in the brain with anti-inflammatory and pain-reducing properties to work in the brain and spinal cord. This collective action is useful in providing relief from pain and muscle stiffness or spasm.

name: Numol MR 4mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About NUMOL MR 4MG TABLET

NUMOL MR 4MG TABLET is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

NUMOL MR 4MG TABLET is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, NUMOL MR 4MG TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking NUMOL MR 4MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take NUMOL MR 4MG TABLET if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking NUMOL MR 4MG TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take NUMOL MR 4MG TABLET only as advised by your doctor. Do not take NUMOL MR 4MG TABLET longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with NUMOL MR 4MG TABLET to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking NUMOL MR 4MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

How NUMOL MR 4MG TABLET Works

introduction:
Introduction About FLEXABENZ ER

FLEXABENZ ER contains Cyclobenzaprine which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to relax muscles, relieve pain and discomfort caused by strains, sprains, and other muscle injuries.

Before taking FLEXABENZ ER, inform your doctor if you have diseases such as fits, an overactive thyroid gland, glaucoma (increased pressure inside the eyes), and urinary retention (difficulty passing urine) to avoid getting unwanted side effects.

FLEXABENZ ER should be taken with caution in patients with liver and kidney diseases. FLEXABENZ ER is not recommended for patients with heart diseases. FLEXABENZ ER is not recommended to be taken during pregnancy unless necessary due to the lack of safety data. FLEXABENZ ER should be used with caution by breastfeeding mothers.

The most common side effects of taking FLEXABENZ ER may include dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, stomach pain, nausea, diarrhoea, vomiting, headache, dry mouth, confusion, mood changes, and an irregular heartbeat. Consult a doctor if any of these symptoms get worse for you while taking this medicine.
uses: Relieve pain and discomfort caused by sprains, strains, and other muscle injuries
usesDetails:

Relax muscles  
Relieve pain and discomfort caused by sprains, strains, and other muscle injuries
mechanismOfAction:
How FLEXABENZ ER Works

FLEXABENZ ER contains Cyclobenzaprine which is a muscle relaxant that works by relieving skeletal muscle spasms without interfering with muscle function. It helps to reduce the hyperactivity of skeletal muscles. FLEXABENZ ER works on the central nervous system (centres in the brain and spinal cord) to relieve muscle spasms, reduce local pain and tenderness and increase the range of motion in acute, painful musculoskeletal conditions.

name: Synaptol 100mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET

SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET contains Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle Relaxants. It is used to relieve painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of the muscles. Symptoms include muscular weakness, tingling or prickling sensation, pain or discomfort.

SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver or kidney impairment, galactose intolerance, the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption and myasthenia gravis. SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney impairment.

SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age) and in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET are muscle weakness, headache, nausea, indigestion and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
usesDetails:
Uses Of SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET
Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
mechanismOfAction:
How SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET Works

GBNKEYWORD] works by blocking the voltage-gated sodium channel in the brain stem thereby causing muscle relaxation and stopping the pain signals between nerve and brain. It also relieves pain by increasing the blood supply to skeletal muscles.

Take SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with plenty of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

warnings.details: SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET.
SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET.

SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET may cause dizziness, sleepiness, attention disturbance, muscle weakness, fits or blurred vision after taking SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET. If you experience any such side effects consult your doctor for advice.

SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and kidney function in patients with moderate kidney impairment. Consult your doctor before taking SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET.

SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with liver impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and the dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and liver function in patients with moderate liver impairment. Consult your doctor before taking SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET.

SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Tolperisone or any other ingredients of this medicine. It should be used with caution in patients who are allergic to lidocaine (due to cross-reactions).

Others

SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Galactose intolerance
The Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption
Myasthenia gravis

SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age). Your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon age and body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The dose of the SYNAPTOL 100MG TABLET should be adjusted in the elderly. Consult your doctor before taking it

introduction:
Introduction About BACFEN XL 10MG CAPSULE

BACFEN XL 10MG CAPSULE contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking BACFEN XL 10MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

BACFEN XL 10MG CAPSULE should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with BACFEN XL 10MG CAPSULE, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

BACFEN XL 10MG CAPSULE may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking BACFEN XL 10MG CAPSULE are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking BACFEN XL 10MG CAPSULE.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BACFEN XL 10MG CAPSULE
Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How BACFEN XL 10MG CAPSULE Works

BACFEN XL 10MG CAPSULE is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use BACFEN XL 10MG CAPSULE

Take BACFEN XL 10MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking BACFEN XL 10MG CAPSULE without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

introduction:
Introduction About THICHOREN AC 100/4MG TABLET

THICHOREN AC 100/4MG TABLET is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

THICHOREN AC 100/4MG TABLET is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, THICHOREN AC 100/4MG TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking THICHOREN AC 100/4MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take THICHOREN AC 100/4MG TABLET if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking THICHOREN AC 100/4MG TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take THICHOREN AC 100/4MG TABLET only as advised by your doctor. Do not take THICHOREN AC 100/4MG TABLET longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with THICHOREN AC 100/4MG TABLET to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking THICHOREN AC 100/4MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ETOLYTE MR TABLET

ETOLYTE MR TABLET is a combination of Etoricoxib and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) and Muscle relaxants. It is used to reduce pain and swelling in the joints and muscles in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, gout and muscle spasm. This medicine is also used for the short-term management after dental surgery for moderate pain. Muscle spasm is the rapid spontaneous contractions of the muscle, which can be painful and uncomfortable. When the nerve impulses are damaged or interrupted that control muscle movement, it could lead to muscle spasms. Symptoms include muscle tightness, joint stiffness, unusual posture, difficulty in moving and pain in affected muscles and joints.

ETOLYTE MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having inflammatory bowel disease, severe congestive heart failure, peptic ulcer or cerebrovascular disease. Consult your doctor for advice. Before taking ETOLYTE MR TABLET, inform your doctor if you have blood disorders, kidney problems, liver problems or heart problems.

ETOLYTE MR TABLET is not recommended to use among pregnant and breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of this medicine are stomach pain, dry socket, edema, dizziness, headache, palpitations, arrhythmia, constipation, diarrhea, indigestion, gastritis, nausea and vomiting. Consult your doctor if the above side effects worsens or persist for a longer duration.

name: Myotop SR 450mg Tablet 6'S
introduction:
Introduction About MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET

MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET contains Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle Relaxants. It is used to relieve painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of the muscles. Symptoms include muscular weakness, tingling or prickling sensation, pain or discomfort.

MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver or kidney impairment, galactose intolerance, the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption and myasthenia gravis. MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney impairment.

MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age) and in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET are muscle weakness, headache, nausea, indigestion and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
usesDetails:
Uses Of MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET
Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
mechanismOfAction:
How MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET Works

MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET works by blocking the voltage-gated sodium channel in the brain stem thereby causing muscle relaxation and stopping the pain signals between nerve and brain. It also relieves pain by increasing the blood supply to skeletal muscles.
usageDetails:
How to use MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET

Take MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with plenty of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.
sideEffects: Hypersensitivity reactions (signs include rash, redness of the skin, itching, shortness of breath, swelling underneath the skin, increased heart rate or low blood pressure)

warnings.details: MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET.
MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET.

MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET may cause dizziness, sleepiness, attention disturbance, muscle weakness, fits or blurred vision after taking MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET. If you experience any such side effects consult your doctor for advice.

MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and kidney function in patients with moderate kidney impairment. Consult your doctor before taking MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET.

MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with liver impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and the dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and liver function in patients with moderate liver impairment. Consult your doctor before taking MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET.

MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Tolperisone or any other ingredients of this medicine. It should be used with caution in patients who are allergic to lidocaine (due to cross-reactions).

Others

MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Galactose intolerance
The Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption
Myasthenia gravis

Use in pediatrics:

MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age). Your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon age and body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

The dose of the MYOTOP SR 450MG TABLET should be adjusted in the elderly. Consult your doctor before taking it.

name: Back 5mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About BACK 5MG TABLET

BACK 5MG TABLET contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking BACK 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

BACK 5MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with BACK 5MG TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

BACK 5MG TABLET may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking BACK 5MG TABLET are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking BACK 5MG TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BACK 5MG TABLET
Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How BACK 5MG TABLET Works

BACK 5MG TABLET is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use BACK 5MG TABLET

Take BACK 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking BACK 5MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

Introduction About TOLIFAST D TABLET

TOLIFAST D TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac and Tolperisone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Skeletal Muscle relaxants respectively. It is used in adults to manage painful muscle spasms.

It can also be used to manage back pain (Ex. ankylosing spondylitis), joint pain and swelling (Ex. osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis), neck pain, sports injuries and sprains.

Take TOLIFAST D TABLET with or just after meals. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with TOLIFAST D TABLET to achieve better results. Before taking TOLIFAST D TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your lung, liver, kidney, heart or stomach.

You much also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, asthma or COPD, bleeding disorders or any allergic conditions (such as skin rash, itching or watery eyes, repeated sneezing, nasal congestion and nasal itching) as a precaution.

TOLIFAST D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe bleeding, perforation or ulcers in the stomach or intestines. Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of taking TOLIFAST D TABLET dizziness, headache, spinning sensation, nausea, vomiting, indigestion, stomach pain, heartburn, flatulence, loss of appetite, increased liver enzymes and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How TOLIFAST D TABLET Works

TOLIFAST D TABLET contains two medicines namely diclofenac and Tolperisone. Diclofenac is a pain-relieving medication. It acts by blocking the production of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain and inflammation.

Tolperisone is a muscle relaxant. It relaxes skeletal muscles by acting on certain centres of the brain and the spinal cord that controls muscle movements. As a result, TOLIFAST D TABLET relieves muscle pain and joint pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TOLIFAST D TABLET

Always take TOLIFAST D TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. TOLIFAST D TABLET should be taken with or after food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Serious allergic reactions such as skin rash, itching, swelling of the face, lips, mouth, or tongue causing difficulty in breathing or swallowing

Bleeding in the gut (signs include bloody stools or vomits)
Sudden, severe chest pain, shortness of breath even while lying down, swelling of legs and feet (signs of heart attack)
