Yellow skin and eyes, problems in passing urine, sore throat, high temperature, increased bruising

warnings.details: TOLIFAST D TABLET should not be taken by pregnant women especially during the last 3 months of pregnancy. Therefore, inform your doctor before taking it.
TOLIFAST D TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy or drowsy after taking TOLIFAST D TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TOLIFAST D TABLET to avoid the risk of side effects.

TOLIFAST D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney diseases (such as kidney failure). It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

TOLIFAST D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver diseases (such as liver failure). It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take TOLIFAST D TABLET if you are allergic to Diclofenac or Tolperisone.

TOLIFAST D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with asthma or breathing difficulties. It should be used with caution in patients with infections of the respiratory tract. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

TOLIFAST D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with congestive heart failure, or heart attack. It should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

The safety and effectiveness of TOLIFAST D TABLET is not well established in children. Therefore, it is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 15 years). It can be used in adolescents aged 15 years or above if prescribed by the physician.
TOLIFAST D TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

TOLIFAST D TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have myasthenia gravis (severe muscle weakness)
Have bleeding, holes or ulcers in the stomach or intestines
Have peripheral arterial disease
Have problems in blood circulation in the body
Have allergic rhinitis (repeated sneezing, nasal itching, watery eyes)
Have urticaria (skin rash with itching)

Before taking TOLIFAST D TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have high blood cholesterol levels
Have diabetes mellitus
Are a smoker
Have a history of bleeding inside the brain
Have a history of stomach ulcer or inflammation particularly if complicated with haemorrhage (bleeding) or perforation
Have ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease
Have bleeding problems
Recently had or going to have a surgery in the stomach or intestines

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking TOLIFAST D TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Other medicines used for pain relief (Ex. aspirin, celecoxib, ibuprofen)
Medicines used for blood thinning (Ex. warfarin, clopidogrel, prasugrel)
Medicines used to reduce blood pressure (Ex. enalapril, olmesartan, losartan, metoprolol, nebivolol)
Cardiac glycosides used to manage heart failure (Ex. digoxin, digitoxin)
Potassium sparging diuretics (used to manage potassium loss) such as spironolactone, aldosterone
Medicines used to manage bacterial infection (such as trimethoprim, ciprofloxacin, ofloxacin, levofloxacin or moxifloxacin)
Medicines used to manage fungal infections (such as voriconazole)
Medicines used to reduce blood sugar levels (such as glibenclamide, glycoside, and tolbutamide)
Oral corticosteroids (used to manage pain and inflammation) Ex. dexamethasone
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. citalopram, fluoxetine, sertraline, venlafaxine, desipramine
Immunosuppressants (used to suppress immune function) Ex. cyclosporin, tacrolimus
Colestipol, colestyramine (medicines used to control blood cholesterol levels)
Diuretics (used to increase urine output) Ex. furosemide
Lithium (a medicine used to manage mental illness)
Methotrexate (a medicine used to manage auto-immune diseases or cancer)
Mifepristone (birth control pill)
Phenytoin (a medicine used to manage fits)
Thioridazine, perphenazine (medicines used to manage psychiatric illnesses)
Tolterodine (a medicine used for overactive bladder)
Atomoxetine (a medicine used for ADHD)
Dextromethorphan (a cough suppressant)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more TOLIFAST D TABLET, contact your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdosage might include nausea, vomiting, upper stomach pain, headache, gastrointestinal bleeding, diarrhoea, disorientation, excitation, drowsiness, dizziness, tinnitus, hypotension, respiratory depression, fainting and convulsions.

name: Tolifast SR 450mg Tablet 6'S
introduction:
Introduction About TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET

TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET contains Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle Relaxants. It is used to relieve painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of the muscles. Symptoms include muscular weakness, tingling or prickling sensation, pain or discomfort.

TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver or kidney impairment, galactose intolerance, the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption and myasthenia gravis. TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney impairment.

TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age) and in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET are muscle weakness, headache, nausea, indigestion and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
usesDetails:
Uses Of TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET
Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
mechanismOfAction:
How TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET Works

TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET works by blocking the voltage-gated sodium channel in the brain stem thereby causing muscle relaxation and stopping the pain signals between nerve and brain. It also relieves pain by increasing the blood supply to skeletal muscles.
usageDetails:
How to use TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET

Take TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with plenty of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.
sideEffects: Hypersensitivity reactions (signs include rash, redness of the skin, itching, shortness of breath, swelling underneath the skin, increased heart rate or low blood pressure)

warnings.details: TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET.
TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET.

TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET may cause dizziness, sleepiness, attention disturbance, muscle weakness, fits or blurred vision after taking TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET. If you experience any such side effects consult your doctor for advice.

TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and kidney function in patients with moderate kidney impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET.

TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with liver impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and the dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and liver function in patients with moderate liver impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET.

TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Tolperisone or any other ingredients of this medicine. It should be used with caution in patients who are allergic to lidocaine (due to cross-reactions).

Others

TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Galactose intolerance
The Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption
Myasthenia gravis

Use in pediatrics:

TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age). Your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon age and body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

The dose of the TOLIFAST SR 450MG TABLET should be adjusted in the elderly. Consult your doctor before taking it.

name: Volitra Plus Gel 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About VOLITRA PLUS GEL

VOLITRA PLUS GEL is a combination of Benzyl alcohol, Diclofenac, Linseed Oil, Menthol, Methyl Salicylate, and Capsaicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Bacteriostatic, Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs), Cooling agents, and Analgesics respectively. It is indicated for the local symptomatic relief of pain and inflammation that occurs due to musculoskeletal disorders (MSDs), sprains and strains, knee pain/arthritis, low back pain.

Avoid exposure to the sun after using VOLITRA PLUS GEL. Consult your doctor for advice. VOLITRA PLUS GEL is not recommended for use in patients who have asthma, urticaria, acute rhinitis, and coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery. Before using VOLITRA PLUS GEL, inform your doctor if you have liver problems, kidney problems, heart problems, blood disorders, or anemia. VOLITRA PLUS GEL is not recommended for use among women who are pregnant, especially in the third trimester of pregnancy and breastfeeding.

VOLITRA PLUS GEL is not recommended to use in children and adolescents below 14 years of age. Caution must be exercised while using VOLITRA PLUS GEL in elderly patients. The most common side effects of using VOLITRA PLUS GEL are application site reactions, including skin irritation, rash, dermatitis, pruritus, erythema, paraesthesia, vesicles, papules, redness or swelling, burning, or stinging sensation. Consult your doctor’s advice if any of these doesn’t improve or worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of VOLITRA PLUS GEL

It is used to relieve pain and inflammation that occurs due to:

Musculoskeletal disorders (MSDs)
Sprains, strains
Knee pain or arthritis
Low back pain
mechanismOfAction:
How VOLITRA PLUS GEL Works

VOLITRA PLUS GEL helps in local symptomatic relief of pain and inflammation whereas Benzyl alcohol inhibits the growth of the bacteria as well as the solvent that dissolves other ingredients in the formula. Diclofenac and Capsaicin work by inhibiting the factors that cause inflammation and pain called prostaglandins. Linseed oil helps in minimizing skin irritation soothes and calms the skin. Menthol acts by acting as an irritant and imparts coolness to the skin and then warmth. Methyl Salicylate acts by dilating the blood vessels and increasing blood flow. It causes irritation of the skin and because of counter-irritation, there is a sensation of warmth and relief in musculoskeletal pain.
usageDetails:
How to use VOLITRA PLUS GEL

Apply VOLITRA PLUS GEL as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Gently rub VOLITRA PLUS GEL on the affected area till it disappears. Do not cover the applied areas with a bandage and do not apply on cuts and open wounds.

Hepatotoxicity (signs include nausea, fatigue, lethargy, diarrhea, pruritus, jaundice, right upper quadrant tenderness, and ‘flu-like’ symptoms)

Side Effects Of VOLITRA PLUS GEL
Common
Application site reactions (signs include skin irritation, rash, dermatitis, pruritus, erythema, paraesthesia, vesicles, papules, redness or swelling, burning, or stinging sensation)
Rare

Stop using VOLITRA PLUS GEL and inform your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects;

Hypersensitivity or allergic reactions
Hepatotoxicity (signs include nausea, fatigue, lethargy, diarrhea, pruritus, jaundice, right upper quadrant tenderness, and ‘flu-like’ symptoms)

warnings.details: VOLITRA PLUS GEL is not recommended in pregnant women, especially in the third trimester of pregnancy. Consult your doctor before using it.
VOLITRA PLUS GEL is not recommended to use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if it is excreted in breast milk. Consult your doctor before using it.
Intake of alcoholic beverages while using VOLITRA PLUS GEL may increase the risk of stomach bleeding. So, limit the consumption of alcohol. Consult your doctor before using.
VOLITRA PLUS GEL is not recommended for use in patients with advanced renal diseases. Consult with your doctor before using.
VOLITRA PLUS GEL should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before using.
Do not use VOLITRA PLUS GEL if you are allergic to Diclofenac, Linseed Oil, Menthol, Methyl Salicylate, Capsaicin or any other ingredients of this medicine.
VOLITRA PLUS GEL is not recommended for use in patients who have or had an asthmatic attack after the use of NSAIDs such as aspirin. Consult with your doctor before using.
VOLITRA PLUS GEL is not recommended for use in patients with heart diseases such as the setting of coronary artery bypass graft surgery. Consult with your doctor before using.
VOLITRA PLUS GEL is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 14 years of age. Consult your doctor before using.

introduction:
Introduction About THIOFORD TABLET

THIOFORD TABLET is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

THIOFORD TABLET is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, THIOFORD TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking THIOFORD TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take THIOFORD TABLET if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking THIOFORD TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take THIOFORD TABLET only as advised by your doctor. Do not take THIOFORD TABLET longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with THIOFORD TABLET to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking THIOFORD TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Collectively, THIOFORD TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

name: Myosone 50mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About MYOSONE 50MG TABLET

MYOSONE 50MG TABLET contains Eperisone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle Relaxants. It is used to manage and improve the myotonic condition of the muscles caused by neck-shoulder arm syndrome (a condition causing muscle pain and stiffness in the neck, arm, and shoulder region), scapulohumeral periarthritis (a condition causing muscle pain and stiffness in the shoulder joint), and low back pain (a painful condition affecting the lower region of the spine due to a muscle or ligament injury).

The myotonic condition causes wasting and weakness of the muscle when its functional ability to relax is impaired. It is also used to manage spastic paralysis (loss of muscle function along with pain and muscle stiffness) caused by a spinal or neurological disorder, trauma, cerebral palsy, tumour in the spine, etc.

MYOSONE 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver function disorders. MYOSONE 50MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy unless recommended by your doctor. MYOSONE 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. Its safety and efficiency for use in children have not been established. Consult your doctor for advice before taking MYOSONE 50MG TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking MYOSONE 50MG TABLET may include weakness, light-headedness, fatigue, sleepiness, insomnia, headache, nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, abdominal pain, diarrhea, constipation, and thirst. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persist.

mechanismOfAction:
How MYOSONE 50MG TABLET Works

MYOSONE 50MG TABLET works by blocking the voltage-gated sodium channel in the brain stem. As a result, it stops nerve signals and aids in the relaxation of muscles.
usageDetails:

Take MYOSONE 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose, frequency, and duration of management for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Nucoxia Relax Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About NUCOXIA RELAX TABLET

NUCOXIA RELAX TABLET is a combination of Etoricoxib and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) and Muscle relaxants. It is used to reduce pain and swelling in the joints and muscles in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, gout and muscle spasm. This medicine is also used for the short-term management after dental surgery for moderate pain. Muscle spasm is the rapid spontaneous contractions of the muscle, which can be painful and uncomfortable. When the nerve impulses are damaged or interrupted that control muscle movement, it could lead to muscle spasms. Symptoms include muscle tightness, joint stiffness, unusual posture, difficulty in moving and pain in affected muscles and joints.

NUCOXIA RELAX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having inflammatory bowel disease, severe congestive heart failure, peptic ulcer or cerebrovascular disease. Consult your doctor for advice. Before taking NUCOXIA RELAX TABLET, inform your doctor if you have blood disorders, kidney problems, liver problems or heart problems.

NUCOXIA RELAX TABLET is not recommended to use among pregnant and breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of this medicine are stomach pain, dry socket, edema, dizziness, headache, palpitations, arrhythmia, constipation, diarrhea, indigestion, gastritis, nausea and vomiting. Consult your doctor if the above side effects worsens or persist for a longer duration.

Have Crohn’s disease, Ulcerative colitis, or Colitis (inflammatory bowel disease)
Have any kind of stroke, and muscles problems
Have peripheral arterial disease

Tell your physician before taking this medicine if you:

Had dehydration (a prolonged bout of vomiting or diarrhea)

Have being managed for an infection
Have high cholesterol, diabetes
Are a smoker
Have epilepsy

introduction:
Introduction About TOPNAC TH TABLET

TOPNAC TH TABLET is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

TOPNAC TH TABLET is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, TOPNAC TH TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking TOPNAC TH TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take TOPNAC TH TABLET if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking TOPNAC TH TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take TOPNAC TH TABLET only as advised by your doctor. Do not take TOPNAC TH TABLET longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with TOPNAC TH TABLET to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking TOPNAC TH TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Introduction About BACFEN 25MG TABLET

BACFEN 25MG TABLET contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking BACFEN 25MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

BACFEN 25MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with BACFEN 25MG TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

BACFEN 25MG TABLET may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking BACFEN 25MG TABLET are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking BACFEN 25MG TABLET.
usesDetails:

Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How BACFEN 25MG TABLET Works

BACFEN 25MG TABLET is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use BACFEN 25MG TABLET

Take BACFEN 25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking BACFEN 25MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

TOLIFAST 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver or kidney impairment, galactose intolerance, the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption and myasthenia gravis. TOLIFAST 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney impairment.

TOLIFAST 150MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. TOLIFAST 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age) and in elderly patients.

Uses Of TOLIFAST 150MG TABLET
Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
mechanismOfAction:
How TOLIFAST 150MG TABLET Works

TOLIFAST 150MG TABLET works by blocking the voltage-gated sodium channel in the brain stem thereby causing muscle relaxation and stopping the pain signals between nerve and brain. It also relieves pain by increasing the blood supply to skeletal muscles.
usageDetails:
How to use TOLIFAST 150MG TABLET

Take TOLIFAST 150MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with plenty of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking TOLIFAST 150MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

warnings.details: TOLIFAST 150MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking TOLIFAST 150MG TABLET.
TOLIFAST 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking TOLIFAST 150MG TABLET.

TOLIFAST 150MG TABLET may cause dizziness, sleepiness, attention disturbance, muscle weakness, fits or blurred vision after taking TOLIFAST 150MG TABLET. If you experience any such side effects consult your doctor for advice.

TOLIFAST 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and kidney function in patients with moderate kidney impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TOLIFAST 150MG TABLET.

TOLIFAST 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with liver impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and the dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and liver function in patients with moderate liver impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TOLIFAST 150MG TABLET.

TOLIFAST 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Tolperisone or any other ingredients of this medicine. It should be used with caution in patients who are allergic to lidocaine (due to cross-reactions).

Others

TOLIFAST 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Galactose intolerance
The Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption
Myasthenia gravis

Use in pediatrics:

TOLIFAST 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age). Your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon age and body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

The dose of the TOLIFAST 150MG TABLET should be adjusted in the elderly. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About RICLOFEN 10MG TABLET

RICLOFEN 10MG TABLET contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking RICLOFEN 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

RICLOFEN 10MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with RICLOFEN 10MG TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

RICLOFEN 10MG TABLET may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking RICLOFEN 10MG TABLET are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking RICLOFEN 10MG TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of RICLOFEN 10MG TABLET
Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How RICLOFEN 10MG TABLET Works

RICLOFEN 10MG TABLET is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use RICLOFEN 10MG TABLET

Take RICLOFEN 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking RICLOFEN 10MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

name: Retoz MR 8mg/60mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About RETOZ MR 8MG/60MG TABLET

RETOZ MR 8MG/60MG TABLET is a combination of Etoricoxib and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) and Muscle relaxants. It is used to reduce pain and swelling in the joints and muscles in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, gout and muscle spasm. This medicine is also used for the short-term management after dental surgery for moderate pain. Muscle spasm is the rapid spontaneous contractions of the muscle, which can be painful and uncomfortable. When the nerve impulses are damaged or interrupted that control muscle movement, it could lead to muscle spasms. Symptoms include muscle tightness, joint stiffness, unusual posture, difficulty in moving and pain in affected muscles and joints.

RETOZ MR 8MG/60MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having inflammatory bowel disease, severe congestive heart failure, peptic ulcer or cerebrovascular disease. Consult your doctor for advice. Before taking RETOZ MR 8MG/60MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have blood disorders, kidney problems, liver problems or heart problems.

RETOZ MR 8MG/60MG TABLET is not recommended to use among pregnant and breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of this medicine are stomach pain, dry socket, edema, dizziness, headache, palpitations, arrhythmia, constipation, diarrhea, indigestion, gastritis, nausea and vomiting. Consult your doctor if the above side effects worsens or persist for a longer duration.

introduction:
Introduction About MIOFREE 8MG CAPSULE

MIOFREE 8MG CAPSULEcontains Thiocolchicoside, which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used in adults and adolescents over 16 years of age to manage painful muscle contractions and for acute painful conditions related to the spine. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of your muscles. They’re common, involuntary, and unpredictable. The symptoms may include swelling, pain, stiffness, tenderness, and fatigue.

Your doctor may advise you to take relevant tests to understand your condition. Before taking MIOFREE 8MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have flaccid paralysis (sagging of the face), muscular hypotonia (weak muscles), diarrhoea, lactose intolerance, seizure, or epilepsy.

MIOFREE 8MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. MIOFREE 8MG CAPSULE should not be used by children or adolescents under the age of 16. The most common side effects of taking MIOFREE 8MG CAPSULE are skin allergic reactions, drowsiness, diarrhea, and gastric symptoms. Consult your doctor if your symptoms get worse or persist.

mechanismOfAction:
How MIOFREE 8MG CAPSULE Works

MIOFREE 8MG CAPSULE works through selective binding to the GABA-A receptor (neurotransmitter). It manages muscle contractions by activating the GABA-inhibitory motor pathway and inhibiting the glycine receptors (neurotransmitters). Thus, relaxing the muscle pain and spasms.

Take MIOFREE 8MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About ZERODOL TH MAX 4 TABLET

ZERODOL TH MAX 4 TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs and Muscle relaxants. ZERODOL TH MAX 4 TABLET is used in adults for the management of acute inflammatory and painful conditions associated with muscle spasms, such as lower back pain, muscle spasm due to any injury, neck and shoulder pain, sciatica (type of nerve pain), degenerative vertebral disorders, ankylosing spondylitis (chronic back pain due to fusion of some bones of the spine), osteoarthritis, and rheumatoid arthritis.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking ZERODOL TH MAX 4 TABLET. ZERODOL TH MAX 4 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from stomach ulcers, intestinal bleeding or have a history of stomach ulcers, severe kidney problems, liver failure, bleeding disorders, peripheral arterial disease (problem with blood circulation), heart problems such as heart attack, stroke, blockages in blood vessels of brain or heart or had a history of heart surgery for clearing blockages, rare hereditary problems of galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption, therefore consult your doctor before taking.

ZERODOL TH MAX 4 TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver and kidney problems, seizures, stomach and bowel disorders, asthma or breathing problems, blood disorders (porphyria), recovering from major surgery, and alcohol dependence. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

ZERODOL TH MAX 4 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women; therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. ZERODOL TH MAX 4 TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 16 years of age. ZERODOL TH MAX 4 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (>65 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects after taking ZERODOL TH MAX 4 TABLET are dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea, drowsiness, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any side effects or an allergic reaction after taking this medicine.

ZERODOL TH MAX 4 TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside, which work together to reduce pain and inflammation. Introduction About BACLESTA 10MG TABLET

BACLESTA 10MG TABLET contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking BACLESTA 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

BACLESTA 10MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with BACLESTA 10MG TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

BACLESTA 10MG TABLET may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking BACLESTA 10MG TABLET are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking BACLESTA 10MG TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BACLESTA 10MG TABLET
Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How BACLESTA 10MG TABLET Works

BACLESTA 10MG TABLET is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use BACLESTA 10MG TABLET

Take BACLESTA 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking BACLESTA 10MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

name: ENZOFLAM MR Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ENZOFLAM MR TABLET

ENZOFLAM MR TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs and Muscle relaxants. ENZOFLAM MR TABLET is used in adults for the management of acute inflammatory and painful conditions associated with muscle spasms, such as lower back pain, muscle spasm due to any injury, neck and shoulder pain, sciatica (type of nerve pain), degenerative vertebral disorders, ankylosing spondylitis (chronic back pain due to fusion of some bones of the spine), osteoarthritis, and rheumatoid arthritis.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking ENZOFLAM MR TABLET. ENZOFLAM MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from stomach ulcers, intestinal bleeding or have a history of stomach ulcers, severe kidney problems, liver failure, bleeding disorders, peripheral arterial disease (problem with blood circulation), heart problems such as heart attack, stroke, blockages in blood vessels of brain or heart or had a history of heart surgery for clearing blockages, rare hereditary problems of galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption, therefore consult your doctor before taking.

ENZOFLAM MR TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver and kidney problems, seizures, stomach and bowel disorders, asthma or breathing problems, blood disorders (porphyria), recovering from major surgery, and alcohol dependence. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

ENZOFLAM MR TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women; therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. ENZOFLAM MR TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 16 years of age. ENZOFLAM MR TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (>65 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects after taking ENZOFLAM MR TABLET are dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea, drowsiness, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any side effects or an allergic reaction after taking this medicine.

mechanismOfAction:
How ENZOFLAM MR TABLET Works

ENZOFLAM MR TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside, which work together to reduce pain and inflammation. Paracetamol and aceclofenac stop the formation of pain and inflammation-causing chemicals called prostaglandins, and thiocolchicoside acts in the brain and spinal cord on GABA receptors and helps to relieve muscle stiffness and muscle spasms.

Take ENZOFLAM MR TABLET as advised by your physician. Take ENZOFLAM MR TABLET with meals or after meals. Swallow ENZOFLAM MR TABLET as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration of management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: TOLKEM SR 450mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TOLKEM SR 450MG TABLET

TOLKEM SR 450MG TABLET contains Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle Relaxants. It is used to relieve painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of the muscles. Symptoms include muscular weakness, tingling or prickling sensation, pain or discomfort.

TOLKEM SR 450MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver or kidney impairment, galactose intolerance, the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption and myasthenia gravis. TOLKEM SR 450MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney impairment.

TOLKEM SR 450MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. TOLKEM SR 450MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age) and in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking TOLKEM SR 450MG TABLET are muscle weakness, headache, nausea, indigestion and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
usesDetails:
Uses Of TOLKEM SR 450MG TABLET
Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
mechanismOfAction:
How TOLKEM SR 450MG TABLET Works

TOLKEM SR 450MG TABLET works by blocking the voltage-gated sodium channel in the brain stem thereby causing muscle relaxation and stopping the pain signals between nerve and brain. It also relieves pain by increasing the blood supply to skeletal muscles.
usageDetails:
How to use TOLKEM SR 450MG TABLET

Take TOLKEM SR 450MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with plenty of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking TOLKEM SR 450MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.
sideEffects: Hypersensitivity reactions (signs include rash, redness of the skin, itching, shortness of breath, swelling underneath the skin, increased heart rate or low blood pressure)

introduction:
Introduction About THICHOREN AC 100/8MG TABLET

THICHOREN AC 100/8MG TABLET is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

THICHOREN AC 100/8MG TABLET is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, THICHOREN AC 100/8MG TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking THICHOREN AC 100/8MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take THICHOREN AC 100/8MG TABLET if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking THICHOREN AC 100/8MG TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take THICHOREN AC 100/8MG TABLET only as advised by your doctor. Do not take THICHOREN AC 100/8MG TABLET longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with THICHOREN AC 100/8MG TABLET to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking THICHOREN AC 100/8MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Collectively, THICHOREN AC 100/8MG TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Introduction About SKELEBENZ 15MG CAPSULE

SKELEBENZ 15MG CAPSULE contains Cyclobenzaprine which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to relax muscles, relieve pain and discomfort caused by strains, sprains, and other muscle injuries.

Before taking SKELEBENZ 15MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have diseases such as fits, an overactive thyroid gland, glaucoma (increased pressure inside the eyes), and urinary retention (difficulty passing urine) to avoid getting unwanted side effects.

SKELEBENZ 15MG CAPSULE should be taken with caution in patients with liver and kidney diseases. SKELEBENZ 15MG CAPSULE is not recommended for patients with heart diseases. SKELEBENZ 15MG CAPSULE is not recommended to be taken during pregnancy unless necessary due to the lack of safety data. SKELEBENZ 15MG CAPSULE should be used with caution by breastfeeding mothers.

The most common side effects of taking SKELEBENZ 15MG CAPSULE may include dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, stomach pain, nausea, diarrhoea, vomiting, headache, dry mouth, confusion, mood changes, and an irregular heartbeat. Consult a doctor if any of these symptoms get worse for you while taking this medicine.

How SKELEBENZ 15MG CAPSULE Works

SKELEBENZ 15MG CAPSULE contains Cyclobenzaprine which is a muscle relaxant that works by relieving skeletal muscle spasms without interfering with muscle function. SKELEBENZ 15MG CAPSULE works on the central nervous system (centres in the brain and spinal cord) to relieve muscle spasms, reduce local pain and tenderness and increase the range of motion in acute, painful musculoskeletal conditions.

introduction:
Introduction About TOLISAK D TABLET

TOLISAK D TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac and Tolperisone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Skeletal Muscle relaxants respectively. It is used in adults to manage painful muscle spasms.

It can also be used to manage back pain (Ex. ankylosing spondylitis), joint pain and swelling (Ex. osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis), neck pain, sports injuries and sprains.

Take TOLISAK D TABLET with or just after meals. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with TOLISAK D TABLET to achieve better results. Before taking TOLISAK D TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your lung, liver, kidney, heart or stomach.

You much also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, asthma or COPD, bleeding disorders or any allergic conditions (such as skin rash, itching or watery eyes, repeated sneezing, nasal congestion and nasal itching) as a precaution.

TOLISAK D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe bleeding, perforation or ulcers in the stomach or intestines. Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of taking TOLISAK D TABLET dizziness, headache, spinning sensation, nausea, vomiting, indigestion, stomach pain, heartburn, flatulence, loss of appetite, increased liver enzymes and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Joint pain, back pain, neck pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of TOLISAK D TABLET

It is used in adults to manage:

Painful muscle spasms
Joint pain, back pain, neck pain
Sprains, sports injury
mechanismOfAction:
How TOLISAK D TABLET Works

TOLISAK D TABLET contains two medicines namely diclofenac and Tolperisone. Diclofenac is a pain-relieving medication. It acts by blocking the production of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain and inflammation.

Tolperisone is a muscle relaxant. It relaxes skeletal muscles by acting on certain centres of the brain and the spinal cord that controls muscle movements. As a result, TOLISAK D TABLET relieves muscle pain and joint pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TOLISAK D TABLET

Always take TOLISAK D TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. TOLISAK D TABLET should be taken with or after food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

TOLISAK D TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy or drowsy after taking TOLISAK D TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TOLISAK D TABLET to avoid the risk of side effects.

TOLISAK D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney diseases (such as kidney failure). It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

TOLISAK D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver diseases (such as liver failure). It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take TOLISAK D TABLET if you are allergic to Diclofenac or Tolperisone.

TOLISAK D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with asthma or breathing difficulties. It should be used with caution in patients with infections of the respiratory tract. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

TOLISAK D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with congestive heart failure, or heart attack. It should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

The safety and effectiveness of TOLISAK D TABLET is not well established in children. Therefore, it is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 15 years). It can be used in adolescents aged 15 years or above if prescribed by the physician.
TOLISAK D TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

TOLISAK D TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have myasthenia gravis (severe muscle weakness)
Have bleeding, holes or ulcers in the stomach or intestines
Have peripheral arterial disease
Have problems in blood circulation in the body
Have allergic rhinitis (repeated sneezing, nasal itching, watery eyes)
Have urticaria (skin rash with itching)

Before taking TOLISAK D TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have high blood cholesterol levels
Have diabetes mellitus
Are a smoker
Have a history of bleeding inside the brain
Have a history of stomach ulcer or inflammation particularly if complicated with haemorrhage (bleeding) or perforation
Have ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease
Have bleeding problems
Recently had or going to have a surgery in the stomach or intestines

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking TOLISAK D TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Other medicines used for pain relief (Ex. aspirin, celecoxib, ibuprofen)
Medicines used for blood thinning (Ex. warfarin, clopidogrel, prasugrel)
Medicines used to reduce blood pressure (Ex. enalapril, olmesartan, losartan, metoprolol, nebivolol)
Cardiac glycosides used to manage heart failure (Ex. digoxin, digitoxin)
Potassium sparging diuretics (used to manage potassium loss) such as spironolactone, aldosterone
Medicines used to manage bacterial infection (such as trimethoprim, ciprofloxacin, ofloxacin, levofloxacin or moxifloxacin)
Medicines used to manage fungal infections (such as voriconazole)
Medicines used to reduce blood sugar levels (such as glibenclamide, glycoside, and tolbutamide)
Oral corticosteroids (used to manage pain and inflammation) Ex. dexamethasone
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. citalopram, fluoxetine, sertraline, venlafaxine, desipramine
Immunosuppressants (used to suppress immune function) Ex. cyclosporin, tacrolimus
Colestipol, colestyramine (medicines used to control blood cholesterol levels)
Diuretics (used to increase urine output) Ex. furosemide
Lithium (a medicine used to manage mental illness)
Methotrexate (a medicine used to manage auto-immune diseases or cancer)
Mifepristone (birth control pill)
Phenytoin (a medicine used to manage fits)
Thioridazine, perphenazine (medicines used to manage psychiatric illnesses)
Tolterodine (a medicine used for overactive bladder)
Atomoxetine (a medicine used for ADHD)
Dextromethorphan (a cough suppressant)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more TOLISAK D TABLET, contact your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdosage might include nausea, vomiting, upper stomach pain, headache, gastrointestinal bleeding, diarrhoea, disorientation, excitation, drowsiness, dizziness, tinnitus, hypotension, respiratory depression, fainting and convulsions.

METAXONE D TABLET is used to relieve pain, inflammation and swelling in conditions that affect the muscles. Also, it effectively relieves muscle stiffness or spasm, thereby improving muscle movement.

Before taking METAXONE D TABLET inform your doctor if you have heart, liver or kidney disease and including other conditions such as diabetes, high blood pressure and high cholesterol levels.

The most common side effects of taking METAXONE D TABLET are nausea, vomiting, upset stomach, drowsiness, headache and nervousness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Consult your doctor before taking METAXONE D TABLET if you are planning to become pregnant or if you have problems getting pregnant because this medicine makes it more difficult to become pregnant.
METAXONE D TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking METAXONE D TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizziness, drowsiness, sleepiness, tiredness and problems with your vision after taking METAXONE D TABLET.
Consumption of alcohol is not recommended during management with METAXONE D TABLET because it may enhance the effects of alcohol and cause dangerous side effects.

METAXONE D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease and should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking METAXONE D TABLET.

METAXONE D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease and should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking METAXONE D TABLET.
Do not take METAXONE D TABLET if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to Diclofenac or Metaxalone or aspirin or ibuprofen or any other NSAID such as naproxen and indomethacin.

METAXONE D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with lung disease such as asthma, breathing difficulties after taking nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) such as aspirin or ibuprofen. It should be used with caution in patients with asthma, long-term lung disease or lung infection. Consult your doctor before taking METAXONE D TABLET.

METAXONE D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart attack, blockages to blood vessels of the heart and should be used with caution in patients with heart problems, angina and high blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking METAXONE D TABLET.

Others

METAXONE D TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

An itchy or runny nose
Peptic ulceration (ulcer in your stomach or duodenum)
Stomach or intestinal bleeding (black tarry stools or vomiting blood)
Cerebrovascular disease such as stroke, mini stroke (TIA)
Blockages to blood vessels to the brain or an operation to clear or bypass blockages
Peripheral arterial disease (problems with your blood circulation)

Before taking METAXONE D TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Suffer from any stomach or bowel disorders such as ulcerative colitis, crohn's disease
Have condition called porphyria (symptoms such as discolouration of the urine, serious skin disorders, anaemia, abdominal pain and severe mental disorders)
Suffer from serious illness with blistering of the skin, mouth, eyes and genitals or connective tissue disorders such as lupus
Have skin rash, appearance of lesions
Suffer from nasal polyps
Are recovering from major surgery
Are a smoker
Suffer from diabetes
Blood clots, raised cholesterol or raised triglycerides
Are going to have surgery of the stomach or intestinal tract
Seasonal allergic rhinitis

Use in pediatrics:

METAXONE D TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.  

 Use in geriatrics:

METAXONE D TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above), usually initiating the management with the lowest effective dose. In elderly patients with stomach problems, doctor may prescribe another medicine to protect the stomach during management with this medicine. Consult your doctor before taking METAXONE D TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About LOBASET 10MG TABLET

LOBASET 10MG TABLET contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking LOBASET 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

LOBASET 10MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with LOBASET 10MG TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

LOBASET 10MG TABLET may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking LOBASET 10MG TABLET are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking LOBASET 10MG TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LOBASET 10MG TABLET
Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How LOBASET 10MG TABLET Works

LOBASET 10MG TABLET is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use LOBASET 10MG TABLET

Take LOBASET 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking LOBASET 10MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

introduction:
Introduction About FLEXABENZ GEL

FLEXABENZ GEL is a combination of Cyclobenzaprine, Diclofenac, Linseed Oil, Menthol and Methyl Salicylate which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants, Non-Steroidal Anti- Inflammatory drugs, Cooling agents and Analgesics. It is used to relieve from the discomfort associated with acute, painful musculoskeletal conditions such as rigidity, tension, stiffness and muscle spasms.

Before using FLEXABENZ GEL tell your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, heart diseases, any allergies, pre-existing diseases, and current health conditions. There are limited information on the use of FLEXABENZ GEL in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before using FLEXABENZ GEL.

Caution must be exercised while using FLEXABENZ GEL in elderly patients. The most common side effects of using FLEXABENZ GEL are skin rash, redness, itchiness (pruritis), general skin inflammation (eczema) and inflammation of the skin at the site of application that is characterised by swelling, rash, or papules (dermatitis, contact dermatitis). Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms doesn’t improve or worsens.
uses: It is used to relieve from the discomfort associated with acute, painful musculoskeletal conditions such as rigidity, tension, stiffness and muscle spasms
usesDetails:
Uses Of FLEXABENZ GEL
It is used to relieve from the discomfort associated with acute, painful musculoskeletal conditions such as rigidity, tension, stiffness and muscle spasms
mechanismOfAction:
How FLEXABENZ GEL Works

[GBKEYWORD] works by blocking the nerve signals of pain sensation, where Cyclobenzaprine causes muscle relaxation by inhibiting 5-Hydroxytryptophan (5-HT2). Diclofenac and Methyl salicylate works by reducing the effects of prostaglandin (substance produced during injury and inflammation causing pain) thereby blocking the pain signals between the brain and nerve endings. Linseed oil helps to reduce inflammation by inhibiting certain chemical substances and strengthens the blood vessel walls thereby reducing fluid leakage. Menthol provides a cooling effect on the skin by causing blood vessels dilatation and it also increase the penetration the medicine into the skin.
usageDetails:
How to use FLEXABENZ GEL

Apply FLEXABENZ GEL as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of the medicine and gently massage FLEXABENZ GEL on the affected area.

introduction:
Introduction About MIOFREE ET 8 TABLET

MIOFREE ET 8 TABLET is a combination of Etoricoxib and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) and Muscle relaxants. It is used to reduce pain and swelling in the joints and muscles in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, gout and muscle spasm. This medicine is also used for the short-term management after dental surgery for moderate pain. Muscle spasm is the rapid spontaneous contractions of the muscle, which can be painful and uncomfortable. When the nerve impulses are damaged or interrupted that control muscle movement, it could lead to muscle spasms. Symptoms include muscle tightness, joint stiffness, unusual posture, difficulty in moving and pain in affected muscles and joints.

MIOFREE ET 8 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having inflammatory bowel disease, severe congestive heart failure, peptic ulcer or cerebrovascular disease. Consult your doctor for advice. Before taking MIOFREE ET 8 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have blood disorders, kidney problems, liver problems or heart problems.

MIOFREE ET 8 TABLET is not recommended to use among pregnant and breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of this medicine are stomach pain, dry socket, edema, dizziness, headache, palpitations, arrhythmia, constipation, diarrhea, indigestion, gastritis, nausea and vomiting. Consult your doctor if the above side effects worsens or persist for a longer duration.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience dizziness or sleepiness. Consult your doctor for advice.

MIOFREE ET 8 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor for advice.
MIOFREE ET 8 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver problems. Consult your doctor for advice.

Others

Have stomach ulcer or bleeding in the stomach or intestines
Have Crohn’s disease, Ulcerative colitis, or Colitis (inflammatory bowel disease)
Have any kind of stroke, and muscles problems
Have peripheral arterial disease

Tell your physician before taking this medicine if you:

Had dehydration (a prolonged bout of vomiting or diarrhea)
Had swelling due to fluid retention
Have being managed for an infection
Have high cholesterol, diabetes
Are a smoker
Have epilepsy

introduction:
Introduction About THIOSPAS 4 CAPSULE

THIOSPAS 4 CAPSULEcontains Thiocolchicoside, which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used in adults and adolescents over 16 years of age to manage painful muscle contractions and for acute painful conditions related to the spine. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of your muscles. They’re common, involuntary, and unpredictable. The symptoms may include swelling, pain, stiffness, tenderness, and fatigue.

Your doctor may advise you to take relevant tests to understand your condition. Before taking THIOSPAS 4 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have flaccid paralysis (sagging of the face), muscular hypotonia (weak muscles), diarrhoea, lactose intolerance, seizure, or epilepsy.

THIOSPAS 4 CAPSULE is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. THIOSPAS 4 CAPSULE should not be used by children or adolescents under the age of 16. The most common side effects of taking THIOSPAS 4 CAPSULE are skin allergic reactions, drowsiness, diarrhea, and gastric symptoms. Consult your doctor if your symptoms get worse or persist.
uses: Acute painful conditions related to the spine
usesDetails:
Uses Of THIOSPAS 4 CAPSULE
Painful muscle contractions
Acute painful conditions related to the spine
mechanismOfAction:
How THIOSPAS 4 CAPSULE Works

THIOSPAS 4 CAPSULE works through selective binding to the GABA-A receptor (neurotransmitter). It manages muscle contractions by activating the GABA-inhibitory motor pathway and inhibiting the glycine receptors (neurotransmitters). Thus, relaxing the muscle pain and spasms.
usageDetails:
How to use THIOSPAS 4 CAPSULE

Take THIOSPAS 4 CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TOLKEM D TABLET

TOLKEM D TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac and Tolperisone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Skeletal Muscle relaxants respectively. It is used in adults to manage painful muscle spasms.

It can also be used to manage back pain (Ex. ankylosing spondylitis), joint pain and swelling (Ex. osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis), neck pain, sports injuries and sprains.

Take TOLKEM D TABLET with or just after meals. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with TOLKEM D TABLET to achieve better results. Before taking TOLKEM D TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your lung, liver, kidney, heart or stomach.

You much also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, asthma or COPD, bleeding disorders or any allergic conditions (such as skin rash, itching or watery eyes, repeated sneezing, nasal congestion and nasal itching) as a precaution.

TOLKEM D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe bleeding, perforation or ulcers in the stomach or intestines. Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of taking TOLKEM D TABLET dizziness, headache, spinning sensation, nausea, vomiting, indigestion, stomach pain, heartburn, flatulence, loss of appetite, increased liver enzymes and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Joint pain, back pain, neck pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of TOLKEM D TABLET

It is used in adults to manage:

Painful muscle spasms
Joint pain, back pain, neck pain
Sprains, sports injury
mechanismOfAction:
How TOLKEM D TABLET Works

TOLKEM D TABLET contains two medicines namely diclofenac and Tolperisone. Diclofenac is a pain-relieving medication. It acts by blocking the production of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain and inflammation.

Tolperisone is a muscle relaxant. It relaxes skeletal muscles by acting on certain centres of the brain and the spinal cord that controls muscle movements. As a result, TOLKEM D TABLET relieves muscle pain and joint pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TOLKEM D TABLET

Always take TOLKEM D TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. TOLKEM D TABLET should be taken with or after food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

warnings.details: TOLKEM D TABLET should not be taken by pregnant women especially during the last 3 months of pregnancy. Therefore, inform your doctor before taking it.
TOLKEM D TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy or drowsy after taking TOLKEM D TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TOLKEM D TABLET to avoid the risk of side effects.

TOLKEM D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney diseases (such as kidney failure). It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

TOLKEM D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver diseases (such as liver failure). It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take TOLKEM D TABLET if you are allergic to Diclofenac or Tolperisone.

TOLKEM D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with asthma or breathing difficulties. It should be used with caution in patients with infections of the respiratory tract. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

TOLKEM D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with congestive heart failure, or heart attack. It should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

The safety and effectiveness of TOLKEM D TABLET is not well established in children. Therefore, it is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 15 years). It can be used in adolescents aged 15 years or above if prescribed by the physician.
TOLKEM D TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

TOLKEM D TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have myasthenia gravis (severe muscle weakness)
Have bleeding, holes or ulcers in the stomach or intestines
Have peripheral arterial disease
Have problems in blood circulation in the body
Have allergic rhinitis (repeated sneezing, nasal itching, watery eyes)
Have urticaria (skin rash with itching)

Before taking TOLKEM D TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have high blood cholesterol levels
Have diabetes mellitus
Are a smoker
Have a history of bleeding inside the brain
Have a history of stomach ulcer or inflammation particularly if complicated with haemorrhage (bleeding) or perforation
Have ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease
Have bleeding problems
Recently had or going to have a surgery in the stomach or intestines

introduction:
Introduction About BACLOF OD 30MG TABLET

BACLOF OD 30MG TABLET contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking BACLOF OD 30MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

BACLOF OD 30MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with BACLOF OD 30MG TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

BACLOF OD 30MG TABLET may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking BACLOF OD 30MG TABLET are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking BACLOF OD 30MG TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BACLOF OD 30MG TABLET
Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How BACLOF OD 30MG TABLET Works

BACLOF OD 30MG TABLET is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use BACLOF OD 30MG TABLET

Take BACLOF OD 30MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking BACLOF OD 30MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

introduction:
Introduction About THIOSPAS A 4 TABLET

THIOSPAS A 4 TABLET is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

THIOSPAS A 4 TABLET is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, THIOSPAS A 4 TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking THIOSPAS A 4 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take THIOSPAS A 4 TABLET if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking THIOSPAS A 4 TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take THIOSPAS A 4 TABLET only as advised by your doctor. Do not take THIOSPAS A 4 TABLET longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with THIOSPAS A 4 TABLET to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking THIOSPAS A 4 TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Collectively, THIOSPAS A 4 TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

introduction:
Introduction About TOLMOVE 450MG TABLET

TOLMOVE 450MG TABLET contains Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle Relaxants. It is used to relieve painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of the muscles. Symptoms include muscular weakness, tingling or prickling sensation, pain or discomfort.

TOLMOVE 450MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver or kidney impairment, galactose intolerance, the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption and myasthenia gravis. TOLMOVE 450MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney impairment.

TOLMOVE 450MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. TOLMOVE 450MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age) and in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking TOLMOVE 450MG TABLET are muscle weakness, headache, nausea, indigestion and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles

Uses Of TOLMOVE 450MG TABLET
Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
mechanismOfAction:
How TOLMOVE 450MG TABLET Works

TOLMOVE 450MG TABLET works by blocking the voltage-gated sodium channel in the brain stem thereby causing muscle relaxation and stopping the pain signals between nerve and brain. It also relieves pain by increasing the blood supply to skeletal muscles.

Take TOLMOVE 450MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with plenty of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking TOLMOVE 450MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.
