TOLMOVE 450MG TABLET may cause dizziness, sleepiness, attention disturbance, muscle weakness, fits or blurred vision after taking TOLMOVE 450MG TABLET. If you experience any such side effects consult your doctor for advice.

TOLMOVE 450MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and kidney function in patients with moderate kidney impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TOLMOVE 450MG TABLET.

Galactose intolerance

Myasthenia gravis

TOLMOVE 450MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age). Your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon age and body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

introduction:
Introduction About ACENAC MR 4MG TABLET

ACENAC MR 4MG TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs and Muscle relaxants. ACENAC MR 4MG TABLET is used in adults for the management of acute inflammatory and painful conditions associated with muscle spasms, such as lower back pain, muscle spasm due to any injury, neck and shoulder pain, sciatica (type of nerve pain), degenerative vertebral disorders, ankylosing spondylitis (chronic back pain due to fusion of some bones of the spine), osteoarthritis, and rheumatoid arthritis.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking ACENAC MR 4MG TABLET. ACENAC MR 4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from stomach ulcers, intestinal bleeding or have a history of stomach ulcers, severe kidney problems, liver failure, bleeding disorders, peripheral arterial disease (problem with blood circulation), heart problems such as heart attack, stroke, blockages in blood vessels of brain or heart or had a history of heart surgery for clearing blockages, rare hereditary problems of galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption, therefore consult your doctor before taking.

ACENAC MR 4MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver and kidney problems, seizures, stomach and bowel disorders, asthma or breathing problems, blood disorders (porphyria), recovering from major surgery, and alcohol dependence. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

ACENAC MR 4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women; therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. ACENAC MR 4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 16 years of age. ACENAC MR 4MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (>65 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects after taking ACENAC MR 4MG TABLET are dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea, drowsiness, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any side effects or an allergic reaction after taking this medicine.

mechanismOfAction:
How ACENAC MR 4MG TABLET Works

ACENAC MR 4MG TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside, which work together to reduce pain and inflammation. Paracetamol and aceclofenac stop the formation of pain and inflammation-causing chemicals called prostaglandins, and thiocolchicoside acts in the brain and spinal cord on GABA receptors and helps to relieve muscle stiffness and muscle spasms.

Take ACENAC MR 4MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Take ACENAC MR 4MG TABLET with meals or after meals. Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration of management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About LIOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE

LIOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking LIOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

LIOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with LIOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

LIOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking LIOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking LIOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LIOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE
Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How LIOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE Works

LIOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use LIOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE

Take LIOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking LIOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

SIGNOFLAM TH 8 TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs and Muscle relaxants. SIGNOFLAM TH 8 TABLET is used in adults for the management of acute inflammatory and painful conditions associated with muscle spasms, such as lower back pain, muscle spasm due to any injury, neck and shoulder pain, sciatica (type of nerve pain), degenerative vertebral disorders, ankylosing spondylitis (chronic back pain due to fusion of some bones of the spine), osteoarthritis, and rheumatoid arthritis.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking SIGNOFLAM TH 8 TABLET. SIGNOFLAM TH 8 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from stomach ulcers, intestinal bleeding or have a history of stomach ulcers, severe kidney problems, liver failure, bleeding disorders, peripheral arterial disease (problem with blood circulation), heart problems such as heart attack, stroke, blockages in blood vessels of brain or heart or had a history of heart surgery for clearing blockages, rare hereditary problems of galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption, therefore consult your doctor before taking.

SIGNOFLAM TH 8 TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver and kidney problems, seizures, stomach and bowel disorders, asthma or breathing problems, blood disorders (porphyria), recovering from major surgery, and alcohol dependence. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

SIGNOFLAM TH 8 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women; therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. SIGNOFLAM TH 8 TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 16 years of age. SIGNOFLAM TH 8 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (>65 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects after taking SIGNOFLAM TH 8 TABLET are dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea, drowsiness, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any side effects or an allergic reaction after taking this medicine.

mechanismOfAction:
How SIGNOFLAM TH 8 TABLET Works

SIGNOFLAM TH 8 TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside, which work together to reduce pain and inflammation. Paracetamol and aceclofenac stop the formation of pain and inflammation-causing chemicals called prostaglandins, and thiocolchicoside acts in the brain and spinal cord on GABA receptors and helps to relieve muscle stiffness and muscle spasms.
usageDetails:
How to use SIGNOFLAM TH 8 TABLET

Take SIGNOFLAM TH 8 TABLET as advised by your physician. Take SIGNOFLAM TH 8 TABLET with meals or after meals. Swallow SIGNOFLAM TH 8 TABLET as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration of management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

SIGNOFLAM TH 8 TABLET is not recommended for patients suffering from heart problems such as angina, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Stomach ulcers, intestinal bleeding or have a history of stomach ulcers
Bleeding disorders
Peripheral arterial disease (problem with blood circulation)
Blockages in blood vessels of the brain
Rare hereditary problems of galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption

Before taking SIGNOFLAM TH 8 TABLET inform your doctor if you have:

Seizures
Stomach and bowel disorders such as ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease (inflammatory bowel diseases), ulceration, bleeding or perforation in the gut or bowel

Smoking habit

name: BOLOFEN XL 20mg Capsule 10's
introduction:
Introduction About BOLOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE

BOLOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking BOLOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

BOLOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with BOLOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

BOLOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking BOLOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking BOLOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BOLOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE
Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How BOLOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE Works

BOLOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use BOLOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE

Take BOLOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking BOLOFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

name: ETORO TH Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ETORO TH TABLET

ETORO TH TABLET is a combination of Etoricoxib and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) and Muscle relaxants. It is used to reduce pain and swelling in the joints and muscles in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, gout and muscle spasm. This medicine is also used for the short-term management after dental surgery for moderate pain. Muscle spasm is the rapid spontaneous contractions of the muscle, which can be painful and uncomfortable. When the nerve impulses are damaged or interrupted that control muscle movement, it could lead to muscle spasms. Symptoms include muscle tightness, joint stiffness, unusual posture, difficulty in moving and pain in affected muscles and joints.

ETORO TH TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having inflammatory bowel disease, severe congestive heart failure, peptic ulcer or cerebrovascular disease. Consult your doctor for advice. Before taking ETORO TH TABLET, inform your doctor if you have blood disorders, kidney problems, liver problems or heart problems.

introduction:
Introduction About THICHOREN 4MG CAPSULE

THICHOREN 4MG CAPSULEcontains Thiocolchicoside, which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used in adults and adolescents over 16 years of age to manage painful muscle contractions and for acute painful conditions related to the spine. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of your muscles. They’re common, involuntary, and unpredictable. The symptoms may include swelling, pain, stiffness, tenderness, and fatigue.

Your doctor may advise you to take relevant tests to understand your condition. Before taking THICHOREN 4MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have flaccid paralysis (sagging of the face), muscular hypotonia (weak muscles), diarrhoea, lactose intolerance, seizure, or epilepsy.

THICHOREN 4MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. THICHOREN 4MG CAPSULE should not be used by children or adolescents under the age of 16. The most common side effects of taking THICHOREN 4MG CAPSULE are skin allergic reactions, drowsiness, diarrhea, and gastric symptoms. Consult your doctor if your symptoms get worse or persist.
uses: Acute painful conditions related to the spine
usesDetails:
Uses Of THICHOREN 4MG CAPSULE
Painful muscle contractions
Acute painful conditions related to the spine
mechanismOfAction:
How THICHOREN 4MG CAPSULE Works

THICHOREN 4MG CAPSULE works through selective binding to the GABA-A receptor (neurotransmitter). It manages muscle contractions by activating the GABA-inhibitory motor pathway and inhibiting the glycine receptors (neurotransmitters). Thus, relaxing the muscle pain and spasms.
usageDetails:
How to use THICHOREN 4MG CAPSULE

Take THICHOREN 4MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Synaptol SR 300mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET

SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET contains Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle Relaxants. It is used to relieve painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of the muscles. Symptoms include muscular weakness, tingling or prickling sensation, pain or discomfort.

SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver or kidney impairment, galactose intolerance, the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption and myasthenia gravis. SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney impairment.

SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age) and in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET are muscle weakness, headache, nausea, indigestion and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
usesDetails:
Uses Of SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET
Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
mechanismOfAction:
How SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET Works

SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET works by blocking the voltage-gated sodium channel in the brain stem thereby causing muscle relaxation and stopping the pain signals between nerve and brain. It also relieves pain by increasing the blood supply to skeletal muscles.
usageDetails:
How to use SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET

Take SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with plenty of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.
sideEffects: Hypersensitivity reactions (signs include rash, redness of the skin, itching, shortness of breath, swelling underneath the skin, increased heart rate or low blood pressure)

warnings.details: SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET.
SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET.

SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET may cause dizziness, sleepiness, attention disturbance, muscle weakness, fits or blurred vision after taking SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET. If you experience any such side effects consult your doctor for advice.

SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and kidney function in patients with moderate kidney impairment. Consult your doctor before taking SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET.

SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with liver impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and the dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and liver function in patients with moderate liver impairment. Consult your doctor before taking SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET.

SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Tolperisone or any other ingredients of this medicine. It should be used with caution in patients who are allergic to lidocaine (due to cross-reactions).

Others

SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Galactose intolerance
The Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption
Myasthenia gravis

Use in pediatrics:

SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age). Your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon age and body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

The dose of the SYNAPTOL SR 300MG TABLET should be adjusted in the elderly. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Introduction About BACLESTA OD 30 TABLET

BACLESTA OD 30 TABLET contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking BACLESTA OD 30 TABLET inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

BACLESTA OD 30 TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with BACLESTA OD 30 TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

BACLESTA OD 30 TABLET may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking BACLESTA OD 30 TABLET are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking BACLESTA OD 30 TABLET.

Uses Of BACLESTA OD 30 TABLET
Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How BACLESTA OD 30 TABLET Works

BACLESTA OD 30 TABLET is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use BACLESTA OD 30 TABLET

Take BACLESTA OD 30 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking BACLESTA OD 30 TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

introduction:
Introduction About TOLPERITAS D TABLET

TOLPERITAS D TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac and Tolperisone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Skeletal Muscle relaxants respectively. It is used in adults to manage painful muscle spasms.

It can also be used to manage back pain (Ex. ankylosing spondylitis), joint pain and swelling (Ex. osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis), neck pain, sports injuries and sprains.

Take TOLPERITAS D TABLET with or just after meals. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with TOLPERITAS D TABLET to achieve better results. Before taking TOLPERITAS D TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your lung, liver, kidney, heart or stomach.

You much also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, asthma or COPD, bleeding disorders or any allergic conditions (such as skin rash, itching or watery eyes, repeated sneezing, nasal congestion and nasal itching) as a precaution.

TOLPERITAS D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe bleeding, perforation or ulcers in the stomach or intestines. Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of taking TOLPERITAS D TABLET dizziness, headache, spinning sensation, nausea, vomiting, indigestion, stomach pain, heartburn, flatulence, loss of appetite, increased liver enzymes and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Joint pain, back pain, neck pain

mechanismOfAction:
How TOLPERITAS D TABLET Works

TOLPERITAS D TABLET contains two medicines namely diclofenac and Tolperisone. Diclofenac is a pain-relieving medication. It acts by blocking the production of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain and inflammation.

Tolperisone is a muscle relaxant. It relaxes skeletal muscles by acting on certain centres of the brain and the spinal cord that controls muscle movements. As a result, TOLPERITAS D TABLET relieves muscle pain and joint pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TOLPERITAS D TABLET

Always take TOLPERITAS D TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. TOLPERITAS D TABLET should be taken with or after food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

TOLPERITAS D TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy or drowsy after taking TOLPERITAS D TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TOLPERITAS D TABLET to avoid the risk of side effects.

TOLPERITAS D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney diseases (such as kidney failure). It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

TOLPERITAS D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver diseases (such as liver failure). It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take TOLPERITAS D TABLET if you are allergic to Diclofenac or Tolperisone.

TOLPERITAS D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with asthma or breathing difficulties. It should be used with caution in patients with infections of the respiratory tract. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

TOLPERITAS D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with congestive heart failure, or heart attack. It should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

The safety and effectiveness of TOLPERITAS D TABLET is not well established in children. Therefore, it is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 15 years). It can be used in adolescents aged 15 years or above if prescribed by the physician.
TOLPERITAS D TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

TOLPERITAS D TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have myasthenia gravis (severe muscle weakness)
Have bleeding, holes or ulcers in the stomach or intestines
Have peripheral arterial disease
Have problems in blood circulation in the body
Have allergic rhinitis (repeated sneezing, nasal itching, watery eyes)
Have urticaria (skin rash with itching)

Before taking TOLPERITAS D TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have high blood cholesterol levels
Have diabetes mellitus
Are a smoker
Have a history of bleeding inside the brain
Have a history of stomach ulcer or inflammation particularly if complicated with haemorrhage (bleeding) or perforation
Have ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease
Have bleeding problems
Recently had or going to have a surgery in the stomach or intestines

introduction:
Introduction About TOLAGIN 4MG TABLET

TOLAGIN 4MG TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs and Muscle relaxants. TOLAGIN 4MG TABLET is used in adults for the management of acute inflammatory and painful conditions associated with muscle spasms, such as lower back pain, muscle spasm due to any injury, neck and shoulder pain, sciatica (type of nerve pain), degenerative vertebral disorders, ankylosing spondylitis (chronic back pain due to fusion of some bones of the spine), osteoarthritis, and rheumatoid arthritis.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking TOLAGIN 4MG TABLET. TOLAGIN 4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from stomach ulcers, intestinal bleeding or have a history of stomach ulcers, severe kidney problems, liver failure, bleeding disorders, peripheral arterial disease (problem with blood circulation), heart problems such as heart attack, stroke, blockages in blood vessels of brain or heart or had a history of heart surgery for clearing blockages, rare hereditary problems of galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption, therefore consult your doctor before taking.

TOLAGIN 4MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver and kidney problems, seizures, stomach and bowel disorders, asthma or breathing problems, blood disorders (porphyria), recovering from major surgery, and alcohol dependence. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

TOLAGIN 4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women; therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. TOLAGIN 4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 16 years of age. TOLAGIN 4MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (>65 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects after taking TOLAGIN 4MG TABLET are dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea, drowsiness, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any side effects or an allergic reaction after taking this medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About RELADOL P TABLET

RELADOL P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Muscle relaxants respectively. It is used for the management of patients with acute painful musculoskeletal conditions.

RELADOL P TABLET is not recommended for use if you have myasthenia gravis. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

Before taking RELADOL P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have peptic ulcer disease, gastrointestinal perforation, bleeding and anemia. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

RELADOL P TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women (especially during first three months) and breastfeeding women, unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of taking RELADOL P TABLET are muscle weakness, headache, low blood pressure, nausea, vomiting, dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage patients with acute painful musculoskeletal conditions

Uses Of RELADOL P TABLET
Used to manage patients with acute painful musculoskeletal conditions
mechanismOfAction:
How RELADOL P TABLET Works

RELADOL P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tolperisone that works by blocking chemical messengers in the brain, which are responsible for inflammatory signs such as pain, increased temperature. Tolperisone works on the spinal cord and brain to relieve contraction or muscle stiffness without a decrease in strength and increases the blood supply to the muscles. These actions together provide relief from painful muscle spasm and spastic conditions.

name: TOLMENTA 150 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TOLMENTA 150 TABLET

TOLMENTA 150 TABLET contains Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle Relaxants. It is used to relieve painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of the muscles. Symptoms include muscular weakness, tingling or prickling sensation, pain or discomfort.

TOLMENTA 150 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver or kidney impairment, galactose intolerance, the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption and myasthenia gravis. TOLMENTA 150 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney impairment.

TOLMENTA 150 TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. TOLMENTA 150 TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age) and in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking TOLMENTA 150 TABLET are muscle weakness, headache, nausea, indigestion and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
usesDetails:
Uses Of TOLMENTA 150 TABLET
Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
mechanismOfAction:
How TOLMENTA 150 TABLET Works

TOLMENTA 150 TABLET works by blocking the voltage-gated sodium channel in the brain stem thereby causing muscle relaxation and stopping the pain signals between nerve and brain. It also relieves pain by increasing the blood supply to skeletal muscles.

How to use TOLMENTA 150 TABLET

Take TOLMENTA 150 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with plenty of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking TOLMENTA 150 TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

TOLMENTA 150 TABLET may cause dizziness, sleepiness, attention disturbance, muscle weakness, fits or blurred vision after taking TOLMENTA 150 TABLET. If you experience any such side effects consult your doctor for advice.

TOLMENTA 150 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and kidney function in patients with moderate kidney impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TOLMENTA 150 TABLET.

TOLMENTA 150 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with liver impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and the dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and liver function in patients with moderate liver impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TOLMENTA 150 TABLET.

TOLMENTA 150 TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Tolperisone or any other ingredients of this medicine. It should be used with caution in patients who are allergic to lidocaine (due to cross-reactions).

Others

TOLMENTA 150 TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Galactose intolerance
The Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption
Myasthenia gravis

TOLMENTA 150 TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age). Your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon age and body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The dose of the TOLMENTA 150 TABLET should be adjusted in the elderly. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About ZIX MR 4MG TABLET

ZIX MR 4MG TABLET is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

ZIX MR 4MG TABLET is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, ZIX MR 4MG TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking ZIX MR 4MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take ZIX MR 4MG TABLET if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking ZIX MR 4MG TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take ZIX MR 4MG TABLET only as advised by your doctor. Do not take ZIX MR 4MG TABLET longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with ZIX MR 4MG TABLET to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking ZIX MR 4MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ACIMOL MR TABLET

ACIMOL MR TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac, Chlorzoxazone and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Muscle relaxants respectively. It is used to manage muscular pains and spasms. It can also be used to provide relief from joint pain (Ex. osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis) and back pain (Ex. ankylosing spondylitis).

Take ACIMOL MR TABLET preferably with meals to avoid gut irritation. Avoid consumption of alcohol as it could aggravate the risk of stomach problems. Do not take ACIMOL MR TABLET if you have any ulcers, bleeding or perforations in the gut.

Before taking ACIMOL MR TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, high blood cholesterol, any inflammation in the bowel or intestines, blood clots, bleeding problems or a previous history of stomach ulcers as a precaution.

ACIMOL MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver failure or stroke. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of taking ACIMOL MR TABLET are nausea, vomiting, indigestion, heartburn and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ACIMOL MR TABLET

It is used to manage:

Muscle pain and spasms
Joint pain and back pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ACIMOL MR TABLET Works

ACIMOL MR TABLET contains three medicines namely Chlorzoxazone, Aceclofenac and paracetamol. Chlorzoxazone is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the brain and in spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.

Aceclofenac and paracetamol are analgesic agents. They provide pain relief by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, inflammation and swelling. Collectively, these action helps in reducing muscle spasms, joint pain and inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use ACIMOL MR TABLET

Take ACIMOL MR TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with meals to avoid gastric irritation.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

SETOLAC MR 200 TABLET contains Etodolac which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs). SETOLAC MR 200 TABLET is used in adults for acute pain management, for relieving pain, stiffness and reducing inflammation associated with conditions such as osteoarthritis and rheumatoid arthritis.

Rheumatoid arthritis is a chronic condition affecting hands, feet and wrists joints and causing pain, swelling and stiffness of joints. Osteoarthritis is a progressive bone disorder affecting joints and causing pain and joint stiffness.

During long term management with SETOLAC MR 200 TABLET, your doctor might order some investigations such as complete hemogram, liver function tests, kidney function tests to ensure better management outcomes.

Avoid consuming alcohol and smoking while taking SETOLAC MR 200 TABLET as it may increase the risk of stomach ulcers and bleeding.

SETOLAC MR 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who experienced allergic reaction, gastrointestinal bleeding, perforation after taking any other NSAID’s such as ibuprofen, aspirin, suffering from stomach ulcers, stomach bleeding or perforation, severe heart failure, liver failure, kidney failure or those who are in setting of coronary artery bypass graft surgery. Consult your doctor before taking.

SETOLAC MR 200 TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from high blood pressure, heart disorders (such as myocardial infarction, stroke), patients at risk of developing ulcerative colitis, Crohn’s disease, pre-existing kidney disease, asthma, blood disorders, diabetes, high cholesterol, mixed connective tissue disorder such as lupus and fluid retention (swelling of legs, ankles, feet).

SETOLAC MR 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless clearly necessary, therefore, consult your doctor before taking.

SETOLAC MR 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents less than 18 years of age as its safety and effectiveness is not yet established.

The most common side effects after taking SETOLAC MR 200 TABLET are abdominal pain, diarrhoea, dyspepsia, flatulence, bloating, vomiting. Consult your doctor immediately in case any of the side effects worsens or you experience allergic reaction after taking SETOLAC MR 200 TABLET.

Introduction About SIGNOFLAM TH 4 TABLET

SIGNOFLAM TH 4 TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs and Muscle relaxants. SIGNOFLAM TH 4 TABLET is used in adults for the management of acute inflammatory and painful conditions associated with muscle spasms, such as lower back pain, muscle spasm due to any injury, neck and shoulder pain, sciatica (type of nerve pain), degenerative vertebral disorders, ankylosing spondylitis (chronic back pain due to fusion of some bones of the spine), osteoarthritis, and rheumatoid arthritis.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking SIGNOFLAM TH 4 TABLET. SIGNOFLAM TH 4 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from stomach ulcers, intestinal bleeding or have a history of stomach ulcers, severe kidney problems, liver failure, bleeding disorders, peripheral arterial disease (problem with blood circulation), heart problems such as heart attack, stroke, blockages in blood vessels of brain or heart or had a history of heart surgery for clearing blockages, rare hereditary problems of galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption, therefore consult your doctor before taking.

SIGNOFLAM TH 4 TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver and kidney problems, seizures, stomach and bowel disorders, asthma or breathing problems, blood disorders (porphyria), recovering from major surgery, and alcohol dependence. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

SIGNOFLAM TH 4 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women; therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. SIGNOFLAM TH 4 TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 16 years of age. SIGNOFLAM TH 4 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (>65 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects after taking SIGNOFLAM TH 4 TABLET are dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea, drowsiness, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any side effects or an allergic reaction after taking this medicine.

mechanismOfAction:
How SIGNOFLAM TH 4 TABLET Works

SIGNOFLAM TH 4 TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside, which work together to reduce pain and inflammation. Paracetamol and aceclofenac stop the formation of pain and inflammation-causing chemicals called prostaglandins, and thiocolchicoside acts in the brain and spinal cord on GABA receptors and helps to relieve muscle stiffness and muscle spasms.

name: Myoril Injection 2ml
introduction:
Introduction About MYORIL INJECTION

MYORIL INJECTIONcontains Thiocolchicoside, which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used in adults and adolescents 16 years of age and older as an add-on therapy for painful muscle contractions and acute painful conditions related to the spine.

Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of your muscles. They’re usually common, involuntary, and unpredictable. The symptoms may include swelling, pain, stiffness, tenderness, and fatigue.

Before receiving MYORIL INJECTION inform your doctor if you have flaccid paralysis (sagging of the face), muscular hypotonia (weak muscles), diarrhoea, lactose intolerance, seizure or epilepsy. MYORIL INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women.

MYORIL INJECTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 16 years of age. The most common side effects of receiving MYORIL INJECTION are skin allergic reactions, drowsiness, diarrhea and gastric symptoms. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.
uses: Manage acute painful conditions related to the spine
usesDetails:
Uses Of MYORIL INJECTION
Manage painful muscle contractions
Manage acute painful conditions related to the spine
mechanismOfAction:
How MYORIL INJECTION Works

MYORIL INJECTION works through selective binding to the GABA-A receptor (neurotransmitter). It manages muscle contractions by activating the GABA-inhibitory motor pathway and inhibiting the glycine receptors (neurotransmitters). Thus, relaxing the muscle pain and spasms.
usageDetails:
How to use MYORIL INJECTION

MYORIL INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the muscles (intramuscularly). Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Etogesic MR 4mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ETOGESIC MR 4MG TABLET

ETOGESIC MR 4MG TABLET is a combination of Etodolac and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and Skeletal muscle relaxants. It is used in the management of osteoarthritis (the most common form of arthritis that occurs when cartilage wears down over time resulting in joint pain and stiffness), painful syndromes of the vertebral column(lower back and neck pain along with muscle stiffness that restricts range of motion and normal posture), rheumatism not related to joint (pain and discomfort are seen but it does damage the joints for long term), painful and muscle spasms due to injury and surgical interventions in adults.

ETOGESIC MR 4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having heart failure, peptic ulcer, relaxed paralysis, muscle hypotonia, undergone by-pass and cardiac surgery, allergic to aspirin or other NSAIDs drugs, pregnant women, breastfeeding women, children and adolescents (below 16 years of age).

Before using ETOGESIC MR 4MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any history of asthma, epilepsy, fluid retention, high blood pressure or impaired heart, kidney or liver function. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of ETOGESIC MR 4MG TABLET are dizziness, stomach pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting and diarrhoea. If any of these symptoms worsen, consult your doctor.
uses: Manage osteoarthritis, painful syndromes of the vertebral column, rheumatism not related to joint, painful muscle spasms in acute spinal pathologies and pain following trauma and surgical interventions
usesDetails:
Uses Of ETOGESIC MR 4MG TABLET
Manage osteoarthritis, painful syndromes of the vertebral column, rheumatism not related to joint, painful muscle spasms in acute spinal pathologies and pain following trauma and surgical interventions
mechanismOfAction:
How ETOGESIC MR 4MG TABLET Works

ETOGESIC MR 4MG TABLET is a combination of Etodolac, which works by blocking the release of some chemical substances in the body that are responsible for the pain and inflammation at the site of injury and thiocolchicoside, a skeletal muscle relaxant that modifies the action of a chemical substance produced in the brain with anti-inflammatory and pain-reducing properties to work in the brain and spinal cord. This collective action is useful in providing relief from pain and muscle stiffness or spasm.
usageDetails:
How to use ETOGESIC MR 4MG TABLET

Take ETOGESIC MR 4MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. The correct dose will be decided by the doctor based on the age, body weight and disease condition. Do not take more than the recommended dosage, as it may lead to side effects.

name: Instaflex At Capsule 5's
introduction:
Introduction About INSTAFLEX AT CAPSULE

INSTAFLEX AT CAPSULE is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

INSTAFLEX AT CAPSULE is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, INSTAFLEX AT CAPSULE relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking INSTAFLEX AT CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take INSTAFLEX AT CAPSULE if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking INSTAFLEX AT CAPSULE if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take INSTAFLEX AT CAPSULE only as advised by your doctor. Do not take INSTAFLEX AT CAPSULE longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with INSTAFLEX AT CAPSULE to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking INSTAFLEX AT CAPSULE are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About BACLOREN 20MG TABLET

BACLOREN 20MG TABLET contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking BACLOREN 20MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

BACLOREN 20MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with BACLOREN 20MG TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

BACLOREN 20MG TABLET may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking BACLOREN 20MG TABLET are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking BACLOREN 20MG TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BACLOREN 20MG TABLET
Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How BACLOREN 20MG TABLET Works

BACLOREN 20MG TABLET is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use BACLOREN 20MG TABLET

Take BACLOREN 20MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking BACLOREN 20MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

introduction:
Introduction About SAFRONAC MR TABLET

SAFRONAC MR TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac, Chlorzoxazone and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Muscle relaxants respectively. It is used to manage muscular pains and spasms. It can also be used to provide relief from joint pain (Ex. osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis) and back pain (Ex. ankylosing spondylitis).

Take SAFRONAC MR TABLET preferably with meals to avoid gut irritation. Avoid consumption of alcohol as it could aggravate the risk of stomach problems. Do not take SAFRONAC MR TABLET if you have any ulcers, bleeding or perforations in the gut.

Before taking SAFRONAC MR TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, high blood cholesterol, any inflammation in the bowel or intestines, blood clots, bleeding problems or a previous history of stomach ulcers as a precaution.

SAFRONAC MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver failure or stroke. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of taking SAFRONAC MR TABLET are nausea, vomiting, indigestion, heartburn and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SAFRONAC MR TABLET

It is used to manage:

Muscle pain and spasms
Joint pain and back pain
mechanismOfAction:
How SAFRONAC MR TABLET Works

SAFRONAC MR TABLET contains three medicines namely Chlorzoxazone, Aceclofenac and paracetamol. Chlorzoxazone is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the brain and in spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.

Aceclofenac and paracetamol are analgesic agents. They provide pain relief by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, inflammation and swelling. Collectively, these action helps in reducing muscle spasms, joint pain and inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use SAFRONAC MR TABLET

Take SAFRONAC MR TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with meals to avoid gastric irritation.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Myosone SR Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About MYOSONE SR TABLET

MYOSONE SR TABLET contains Eperisone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle Relaxants. It is used to manage and improve the myotonic condition of the muscles caused by neck-shoulder arm syndrome (a condition causing muscle pain and stiffness in the neck, arm, and shoulder region), scapulohumeral periarthritis (a condition causing muscle pain and stiffness in the shoulder joint), and low back pain (a painful condition affecting the lower region of the spine due to a muscle or ligament injury).

The myotonic condition causes wasting and weakness of the muscle when its functional ability to relax is impaired. It is also used to manage spastic paralysis (loss of muscle function along with pain and muscle stiffness) caused by a spinal or neurological disorder, trauma, cerebral palsy, tumour in the spine, etc.

MYOSONE SR TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver function disorders. MYOSONE SR TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy unless recommended by your doctor. MYOSONE SR TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. Its safety and efficiency for use in children have not been established. Consult your doctor for advice before taking MYOSONE SR TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking MYOSONE SR TABLET may include weakness, light-headedness, fatigue, sleepiness, insomnia, headache, nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, abdominal pain, diarrhea, constipation, and thirst. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persist.

introduction:
Introduction About BACK 10MG TABLET

BACK 10MG TABLET contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking BACK 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

BACK 10MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with BACK 10MG TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

BACK 10MG TABLET may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking BACK 10MG TABLET are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking BACK 10MG TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BACK 10MG TABLET
Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How BACK 10MG TABLET Works

BACK 10MG TABLET is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use BACK 10MG TABLET

Take BACK 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking BACK 10MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

name: RELADOL DSR Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About RELADOL DSR TABLET

RELADOL DSR TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac and Tolperisone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Skeletal Muscle relaxants respectively. It is used in adults to manage painful muscle spasms.

It can also be used to manage back pain (Ex. ankylosing spondylitis), joint pain and swelling (Ex. osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis), neck pain, sports injuries and sprains.

Take RELADOL DSR TABLET with or just after meals. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with RELADOL DSR TABLET to achieve better results. Before taking RELADOL DSR TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your lung, liver, kidney, heart or stomach.

You much also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, asthma or COPD, bleeding disorders or any allergic conditions (such as skin rash, itching or watery eyes, repeated sneezing, nasal congestion and nasal itching) as a precaution.

RELADOL DSR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe bleeding, perforation or ulcers in the stomach or intestines. Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of taking RELADOL DSR TABLET dizziness, headache, spinning sensation, nausea, vomiting, indigestion, stomach pain, heartburn, flatulence, loss of appetite, increased liver enzymes and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Joint pain, back pain, neck pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of RELADOL DSR TABLET

It is used in adults to manage:

Painful muscle spasms
Joint pain, back pain, neck pain
Sprains, sports injury
mechanismOfAction:
How RELADOL DSR TABLET Works

RELADOL DSR TABLET contains two medicines namely diclofenac and Tolperisone. Diclofenac is a pain-relieving medication. It acts by blocking the production of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain and inflammation.

Tolperisone is a muscle relaxant. It relaxes skeletal muscles by acting on certain centres of the brain and the spinal cord that controls muscle movements. As a result, RELADOL DSR TABLET relieves muscle pain and joint pain.
usageDetails:
How to use RELADOL DSR TABLET

Always take RELADOL DSR TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. RELADOL DSR TABLET should be taken with or after food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

RELADOL DSR TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy or drowsy after taking RELADOL DSR TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking RELADOL DSR TABLET to avoid the risk of side effects.

RELADOL DSR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney diseases (such as kidney failure). It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

RELADOL DSR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver diseases (such as liver failure). It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take RELADOL DSR TABLET if you are allergic to Diclofenac or Tolperisone.

RELADOL DSR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with asthma or breathing difficulties. It should be used with caution in patients with infections of the respiratory tract. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

RELADOL DSR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with congestive heart failure, or heart attack. It should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

The safety and effectiveness of RELADOL DSR TABLET is not well established in children. Therefore, it is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 15 years). It can be used in adolescents aged 15 years or above if prescribed by the physician.
RELADOL DSR TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

RELADOL DSR TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have myasthenia gravis (severe muscle weakness)
Have bleeding, holes or ulcers in the stomach or intestines
Have peripheral arterial disease
Have problems in blood circulation in the body
Have allergic rhinitis (repeated sneezing, nasal itching, watery eyes)
Have urticaria (skin rash with itching)

Before taking RELADOL DSR TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have high blood cholesterol levels
Have diabetes mellitus
Are a smoker
Have a history of bleeding inside the brain
Have a history of stomach ulcer or inflammation particularly if complicated with haemorrhage (bleeding) or perforation
Have ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease
Have bleeding problems
Recently had or going to have a surgery in the stomach or intestines

TOLEXANT P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Muscle relaxants respectively. It is used for the management of patients with acute painful musculoskeletal conditions.

Introduction About TOLAGIN 8MG TABLET

TOLAGIN 8MG TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs and Muscle relaxants. TOLAGIN 8MG TABLET is used in adults for the management of acute inflammatory and painful conditions associated with muscle spasms, such as lower back pain, muscle spasm due to any injury, neck and shoulder pain, sciatica (type of nerve pain), degenerative vertebral disorders, ankylosing spondylitis (chronic back pain due to fusion of some bones of the spine), osteoarthritis, and rheumatoid arthritis.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking TOLAGIN 8MG TABLET. TOLAGIN 8MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from stomach ulcers, intestinal bleeding or have a history of stomach ulcers, severe kidney problems, liver failure, bleeding disorders, peripheral arterial disease (problem with blood circulation), heart problems such as heart attack, stroke, blockages in blood vessels of brain or heart or had a history of heart surgery for clearing blockages, rare hereditary problems of galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption, therefore consult your doctor before taking.

TOLAGIN 8MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver and kidney problems, seizures, stomach and bowel disorders, asthma or breathing problems, blood disorders (porphyria), recovering from major surgery, and alcohol dependence. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

TOLAGIN 8MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women; therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. TOLAGIN 8MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 16 years of age. TOLAGIN 8MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (>65 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects after taking TOLAGIN 8MG TABLET are dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea, drowsiness, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any side effects or an allergic reaction after taking this medicine.

TOLAGIN 8MG TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside, which work together to reduce pain and inflammation. introduction:
Introduction About THIONOS A 4 TABLET

THIONOS A 4 TABLET is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

THIONOS A 4 TABLET is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, THIONOS A 4 TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking THIONOS A 4 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take THIONOS A 4 TABLET if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking THIONOS A 4 TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take THIONOS A 4 TABLET only as advised by your doctor. Do not take THIONOS A 4 TABLET longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with THIONOS A 4 TABLET to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking THIONOS A 4 TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About THIOQUEST A 4MG TABLET

THIOQUEST A 4MG TABLET is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

THIOQUEST A 4MG TABLET is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, THIOQUEST A 4MG TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking THIOQUEST A 4MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take THIOQUEST A 4MG TABLET if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking THIOQUEST A 4MG TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take THIOQUEST A 4MG TABLET only as advised by your doctor. Do not take THIOQUEST A 4MG TABLET longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with THIOQUEST A 4MG TABLET to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking THIOQUEST A 4MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ETOSPAZ MR 4 TABLET

ETOSPAZ MR 4 TABLET is a combination of Etoricoxib and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) and Muscle relaxants. It is used to reduce pain and swelling in the joints and muscles in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, gout and muscle spasm. This medicine is also used for the short-term management after dental surgery for moderate pain. Muscle spasm is the rapid spontaneous contractions of the muscle, which can be painful and uncomfortable. When the nerve impulses are damaged or interrupted that control muscle movement, it could lead to muscle spasms. Symptoms include muscle tightness, joint stiffness, unusual posture, difficulty in moving and pain in affected muscles and joints.

ETOSPAZ MR 4 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having inflammatory bowel disease, severe congestive heart failure, peptic ulcer or cerebrovascular disease. Consult your doctor for advice. Before taking ETOSPAZ MR 4 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have blood disorders, kidney problems, liver problems or heart problems.

ETOSPAZ MR 4 TABLET is not recommended to use among pregnant and breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of this medicine are stomach pain, dry socket, edema, dizziness, headache, palpitations, arrhythmia, constipation, diarrhea, indigestion, gastritis, nausea and vomiting. Consult your doctor if the above side effects worsens or persist for a longer duration.

introduction:
Introduction About DFO MR TABLET

DFO MR TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac and Metaxalone which belongs to the group of medicines called Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) and Muscle relaxants respectively. DFO MR TABLET is used to relieve pain, inflammation and swelling in conditions that affect the muscles. Also, it effectively relieves muscle stiffness or spasm, thereby improving muscle movement.

Before taking DFO MR TABLET inform your doctor if you have heart, liver or kidney disease and including other conditions such as diabetes, high blood pressure and high cholesterol levels.

Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctors before taking DFO MR TABLET. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age and not recommended for use in children.

The most common side effects of taking DFO MR TABLET are nausea, vomiting, upset stomach, drowsiness, headache and nervousness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How DFO MR TABLET Works

DFO MR TABLET relieves pain, inflammation, muscle stiffness or spasm and swelling, where diclofenac works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers that cause pain and inflammation (redness and swelling). Metaxalone works on the centres in the brain and spinal cord to relieve muscle stiffness or spasm also relieves pain and improves the movement of muscles.

Take DFO MR TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow DFO MR TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of DFO MR TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: DFO MR TABLET is not recommended for use in women who are pregnant for more than 6 months as it may affects the baby’s circulation. Consult your doctor before taking DFO MR TABLET if you are planning to become pregnant or if you have problems getting pregnant because this medicine makes it more difficult to become pregnant.
DFO MR TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking DFO MR TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizziness, drowsiness, sleepiness, tiredness and problems with your vision after taking DFO MR TABLET.
Consumption of alcohol is not recommended during management with DFO MR TABLET because it may enhance the effects of alcohol and cause dangerous side effects.
DFO MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease and should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking DFO MR TABLET.
DFO MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease and should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking DFO MR TABLET.
Do not take DFO MR TABLET if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to Diclofenac or Metaxalone or aspirin or ibuprofen or any other NSAID such as naproxen and indomethacin.

DFO MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with lung disease such as asthma, breathing difficulties after taking nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) such as aspirin or ibuprofen. It should be used with caution in patients with asthma, long-term lung disease or lung infection. Consult your doctor before taking DFO MR TABLET.

DFO MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart attack, blockages to blood vessels of the heart and should be used with caution in patients with heart problems, angina and high blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking DFO MR TABLET.

Others

DFO MR TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

An itchy or runny nose
Peptic ulceration (ulcer in your stomach or duodenum)
Stomach or intestinal bleeding (black tarry stools or vomiting blood)
Cerebrovascular disease such as stroke, mini stroke (TIA)
Blockages to blood vessels to the brain or an operation to clear or bypass blockages
Peripheral arterial disease (problems with your blood circulation)

Before taking DFO MR TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Suffer from any stomach or bowel disorders such as ulcerative colitis, crohn's disease
Have condition called porphyria (symptoms such as discolouration of the urine, serious skin disorders, anaemia, abdominal pain and severe mental disorders)
Suffer from serious illness with blistering of the skin, mouth, eyes and genitals or connective tissue disorders such as lupus
Have skin rash, appearance of lesions
Suffer from nasal polyps
Are recovering from major surgery
Are a smoker
Suffer from diabetes
Blood clots, raised cholesterol or raised triglycerides
Are going to have surgery of the stomach or intestinal tract
Seasonal allergic rhinitis

Use in pediatrics:

DFO MR TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.  

 Use in geriatrics:

DFO MR TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above), usually initiating the management with the lowest effective dose. In elderly patients with stomach problems, doctor may prescribe another medicine to protect the stomach during management with this medicine. Consult your doctor before taking DFO MR TABLET.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking DFO MR TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Diuretics such as spironolactone (used to manage edema)
Cardiac glycosides such as digoxin (used to manage heart problems)
Lithium (used to manage some mental problems)
Methotrexate (used to manage some inflammatory disease or some cancers)
Mifepristone (used to terminate pregnancy)
Corticosteroids such as prednisolone (used to manage variety of conditions such as allergies and hormonal imbalances)
Immunosuppressive agents such as ciclosporin, tacrolimus (used to manage organ rejection after transplant)
