name: Etosaid MR Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ETOSAID MR TABLET

ETOSAID MR TABLET is a combination of Etoricoxib and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) and Muscle relaxants. It is used to reduce pain and swelling in the joints and muscles in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, gout and muscle spasm. This medicine is also used for the short-term management after dental surgery for moderate pain. Muscle spasm is the rapid spontaneous contractions of the muscle, which can be painful and uncomfortable. When the nerve impulses are damaged or interrupted that control muscle movement, it could lead to muscle spasms. Symptoms include muscle tightness, joint stiffness, unusual posture, difficulty in moving and pain in affected muscles and joints.

ETOSAID MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having inflammatory bowel disease, severe congestive heart failure, peptic ulcer or cerebrovascular disease. Consult your doctor for advice. Before taking ETOSAID MR TABLET, inform your doctor if you have blood disorders, kidney problems, liver problems or heart problems.

ETOSAID MR TABLET is not recommended to use among pregnant and breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of this medicine are stomach pain, dry socket, edema, dizziness, headache, palpitations, arrhythmia, constipation, diarrhea, indigestion, gastritis, nausea and vomiting. Consult your doctor if the above side effects worsens or persist for a longer duration.

Have peripheral arterial disease

Tell your physician before taking this medicine if you:

Had dehydration (a prolonged bout of vomiting or diarrhea)
Had swelling due to fluid retention
Have being managed for an infection
Have high cholesterol, diabetes
Are a smoker

introduction:
Introduction About BACFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE

BACFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking BACFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

BACFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with BACFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

BACFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking BACFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking BACFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BACFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE
Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How BACFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE Works

BACFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use BACFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE

Take BACFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking BACFEN XL 20MG CAPSULE without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

introduction:
Introduction About MYOTOP DSR TABLET

MYOTOP DSR TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac and Tolperisone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Skeletal Muscle relaxants respectively. It is used in adults to manage painful muscle spasms.

It can also be used to manage back pain (Ex. ankylosing spondylitis), joint pain and swelling (Ex. osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis), neck pain, sports injuries and sprains.

Take MYOTOP DSR TABLET with or just after meals. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with MYOTOP DSR TABLET to achieve better results. Before taking MYOTOP DSR TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your lung, liver, kidney, heart or stomach.

You much also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, asthma or COPD, bleeding disorders or any allergic conditions (such as skin rash, itching or watery eyes, repeated sneezing, nasal congestion and nasal itching) as a precaution.

MYOTOP DSR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe bleeding, perforation or ulcers in the stomach or intestines. Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of taking MYOTOP DSR TABLET dizziness, headache, spinning sensation, nausea, vomiting, indigestion, stomach pain, heartburn, flatulence, loss of appetite, increased liver enzymes and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

How MYOTOP DSR TABLET Works

MYOTOP DSR TABLET contains two medicines namely diclofenac and Tolperisone. Diclofenac is a pain-relieving medication. It acts by blocking the production of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain and inflammation.

Tolperisone is a muscle relaxant. It relaxes skeletal muscles by acting on certain centres of the brain and the spinal cord that controls muscle movements. As a result, MYOTOP DSR TABLET relieves muscle pain and joint pain.

Always take MYOTOP DSR TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. MYOTOP DSR TABLET should be taken with or after food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET

BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET
Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET Works

BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.
usageDetails:
How to use BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET

Take BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking BACLOF OD 20MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

introduction:
Introduction About MEFKIND FORTE SUSPENSION

MEFKIND FORTE SUSPENSION is a combination of Mefenamic acid and Paracetamol, which belongs to a group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) and Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is indicated for the management of fever in children. It is also used for the management of mild to moderate pain such as headache, toothache, joint or muscle pain, and period pain.

MEFKIND FORTE SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in patients with asthma or aspirin-sensitive asthma, severe liver, kidney, or heart disease. Contact your doctor before taking.

MEFKIND FORTE SUSPENSION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. Contact your doctor before taking.

MEFKIND FORTE SUSPENSION is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

MEFKIND FORTE SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in children under 6 months of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

MEFKIND FORTE SUSPENSION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are skin rash, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, constipation, indigestion, flatulence, anorexia, dry mouth, heartburn, peptic ulcers, perforation or GI bleeding, and ulcerative stomatitis. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Mild to moderate pain (headache, toothache, joint or muscle pains, and period pains)

MEFKIND FORTE SUSPENSION helps to relieve fever and pain, where paracetamol acts on the hypothalamus (heat regulating center) of the brain, resulting in peripheral vasodilation, sweating, and loss of body heat, and it also increases the pain threshold by inhibiting COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes, and mefenamic acid works by inhibiting COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes, which are involved in prostaglandin synthesis (responsible for pain and inflammation).

Take this medicine as advised by your doctor. Shake well before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MYOTOP D TABLET

MYOTOP D TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac and Tolperisone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Skeletal Muscle relaxants respectively. It is used in adults to manage painful muscle spasms.

It can also be used to manage back pain (Ex. ankylosing spondylitis), joint pain and swelling (Ex. osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis), neck pain, sports injuries and sprains.

Take MYOTOP D TABLET with or just after meals. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with MYOTOP D TABLET to achieve better results. Before taking MYOTOP D TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your lung, liver, kidney, heart or stomach.

You much also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, asthma or COPD, bleeding disorders or any allergic conditions (such as skin rash, itching or watery eyes, repeated sneezing, nasal congestion and nasal itching) as a precaution.

MYOTOP D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe bleeding, perforation or ulcers in the stomach or intestines. Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of taking MYOTOP D TABLET dizziness, headache, spinning sensation, nausea, vomiting, indigestion, stomach pain, heartburn, flatulence, loss of appetite, increased liver enzymes and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Joint pain, back pain, neck pain

mechanismOfAction:
How MYOTOP D TABLET Works

MYOTOP D TABLET contains two medicines namely diclofenac and Tolperisone. Diclofenac is a pain-relieving medication. It acts by blocking the production of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain and inflammation.

Tolperisone is a muscle relaxant. It relaxes skeletal muscles by acting on certain centres of the brain and the spinal cord that controls muscle movements. As a result, MYOTOP D TABLET relieves muscle pain and joint pain.
usageDetails:
How to use MYOTOP D TABLET

Always take MYOTOP D TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. MYOTOP D TABLET should be taken with or after food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ETOGESIC T TABLET

ETOGESIC T TABLET is a combination of Etodolac and Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Nonsteroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle Relaxants respectively. It is used in adults for the management of acute inflammation conditions associated with muscle spasm characterized by weakness, swelling and muscle pain.

ETOGESIC T TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with asthma, pain before or after bypass surgery. Consult your doctor before taking ETOGESIC T TABLET.

It should be used with caution in patients having liver, kidney, and other heart disease. It is not recommended during pregnancy and in breast feeding mothers, consult your doctor for advice.

As the safety and effectiveness in paediatric patients below the age of 18 years have not been established, consult your doctor before taking ETOGESIC T TABLET.

It should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking ETOGESIC T TABLET are stomach pain, indigestion, heart burn and vomiting. Consult your doctor if the side effects does not improve.

introduction:
Introduction About ARK TH4 TABLET

ARK TH4 TABLET is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

ARK TH4 TABLET is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, ARK TH4 TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking ARK TH4 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take ARK TH4 TABLET if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking ARK TH4 TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take ARK TH4 TABLET only as advised by your doctor. Do not take ARK TH4 TABLET longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with ARK TH4 TABLET to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking ARK TH4 TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About THIOFORD FORTE TABLET

THIOFORD FORTE TABLET is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

THIOFORD FORTE TABLET is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, THIOFORD FORTE TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking THIOFORD FORTE TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take THIOFORD FORTE TABLET if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking THIOFORD FORTE TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take THIOFORD FORTE TABLET only as advised by your doctor. Do not take THIOFORD FORTE TABLET longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with THIOFORD FORTE TABLET to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking THIOFORD FORTE TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About THIOBLIS A 8MG TABLET

THIOBLIS A 8MG TABLET is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

THIOBLIS A 8MG TABLET is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, THIOBLIS A 8MG TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking THIOBLIS A 8MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take THIOBLIS A 8MG TABLET if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking THIOBLIS A 8MG TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take THIOBLIS A 8MG TABLET only as advised by your doctor. Do not take THIOBLIS A 8MG TABLET longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with THIOBLIS A 8MG TABLET to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking THIOBLIS A 8MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Collectively, THIOBLIS A 8MG TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Introduction About MOBISWIFT D TABLET

MOBISWIFT D TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac and Metaxalone which belongs to the group of medicines called Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) and Muscle relaxants respectively. MOBISWIFT D TABLET is used to relieve pain, inflammation and swelling in conditions that affect the muscles. Also, it effectively relieves muscle stiffness or spasm, thereby improving muscle movement.

Before taking MOBISWIFT D TABLET inform your doctor if you have heart, liver or kidney disease and including other conditions such as diabetes, high blood pressure and high cholesterol levels.

Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctors before taking MOBISWIFT D TABLET. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age and not recommended for use in children.

The most common side effects of taking MOBISWIFT D TABLET are nausea, vomiting, upset stomach, drowsiness, headache and nervousness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

warnings.details: MOBISWIFT D TABLET is not recommended for use in women who are pregnant for more than 6 months as it may affects the baby’s circulation. Consult your doctor before taking MOBISWIFT D TABLET if you are planning to become pregnant or if you have problems getting pregnant because this medicine makes it more difficult to become pregnant.
MOBISWIFT D TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking MOBISWIFT D TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizziness, drowsiness, sleepiness, tiredness and problems with your vision after taking MOBISWIFT D TABLET.
Consumption of alcohol is not recommended during management with MOBISWIFT D TABLET because it may enhance the effects of alcohol and cause dangerous side effects.

MOBISWIFT D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease and should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking MOBISWIFT D TABLET.

MOBISWIFT D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease and should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking MOBISWIFT D TABLET.
Do not take MOBISWIFT D TABLET if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to Diclofenac or Metaxalone or aspirin or ibuprofen or any other NSAID such as naproxen and indomethacin.

MOBISWIFT D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with lung disease such as asthma, breathing difficulties after taking nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) such as aspirin or ibuprofen. It should be used with caution in patients with asthma, long-term lung disease or lung infection. Consult your doctor before taking MOBISWIFT D TABLET.

MOBISWIFT D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart attack, blockages to blood vessels of the heart and should be used with caution in patients with heart problems, angina and high blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking MOBISWIFT D TABLET.

Others

MOBISWIFT D TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

An itchy or runny nose
Peptic ulceration (ulcer in your stomach or duodenum)
Stomach or intestinal bleeding (black tarry stools or vomiting blood)
Cerebrovascular disease such as stroke, mini stroke (TIA)
Blockages to blood vessels to the brain or an operation to clear or bypass blockages
Peripheral arterial disease (problems with your blood circulation)

Before taking MOBISWIFT D TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Suffer from any stomach or bowel disorders such as ulcerative colitis, crohn's disease
Have condition called porphyria (symptoms such as discolouration of the urine, serious skin disorders, anaemia, abdominal pain and severe mental disorders)
Suffer from serious illness with blistering of the skin, mouth, eyes and genitals or connective tissue disorders such as lupus
Have skin rash, appearance of lesions
Suffer from nasal polyps
Are recovering from major surgery
Are a smoker
Suffer from diabetes
Blood clots, raised cholesterol or raised triglycerides
Are going to have surgery of the stomach or intestinal tract
Seasonal allergic rhinitis

Use in pediatrics:

MOBISWIFT D TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.  

 Use in geriatrics:

MOBISWIFT D TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above), usually initiating the management with the lowest effective dose. In elderly patients with stomach problems, doctor may prescribe another medicine to protect the stomach during management with this medicine. Consult your doctor before taking MOBISWIFT D TABLET.

MOBISWIFT D TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking MOBISWIFT D TABLET.     

Driving and Using Machines

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizziness, drowsiness, sleepiness, tiredness and problems with your vision after taking MOBISWIFT D TABLET.

Alcohol

Consumption of alcohol is not recommended during management with MOBISWIFT D TABLET because it may enhance the effects of alcohol and cause dangerous side effects.   

Kidney

MOBISWIFT D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease and should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking MOBISWIFT D TABLET. 

Liver

MOBISWIFT D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease and should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking MOBISWIFT D TABLET.

Allergy

Do not take MOBISWIFT D TABLET if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to Diclofenac or Metaxalone or aspirin or ibuprofen or any other NSAID such as naproxen and indomethacin.  

Lungs

MOBISWIFT D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with lung disease such as asthma, breathing difficulties after taking nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) such as aspirin or ibuprofen. It should be used with caution in patients with asthma, long-term lung disease or lung infection. Consult your doctor before taking MOBISWIFT D TABLET.

Heart Disease

MOBISWIFT D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart attack, blockages to blood vessels of the heart and should be used with caution in patients with heart problems, angina and high blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking MOBISWIFT D TABLET.

Others

MOBISWIFT D TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

An itchy or runny nose
Peptic ulceration (ulcer in your stomach or duodenum)
Stomach or intestinal bleeding (black tarry stools or vomiting blood)
Cerebrovascular disease such as stroke, mini stroke (TIA)
Blockages to blood vessels to the brain or an operation to clear or bypass blockages
Peripheral arterial disease (problems with your blood circulation)

Before taking MOBISWIFT D TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Suffer from any stomach or bowel disorders such as ulcerative colitis, crohn's disease
Have condition called porphyria (symptoms such as discolouration of the urine, serious skin disorders, anaemia, abdominal pain and severe mental disorders)
Suffer from serious illness with blistering of the skin, mouth, eyes and genitals or connective tissue disorders such as lupus
Have skin rash, appearance of lesions
Suffer from nasal polyps
Are recovering from major surgery
Are a smoker
Suffer from diabetes
Blood clots, raised cholesterol or raised triglycerides
Are going to have surgery of the stomach or intestinal tract
Seasonal allergic rhinitis

Use in pediatrics:

MOBISWIFT D TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.  

 Use in geriatrics:

MOBISWIFT D TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above), usually initiating the management with the lowest effective dose. In elderly patients with stomach problems, doctor may prescribe another medicine to protect the stomach during management with this medicine. Consult your doctor before taking MOBISWIFT D TABLET.

name: ECT Plus Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ECT PLUS TABLET

ECT PLUS TABLET is a combination of Etoricoxib and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) and Muscle relaxants. It is used to reduce pain and swelling in the joints and muscles in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, gout and muscle spasm. This medicine is also used for the short-term management after dental surgery for moderate pain. Muscle spasm is the rapid spontaneous contractions of the muscle, which can be painful and uncomfortable. When the nerve impulses are damaged or interrupted that control muscle movement, it could lead to muscle spasms. Symptoms include muscle tightness, joint stiffness, unusual posture, difficulty in moving and pain in affected muscles and joints.

ECT PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having inflammatory bowel disease, severe congestive heart failure, peptic ulcer or cerebrovascular disease. Consult your doctor for advice. Before taking ECT PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have blood disorders, kidney problems, liver problems or heart problems.

ECT PLUS TABLET is not recommended to use among pregnant and breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of this medicine are stomach pain, dry socket, edema, dizziness, headache, palpitations, arrhythmia, constipation, diarrhea, indigestion, gastritis, nausea and vomiting. Consult your doctor if the above side effects worsens or persist for a longer duration.
uses: Used to reduce pain, swelling in the joints and muscles in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, gout and muscle spasm

ECT PLUS TABLET reduces pain and swelling in the joints and muscles, whereas Etoricoxib works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers that cause pain and inflammation and Thiocolchicoside works on the centers in the brain and spinal cord to relieve muscle stiffness or spasm and improves pain and movement of muscles.

name: THIOQUEST TWIST 4mg Capsule 10's
introduction:
Introduction About THIOQUEST TWIST 4MG CAPSULE

THIOQUEST TWIST 4MG CAPSULEcontains Thiocolchicoside, which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used in adults and adolescents over 16 years of age to manage painful muscle contractions and for acute painful conditions related to the spine. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of your muscles. They’re common, involuntary, and unpredictable. The symptoms may include swelling, pain, stiffness, tenderness, and fatigue.

Your doctor may advise you to take relevant tests to understand your condition. Before taking THIOQUEST TWIST 4MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have flaccid paralysis (sagging of the face), muscular hypotonia (weak muscles), diarrhoea, lactose intolerance, seizure, or epilepsy.

THIOQUEST TWIST 4MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. THIOQUEST TWIST 4MG CAPSULE should not be used by children or adolescents under the age of 16. The most common side effects of taking THIOQUEST TWIST 4MG CAPSULE are skin allergic reactions, drowsiness, diarrhea, and gastric symptoms. Consult your doctor if your symptoms get worse or persist.
uses: Acute painful conditions related to the spine
usesDetails:
Uses Of THIOQUEST TWIST 4MG CAPSULE
Painful muscle contractions
Acute painful conditions related to the spine
mechanismOfAction:
How THIOQUEST TWIST 4MG CAPSULE Works

THIOQUEST TWIST 4MG CAPSULE works through selective binding to the GABA-A receptor (neurotransmitter). It manages muscle contractions by activating the GABA-inhibitory motor pathway and inhibiting the glycine receptors (neurotransmitters). Thus, relaxing the muscle pain and spasms.
usageDetails:
How to use THIOQUEST TWIST 4MG CAPSULE

Take THIOQUEST TWIST 4MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ACSIS TH 4 TABLET

ACSIS TH 4 TABLET is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

ACSIS TH 4 TABLET is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, ACSIS TH 4 TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking ACSIS TH 4 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take ACSIS TH 4 TABLET if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking ACSIS TH 4 TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take ACSIS TH 4 TABLET only as advised by your doctor. Do not take ACSIS TH 4 TABLET longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with ACSIS TH 4 TABLET to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking ACSIS TH 4 TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Introduction About ETOVA MR FORTE TABLET

ETOVA MR FORTE TABLET is a combination of Etodolac and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and Skeletal muscle relaxants. It is used in the management of osteoarthritis (the most common form of arthritis that occurs when cartilage wears down over time resulting in joint pain and stiffness), painful syndromes of the vertebral column(lower back and neck pain along with muscle stiffness that restricts range of motion and normal posture), rheumatism not related to joint (pain and discomfort are seen but it does damage the joints for long term), painful and muscle spasms due to injury and surgical interventions in adults.

ETOVA MR FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having heart failure, peptic ulcer, relaxed paralysis, muscle hypotonia, undergone by-pass and cardiac surgery, allergic to aspirin or other NSAIDs drugs, pregnant women, breastfeeding women, children and adolescents (below 16 years of age).

Before using ETOVA MR FORTE TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any history of asthma, epilepsy, fluid retention, high blood pressure or impaired heart, kidney or liver function. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of ETOVA MR FORTE TABLET are dizziness, stomach pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting and diarrhoea. If any of these symptoms worsen, consult your doctor.

Introduction About BIZLO OD 30MG TABLET

BIZLO OD 30MG TABLET contains Baclofen which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used to manage muscle spasms caused due to cerebral palsy, multiple sclerosis, stroke or due to any other nerve or spinal cord disorders.

Before taking BIZLO OD 30MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension or any problems with your lung, liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, problems in urination, any mental illness or a previous history of alcoholism or drug abuse.

BIZLO OD 30MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. During management with BIZLO OD 30MG TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests and urine tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

BIZLO OD 30MG TABLET may causes excessive sleepiness. Therefore, avoid engaging into hazardous activities that requires complete alertness. Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it may make you feel drowsier.

The most common side effects of taking BIZLO OD 30MG TABLET are drowsiness, confusion, weakness and feeling unsteady or shaky. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you feel extremely sad or depressed along with thoughts of committing suicide after taking BIZLO OD 30MG TABLET.

Manage muscle spasms (painful muscle contractions)
mechanismOfAction:
How BIZLO OD 30MG TABLET Works

BIZLO OD 30MG TABLET is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.

Take BIZLO OD 30MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with food or milk to avoid nausea.

Do not stop taking BIZLO OD 30MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may cause withdrawal symptoms such as muscle spasms, increased muscle tightness, fast heart rate, fever, confusion, hallucinations, mood changes, mental disorders, feeling attacked or persecuted or convulsions (fits).

Introduction About MYORIDE PLUS TABLET

MYORIDE PLUS TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs and Muscle relaxants. MYORIDE PLUS TABLET is used in adults for the management of acute inflammatory and painful conditions associated with muscle spasms, such as lower back pain, muscle spasm due to any injury, neck and shoulder pain, sciatica (type of nerve pain), degenerative vertebral disorders, ankylosing spondylitis (chronic back pain due to fusion of some bones of the spine), osteoarthritis, and rheumatoid arthritis.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking MYORIDE PLUS TABLET. MYORIDE PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from stomach ulcers, intestinal bleeding or have a history of stomach ulcers, severe kidney problems, liver failure, bleeding disorders, peripheral arterial disease (problem with blood circulation), heart problems such as heart attack, stroke, blockages in blood vessels of brain or heart or had a history of heart surgery for clearing blockages, rare hereditary problems of galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption, therefore consult your doctor before taking.

MYORIDE PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver and kidney problems, seizures, stomach and bowel disorders, asthma or breathing problems, blood disorders (porphyria), recovering from major surgery, and alcohol dependence. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

MYORIDE PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women; therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. MYORIDE PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 16 years of age. MYORIDE PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (>65 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects after taking MYORIDE PLUS TABLET are dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea, drowsiness, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any side effects or an allergic reaction after taking this medicine.

mechanismOfAction:
How MYORIDE PLUS TABLET Works

MYORIDE PLUS TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside, which work together to reduce pain and inflammation. Paracetamol and aceclofenac stop the formation of pain and inflammation-causing chemicals called prostaglandins, and thiocolchicoside acts in the brain and spinal cord on GABA receptors and helps to relieve muscle stiffness and muscle spasms.
usageDetails:

Take MYORIDE PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician. Take MYORIDE PLUS TABLET with meals or after meals. Swallow MYORIDE PLUS TABLET as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration of management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About ZACY MR 8MG TABLET

ZACY MR 8MG TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs and Muscle relaxants. ZACY MR 8MG TABLET is used in adults for the management of acute inflammatory and painful conditions associated with muscle spasms, such as lower back pain, muscle spasm due to any injury, neck and shoulder pain, sciatica (type of nerve pain), degenerative vertebral disorders, ankylosing spondylitis (chronic back pain due to fusion of some bones of the spine), osteoarthritis, and rheumatoid arthritis.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking ZACY MR 8MG TABLET. ZACY MR 8MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from stomach ulcers, intestinal bleeding or have a history of stomach ulcers, severe kidney problems, liver failure, bleeding disorders, peripheral arterial disease (problem with blood circulation), heart problems such as heart attack, stroke, blockages in blood vessels of brain or heart or had a history of heart surgery for clearing blockages, rare hereditary problems of galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption, therefore consult your doctor before taking.

ZACY MR 8MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver and kidney problems, seizures, stomach and bowel disorders, asthma or breathing problems, blood disorders (porphyria), recovering from major surgery, and alcohol dependence. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

ZACY MR 8MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women; therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. ZACY MR 8MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 16 years of age. ZACY MR 8MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (>65 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects after taking ZACY MR 8MG TABLET are dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea, drowsiness, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any side effects or an allergic reaction after taking this medicine.

ZACY MR 8MG TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside, which work together to reduce pain and inflammation. introduction:
Introduction About ACENAAC MR TABLET

ACENAAC MR TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac, Chlorzoxazone and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Muscle relaxants respectively. It is used to manage muscular pains and spasms. It can also be used to provide relief from joint pain (Ex. osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis) and back pain (Ex. ankylosing spondylitis).

Take ACENAAC MR TABLET preferably with meals to avoid gut irritation. Avoid consumption of alcohol as it could aggravate the risk of stomach problems. Do not take ACENAAC MR TABLET if you have any ulcers, bleeding or perforations in the gut.

Before taking ACENAAC MR TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, high blood cholesterol, any inflammation in the bowel or intestines, blood clots, bleeding problems or a previous history of stomach ulcers as a precaution.

ACENAAC MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver failure or stroke. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of taking ACENAAC MR TABLET are nausea, vomiting, indigestion, heartburn and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ACENAAC MR TABLET

It is used to manage:

Muscle pain and spasms
Joint pain and back pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ACENAAC MR TABLET Works

ACENAAC MR TABLET contains three medicines namely Chlorzoxazone, Aceclofenac and paracetamol. Chlorzoxazone is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the brain and in spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.

Aceclofenac and paracetamol are analgesic agents. They provide pain relief by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, inflammation and swelling. Collectively, these action helps in reducing muscle spasms, joint pain and inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use ACENAAC MR TABLET

Take ACENAAC MR TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with meals to avoid gastric irritation.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

ACENAAC MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with moderate to severe kidney diseases. It should be used with caution in patients with mild kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About AC MR TABLET

AC MR TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs and Muscle relaxants. AC MR TABLET is used in adults for the management of acute inflammatory and painful conditions associated with muscle spasms, such as lower back pain, muscle spasm due to any injury, neck and shoulder pain, sciatica (type of nerve pain), degenerative vertebral disorders, ankylosing spondylitis (chronic back pain due to fusion of some bones of the spine), osteoarthritis, and rheumatoid arthritis.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking AC MR TABLET. AC MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from stomach ulcers, intestinal bleeding or have a history of stomach ulcers, severe kidney problems, liver failure, bleeding disorders, peripheral arterial disease (problem with blood circulation), heart problems such as heart attack, stroke, blockages in blood vessels of brain or heart or had a history of heart surgery for clearing blockages, rare hereditary problems of galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption, therefore consult your doctor before taking.

AC MR TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver and kidney problems, seizures, stomach and bowel disorders, asthma or breathing problems, blood disorders (porphyria), recovering from major surgery, and alcohol dependence. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

AC MR TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women; therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. AC MR TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 16 years of age. AC MR TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (>65 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects after taking AC MR TABLET are dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea, drowsiness, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any side effects or an allergic reaction after taking this medicine.

mechanismOfAction:
How AC MR TABLET Works

AC MR TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside, which work together to reduce pain and inflammation. Paracetamol and aceclofenac stop the formation of pain and inflammation-causing chemicals called prostaglandins, and thiocolchicoside acts in the brain and spinal cord on GABA receptors and helps to relieve muscle stiffness and muscle spasms.
usageDetails:
How to use AC MR TABLET

Take AC MR TABLET as advised by your physician. Take AC MR TABLET with meals or after meals. Swallow AC MR TABLET as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration of management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: RELADOL SR Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About RELADOL SR TABLET

RELADOL SR TABLET contains Tolperisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle Relaxants. It is used to relieve painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of the muscles. Symptoms include muscular weakness, tingling or prickling sensation, pain or discomfort.

RELADOL SR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver or kidney impairment, galactose intolerance, the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption and myasthenia gravis. RELADOL SR TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney impairment.

RELADOL SR TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. RELADOL SR TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age) and in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking RELADOL SR TABLET are muscle weakness, headache, nausea, indigestion and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
usesDetails:
Uses Of RELADOL SR TABLET
Relieves painful muscle spasms of the skeletal muscles
mechanismOfAction:
How RELADOL SR TABLET Works

RELADOL SR TABLET works by blocking the voltage-gated sodium channel in the brain stem thereby causing muscle relaxation and stopping the pain signals between nerve and brain. It also relieves pain by increasing the blood supply to skeletal muscles.
usageDetails:
How to use RELADOL SR TABLET

Take RELADOL SR TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with plenty of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking RELADOL SR TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

RELADOL SR TABLET may cause dizziness, sleepiness, attention disturbance, muscle weakness, fits or blurred vision after taking RELADOL SR TABLET. If you experience any such side effects consult your doctor for advice.

RELADOL SR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and kidney function in patients with moderate kidney impairment. Consult your doctor before taking RELADOL SR TABLET.

RELADOL SR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with liver impairment due to increased risk of adverse events and the dose may be adjusted by monitoring the patient’s condition and liver function in patients with moderate liver impairment. Consult your doctor before taking RELADOL SR TABLET.

RELADOL SR TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Tolperisone or any other ingredients of this medicine. It should be used with caution in patients who are allergic to lidocaine (due to cross-reactions).

Others

RELADOL SR TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Galactose intolerance
The Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose-malabsorption
Myasthenia gravis

Use in pediatrics:

RELADOL SR TABLET should be used with caution in children (from 3 months to 14 years of age). Your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon age and body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

The dose of the RELADOL SR TABLET should be adjusted in the elderly. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About DYNAPAR SPAS TABLET

DYNAPAR SPAS TABLET contains a combination of Diclofenac and Dicyclomine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Painkillers and Antispasmodics. DYNAPAR SPAS TABLET is used to manage renal, ureteric, biliary and abdominal Colic (severe pain due to presence of a stone), post operative pain, uterine irritation during pregnancy and primary dysmenorrhoea (cramping pain that occurs before or during the menstruation).

A stone is a hard deposit of minerals formed within the body which can form anywhere along the path from kidney to urethra or gall bladder.

Your doctor may recommend you take relevant medical tests before or during the management with DYNAPAR SPAS TABLET to understand your existing condition and may also advise you to modify your diet with fluids, fruits and vegetables rich in fibers if necessitated by your existing condition.

DYNAPAR SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney or heart diseases, ulcer in stomach or small intestine, stomach or intestinal bleeding, problems with blood circulation, myasthenia gravis, glaucoma (increased pressure in eye), ulcerative colitis, reflux esophagitis, intestinal obstruction or urinary obstruction.

DYNAPAR SPAS TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have lung diseases such as asthma, porphyria, diabetes, blood clots, raised cholesterol, enlarged prostate, runny nose, nasal polyps, habit of smoking or planned surgery of stomach or intestine.

DYNAPAR SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use during last 3 months of pregnancy and should be used with caution in initial 6 months. DYNAPAR SPAS TABLET should not be given to breastfeeding women as it passes through breast milk. Consult your doctor for advice.

In infants below 6 months of age, DYNAPAR SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use and should be used with caution in elderly patients. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking DYNAPAR SPAS TABLET.

The common side effects of taking DYNAPAR SPAS TABLET may include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea or constipation, headache, dizziness, gas-filled stomach, dry mouth and blurring of vision and nervousness etc. Contact your doctor if the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How DYNAPAR SPAS TABLET Works

DYNAPAR SPAS TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac and Dicyclomine. Diclofenac is a Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug that works by inhibiting the release cyclooxygenase, a chemical messenger that produces fever, discomfort and inflammation in the body (redness and swelling). Dicyclomine is an Anticholinergic that decreases and relaxes the abnormal muscle contractions in the stomach and intestine by acting on certain receptors called acetylcholine receptors and directly on smooth muscles.

introduction:
Introduction About ACEMIZ MR TABLET

ACEMIZ MR TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac, Chlorzoxazone and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Muscle relaxants respectively. It is used to manage muscular pains and spasms. It can also be used to provide relief from joint pain (Ex. osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis) and back pain (Ex. ankylosing spondylitis).

Take ACEMIZ MR TABLET preferably with meals to avoid gut irritation. Avoid consumption of alcohol as it could aggravate the risk of stomach problems. Do not take ACEMIZ MR TABLET if you have any ulcers, bleeding or perforations in the gut.

Before taking ACEMIZ MR TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, high blood cholesterol, any inflammation in the bowel or intestines, blood clots, bleeding problems or a previous history of stomach ulcers as a precaution.

ACEMIZ MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver failure or stroke. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of taking ACEMIZ MR TABLET are nausea, vomiting, indigestion, heartburn and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ACEMIZ MR TABLET

It is used to manage:

Muscle pain and spasms
Joint pain and back pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ACEMIZ MR TABLET Works

ACEMIZ MR TABLET contains three medicines namely Chlorzoxazone, Aceclofenac and paracetamol. Chlorzoxazone is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the brain and in spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.

Aceclofenac and paracetamol are analgesic agents. They provide pain relief by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, inflammation and swelling. Collectively, these action helps in reducing muscle spasms, joint pain and inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use ACEMIZ MR TABLET

Take ACEMIZ MR TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with meals to avoid gastric irritation.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MEFWAL PLUS TABLET

MEFWAL PLUS TABLET is a combination of Dicyclomine and Mefenamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticholinergics and Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) respectively. It is used for the management of abdominal (stomach) pain and dysmenorrhea, it is a condition in women who experience severe and frequent cramps and pain during menses.

MEFWAL PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pre-existing renal disease or obstructive uropathy, asthma, increased pressure in eyes (glaucoma), myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), gastrointestinal conditions like inflammatory bowel disease, severe ulcerative colitis, paralysis of intestine (paralytic ileus), chronic constipation (intestinal atony) and toxic dilatation of intestine (megacolon). MEFWAL PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases (heart failure, high blood pressure), impaired liver function, fluid retention, prior history of ulcer disease or gastro-intestinal bleeding and prostate enlargement.

MEFWAL PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in third trimester of pregnancy and should be used with caution in first and second trimester of pregnancy. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. MEFWAL PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in infants (below 6 months of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) as it increases the risk of gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding and perforation which may be fatal. The common side effects of taking MEFWAL PLUS TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEFWAL PLUS TABLET Works

MEFWAL PLUS TABLET contains Dicyclomine and Mefenamic acid. Dicyclomine works by blocking the effects of a chemical called acetylcholine (responsible for causing contraction of muscles) at the acetylcholine-receptor sites along with direct spasmolytic effect upon smooth muscles (musculotropic). This helps to relieve smooth muscle spasm of the intestine, bile duct, ureters and uterus. Mefenamic acid works by inhibiting the enzyme cyclooxygenase (COX) which is responsible for formation of chemical called prostaglandin that is responsible for inflammatory response in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use MEFWAL PLUS TABLET

Take MEFWAL PLUS TABLET as advised by your doctor. It must be taken preferably after food. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not alter or discontinue the daily dose of MEFWAL PLUS TABLET after feeling better without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of MEFWAL PLUS TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About AKILOS TH 4 TABLET

AKILOS TH 4 TABLET is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

AKILOS TH 4 TABLET is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, AKILOS TH 4 TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking AKILOS TH 4 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take AKILOS TH 4 TABLET if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking AKILOS TH 4 TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take AKILOS TH 4 TABLET only as advised by your doctor. Do not take AKILOS TH 4 TABLET longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with AKILOS TH 4 TABLET to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking AKILOS TH 4 TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About IBUGESIC TH 4MG TABLET

IBUGESIC TH 4MG TABLET is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

IBUGESIC TH 4MG TABLET is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, IBUGESIC TH 4MG TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking IBUGESIC TH 4MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take IBUGESIC TH 4MG TABLET if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking IBUGESIC TH 4MG TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take IBUGESIC TH 4MG TABLET only as advised by your doctor. Do not take IBUGESIC TH 4MG TABLET longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with IBUGESIC TH 4MG TABLET to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking IBUGESIC TH 4MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Introduction About FLUZEST 100 MG CAPSULE

FLUZEST 100 MG CAPSULE contains Flupirtine which belongs to a group of medicines called Nonopioid, Non-NSAID analgesics. It is used in the management of acute and chronic pain (such as primary headache, tumor pain, menstrual cramps, pain after traumatologic/orthopaedic operations and injuries and painful increased muscle tone of the posture and motor muscles).  

FLUZEST 100 MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems. Before taking FLUZEST 100 MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have kidney disease, myasthenia gravis, had or have a history of tinnitus (ringing in the ears) or if you are allergic to Flupirtine. FLUZEST 100 MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor.

FLUZEST 100 MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) unless deemed necessary and it should be used with caution in elderly patients, especially in patients with kidney problems. The most common side effects of taking FLUZEST 100 MG CAPSULE are fatigue, dizziness, heartburn, nausea, vomiting, dry mouth, constipation and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ARTACIL 25MG INJECTION

ARTACIL 25MG INJECTION contains Atracurium which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It relaxes your muscles and keeps your body still (immobile) during a surgery. It also relaxes the airway muscles which help in artificial breathing and in facilitating easy insertion of breathing tubes into the airways.

Before receiving ARTACIL 25MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a history of asthma or allergic conditions, any nerve or muscle disorders, electrolyte imbalance or if you are severely dehydrated.

ARTACIL 25MG INJECTION should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. However, it may be used during a caesarean section in pregnant women under close supervision.

ARTACIL 25MG INJECTION may cause difficulty in breathing which is due to relaxation of muscle involved in breathing. In such cases, your doctor might provide you with additional ventilation support until the effect of ARTACIL 25MG INJECTION wears off.

Other most common side effects of receiving ARTACIL 25MG INJECTION are pain or irritation at the site of injection, slow of fast heart rate, low or high blood pressure and flushing of skin. Inform your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ZIX MR 8MG TABLET

ZIX MR 8MG TABLET is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

ZIX MR 8MG TABLET is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, ZIX MR 8MG TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking ZIX MR 8MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take ZIX MR 8MG TABLET if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking ZIX MR 8MG TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take ZIX MR 8MG TABLET only as advised by your doctor. Do not take ZIX MR 8MG TABLET longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with ZIX MR 8MG TABLET to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking ZIX MR 8MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About PYROLATE 0.2MG INJECTION

PYROLATE 0.2MG INJECTION contains Glycopyrrolate which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticholinergics. It is used before or during an operation to reduce saliva and other secretions and to reduce or manage the slowness of the heartbeat during surgery.

PYROLATE 0.2MG INJECTION is also used to protect from the unwanted effects of certain drugs used to reverse the effects of muscle relaxing drugs such as neostigmine or pyridostigmine.

PYROLATE 0.2MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases, glaucoma (increased pressure in the eye), myasthenia gravis, enlarged prostate, stomach or bowel problems (pyloric stenosis or paralytic ileus) or if you are taking a specific medicine called neostigmine.

PYROLATE 0.2MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients who have kidney diseases, down’s syndrome, gastric reflux, diarrhea, ulcerative colitis, overactive thyroid gland, or high temperature. PYROLATE 0.2MG INJECTION should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women. Caution must be exercised while using PYROLATE 0.2MG INJECTION in children and elderly patients above 60 years of age.

The most common side effects of receiving PYROLATE 0.2MG INJECTION are dry mouth, drowsiness, visual disturbances, fast irregular heartbeats, and an urge to pass urine but the inability to do so. Contact your physician for advice if any of the symptoms worsen.

How PYROLATE 0.2MG INJECTION Works

PYROLATE 0.2MG INJECTION helps in decreasing the secretions of the body by blocking the activity of acetylcholine (a chemical messenger in the body responsible for acid and saliva production). Thus, decreasing the production of saliva and stomach acid.

PYROLATE 0.2MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a physician or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion or into a muscle (intramuscular). The correct dose and duration will be decided by your physician for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Introduction About CHYMOMAX MR TABLET

CHYMOMAX MR TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs and Muscle relaxants. CHYMOMAX MR TABLET is used in adults for the management of acute inflammatory and painful conditions associated with muscle spasms, such as lower back pain, muscle spasm due to any injury, neck and shoulder pain, sciatica (type of nerve pain), degenerative vertebral disorders, ankylosing spondylitis (chronic back pain due to fusion of some bones of the spine), osteoarthritis, and rheumatoid arthritis.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking CHYMOMAX MR TABLET. CHYMOMAX MR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from stomach ulcers, intestinal bleeding or have a history of stomach ulcers, severe kidney problems, liver failure, bleeding disorders, peripheral arterial disease (problem with blood circulation), heart problems such as heart attack, stroke, blockages in blood vessels of brain or heart or had a history of heart surgery for clearing blockages, rare hereditary problems of galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption, therefore consult your doctor before taking.

CHYMOMAX MR TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver and kidney problems, seizures, stomach and bowel disorders, asthma or breathing problems, blood disorders (porphyria), recovering from major surgery, and alcohol dependence. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

CHYMOMAX MR TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women; therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. CHYMOMAX MR TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 16 years of age. CHYMOMAX MR TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (>65 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects after taking CHYMOMAX MR TABLET are dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea, drowsiness, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any side effects or an allergic reaction after taking this medicine.

mechanismOfAction:
How CHYMOMAX MR TABLET Works

CHYMOMAX MR TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside, which work together to reduce pain and inflammation. Paracetamol and aceclofenac stop the formation of pain and inflammation-causing chemicals called prostaglandins, and thiocolchicoside acts in the brain and spinal cord on GABA receptors and helps to relieve muscle stiffness and muscle spasms.

Swallow CHYMOMAX MR TABLET as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration of management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About THIOBLIS 4 TABLET

THIOBLIS 4 TABLETcontains Thiocolchicoside, which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It is used in adults and adolescents over 16 years of age to manage painful muscle contractions and for acute painful conditions related to the spine. Muscle spasms (muscle cramps) are painful contractions and tightening of your muscles. They’re common, involuntary, and unpredictable. The symptoms may include swelling, pain, stiffness, tenderness, and fatigue.

Your doctor may advise you to take relevant tests to understand your condition. Before taking THIOBLIS 4 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have flaccid paralysis (sagging of the face), muscular hypotonia (weak muscles), diarrhoea, lactose intolerance, seizure, or epilepsy.

THIOBLIS 4 TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. THIOBLIS 4 TABLET should not be used by children or adolescents under the age of 16. The most common side effects of taking THIOBLIS 4 TABLET are skin allergic reactions, drowsiness, diarrhea, and gastric symptoms. Consult your doctor if your symptoms get worse or persist.
uses: Acute painful conditions related to the spine
usesDetails:
Uses Of THIOBLIS 4 TABLET
Painful muscle contractions
Acute painful conditions related to the spine
mechanismOfAction:
How THIOBLIS 4 TABLET Works

THIOBLIS 4 TABLET works through selective binding to the GABA-A receptor (neurotransmitter). It manages muscle contractions by activating the GABA-inhibitory motor pathway and inhibiting the glycine receptors (neurotransmitters). Thus, relaxing the muscle pain and spasms.
usageDetails:
How to use THIOBLIS 4 TABLET

Take THIOBLIS 4 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Artacil 50mg Injection 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About ARTACIL 50MG INJECTION

ARTACIL 50MG INJECTION contains Atracurium which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants. It relaxes your muscles and keeps your body still (immobile) during a surgery. It also relaxes the airway muscles which help in artificial breathing and in facilitating easy insertion of breathing tubes into the airways.

Before receiving ARTACIL 50MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a history of asthma or allergic conditions, any nerve or muscle disorders, electrolyte imbalance or if you are severely dehydrated.

ARTACIL 50MG INJECTION should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. However, it may be used during a caesarean section in pregnant women under close supervision.

ARTACIL 50MG INJECTION may cause difficulty in breathing which is due to relaxation of muscle involved in breathing. In such cases, your doctor might provide you with additional ventilation support until the effect of ARTACIL 50MG INJECTION wears off.

Other most common side effects of receiving ARTACIL 50MG INJECTION are pain or irritation at the site of injection, slow of fast heart rate, low or high blood pressure and flushing of skin. Inform your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ARTACIL 50MG INJECTION Works

ARTACIL 50MG INJECTION is a muscle relaxant. It works by blocking the transmission of nerve signals from the nerve fibers to the muscles. As a result, it causes muscle relaxation and help you stay immobile during surgeries. ARTACIL 50MG INJECTION can also relax the airway muscles which helps in easy insertion of breathing tubes into the airways and in artificial breathing.
usageDetails:
How to use ARTACIL 50MG INJECTION

ARTACIL 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously) under close monitoring. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

ARTACIL 50MG INJECTION should be used in breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, inform your doctor before receiving it. The nursing infant should be monitored closely when the mother receives this medicine.
Do not drive or operate any machines until the effects of this medicine wears off completely.
Talk to your doctor before receiving ARTACIL 50MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Atracurium or to any other muscle relaxants (such as pancuronium).
ARTACIL 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with a history of asthma. Therefore, inform your doctor before receiving it.
ARTACIL 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with heart problems. Therefore, inform your doctor before receiving it.

ARTACIL 50MG INJECTION should be used in infants, children, and in adolescents (aged above 1 month until 18 years) under close medical supervision. It is not suitable for use in newborns aged below 1 month of age.
ARTACIL 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before receiving it.

Have a history of allergic reactions
Have nerve or muscle disorder (such as myasthenia gravis, poliomyelitis, Eaton-Lambert syndrome etc.)

Are suffering from burns
